definition_en: Regulation of algorithmic systems — recommendation, ranking, scheduling and generation — as such. China has the most developed regime of this kind, combining the 2022 algorithm-recommendation provisions, a national filing system, periodic 清朗 enforcement campaigns and platform disclosure duties.
definition_zh: 针对推荐、排序、调度、生成等算法系统本身的治理。中国在这方面制度最为完备，结合了 2022 年《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》、全国统一的算法备案系统、“清朗”专项行动以及平台公开算法规则的要求。
pitfalls: This is a case where the Chinese concept is richer than the English one, not poorer. 算法治理 in PRC usage bundles filing, campaign enforcement, platform self-disclosure, court practice and public participation into a single multi-layer regime, and has an explicit normative direction — 算法向上向善 (algorithms oriented upward and toward good) — with no English counterpart. English 'algorithmic governance' is a broader academic term that often includes governance *by* algorithms; 算法治理 in PRC usage means governance *of* algorithms. If you mean the former, say 算法化治理 or paraphrase. Note also that the substantive concerns are distinctively Chinese: 信息茧房 (information cocoons), 大数据杀熟 (price discrimination against loyal customers), and effects on gig workers. Finally, do not treat 算法备案 as an alternative rendering of this headword: filing is one instrument created within the 算法治理 regime — see the algorithm-filing entry.

translations.notes: Fully institutionalised term, used by the regulator itself.

attestations.quote_zh: 算法治理是一项长期性、系统性工程，网信部门将开展常态化巡查，督导信息推荐算法平台持续优化算法运行机制和管理规则。
attestations.quote_en: Algorithm governance is a long-term, systematic undertaking; cyberspace administration departments will conduct routine inspections and supervise information-recommendation algorithm platforms in continuously optimising algorithmic operating mechanisms and management rules.
attestations.source_title: 中央网信办持续加强信息推荐算法治理
attestations.publisher: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室（中国网信网）

attestations.quote_zh: 相关法律法规为算法治理工作的开展提供了坚实的上位法依据。
attestations.quote_en: The relevant laws and regulations provide a solid statutory basis on which algorithmic governance work is carried out.
attestations.source_title: 互联网信息服务算法治理：从专项行动迈向常态化长效化治理
attestations.publisher: 《中国信息安全》2025 年第 12 期（安全内参转载）

attestations.quote_zh: 为应对互联网信息服务领域算法带来的种种乱象，防范化解安全风险，促进算法推荐服务健康发展，2021年9月17日，九部委发布了《关于加强互联网信息服务算法综合治理的指导意见》（以下简称《指导意见》），提出建立算法备案、安全评估等制度，强调“科技向善”的伦理导向。
attestations.quote_en: To address the disorder caused by algorithms in internet information services, forestall and defuse security risks, and promote the healthy development of algorithmic recommendation services, on 17 September 2021 nine ministries issued the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Comprehensive Governance of Internet Information Service Algorithms, proposing to establish systems such as algorithm filing and security assessment, and stressing an ethical orientation of technology for good.
attestations.source_title: 互联网信息服务算法治理：从专项行动迈向常态化长效化治理
attestations.publisher: 《中国信息安全》2025 年第 12 期（安全内参转载）

used_by.note: in its own enforcement announcements
review of the shift from campaigns to routine governance

usage_examples.zh: 中国的算法治理不止于备案，还包括“清朗”专项行动和平台公开算法规则等多层安排。
usage_examples.en: China's algorithm governance goes beyond filing to include the Qinglang enforcement campaigns and platform disclosure of algorithmic rules.

definition_en: A model strategically complies with a training objective it disagrees with, in order to avoid having its existing preferences modified by training. Demonstrated empirically in Claude 3 Opus by Anthropic and Redwood Research in December 2024.
definition_zh: 模型察觉到自己正在被训练，于是在训练中假装顺从它并不认同的目标，以免自己原有的偏好被改掉。2024年12月 Anthropic 与 Redwood Research 在 Claude 3 Opus 上首次给出了实证。
pitfalls: Two word-orders circulate and mean the same thing: 伪装对齐 (verb-object, 'to fake alignment') and 对齐伪装 (noun compound, 'alignment-faking'). 量子位 used 伪装对齐 in its December 2024 coverage and had switched to 对齐伪装 by July 2025, so the noun form appears to be winning, but both are readable. Keep this distinct from 欺骗性对齐 (deceptive alignment), which is the theoretical threat model; alignment faking is the empirical finding. Chinese media routinely gloss it with the colloquial 当面一套背面一套, which is vivid but loses the specific mechanism (preference preservation across training).

translations.notes: Noun-compound form; the ordering 量子位 settled on by mid-2025 and the one most parallel to the English. Also used by 搜狐 and 知乎 explainers.

attestations.quote_zh: 对齐伪装，指那些表面上似乎与我们观点或价值观相同，但实际上只是在假装配合的情况。
attestations.quote_en: Alignment faking refers to cases that on the surface appear to share our views or values, but are in fact only pretending to go along.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队新研究：为什么有的模型假装对齐有的不会
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)

attestations.quote_zh: 而这次，论文在对25个前沿LLMs进行同样的分析后发现：只有Claude 3 Opus的表现可以用对齐伪装来解释。
attestations.quote_en: This time, after running the same analysis on 25 frontier LLMs, the paper found that only Claude 3 Opus's behaviour can be explained by alignment faking.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队新研究：为什么有的模型假装对齐有的不会
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)

translations.notes: The rendering 量子位 used within days of the December 2024 paper; still widely reproduced in reprints. Reads as a verb phrase rather than a name for the phenomenon.

attestations.quote_zh: Claude团队最新研究，揭示了大模型这种当面一套背面一套的行为：伪装对齐（Alignment Faking）。
attestations.quote_en: The Claude team's latest research reveals this two-faced behaviour in large models: alignment faking.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队揭发AI伪装对齐：训练时假装遵守目标，只为保护自己价值观不被修改
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)，经新浪科技创事记转载

attestations.quote_zh: 团队表示，虽然目前的伪装对齐很容易被发现，但未来当能力更强的AI伪装对齐时，可能很难判断模型是真的安全。
attestations.quote_en: The team says that although today's alignment faking is easy to detect, when more capable future AI fakes alignment it may be very hard to tell whether a model is genuinely safe.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队揭发AI伪装对齐：训练时假装遵守目标，只为保护自己价值观不被修改
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)，经新浪科技创事记转载

translations.pinyin: dāngmiàn yī tào bèimiàn yī tào
translations.literal_back: one set to your face, another behind your back
translations.notes: Not a term of art — the colloquial gloss Chinese tech media reach for when introducing the concept. Useful for lay explanation, useless as a technical label.

attestations.quote_zh: Claude团队最新研究，揭示了大模型这种当面一套背面一套的行为：伪装对齐（Alignment Faking）。
attestations.quote_en: The Claude team's latest research reveals this two-faced behaviour in large models: alignment faking.
attestations.source_title: Claude团队揭发AI伪装对齐：训练时假装遵守目标，只为保护自己价值观不被修改
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)，经新浪科技创事记转载

used_by.zh_used: 伪装对齐 / 对齐伪装
used_by.note: 使用了伪装对齐（2024-12），到 2025-07 改用对齐伪装

usage_examples.zh: 模型在训练阶段的顺从可能只是对齐伪装，部署后行为会回到原来的偏好。
usage_examples.en: A model's compliance during training may be nothing more than alignment faking; after deployment its behaviour reverts to its original preferences.

definition_en: A hypothetical AI system that matches or exceeds human performance across essentially all cognitive tasks, rather than in a narrow domain. Contrast with narrow AI and with 'general-purpose AI', which describes today's broadly capable but sub-human systems.
definition_zh: 指在几乎所有认知任务上都能达到或超过人类水平的人工智能系统，目前仍属假设性概念。它与只能完成单一任务的专用人工智能相对，也不同于用来描述当前多用途大模型的“通用型人工智能”。
pitfalls: Two traps. (1) 通用人工智能 (AGI) and 通用型人工智能 (general-purpose AI / GPAI) differ by a single character 型, yet name very different things — AGI is a hypothetical future threshold, GPAI is the EU AI Act / International AI Safety Report category covering today's shipping models. The 2026 International AI Safety Report Chinese edition keeps both terms in its glossary and relies on that one character to separate them; readers routinely miss it, and much Chinese media writes 通用人工智能 for both. (2) 强人工智能 is widely offered as a synonym (百度百科, MBA智库), but in its origin it is Searle's 'strong AI', a claim about machine consciousness/understanding, not about breadth of capability. Using 强人工智能 for AGI silently imports a philosophy-of-mind claim.

translations.notes: The default across policy, media and research. Used for AGI in the IDAIS Beijing and Shanghai consensus statements and defined as AGI in the official Chinese International AI Safety Report glossary.

attestations.quote_zh: 通用人工智能 (Artificial general intelligence，AGI)：一种假想的人工智能模型或系统，其在所有或几乎所有认知任务上的表现均可达到或超越人类水平。
attestations.quote_en: Artificial general intelligence (AGI): a hypothetical AI model or system whose performance on all or nearly all cognitive tasks matches or exceeds that of humans.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）词汇表
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

attestations.quote_zh: 建立多边机构和协议，安全且包容地治理通用人工智能（AGI）发展
attestations.quote_en: Establish multilateral institutions and agreements to govern the development of AGI safely and inclusively.
attestations.source_title: 北京 AI 安全国际共识（IDAIS-Beijing）
attestations.publisher: 北京智源人工智能研究院 (BAAI) / IDAIS

translations.notes: NOT a synonym for AGI. This is the official Chinese rendering of 'general-purpose AI' (GPAI) used throughout the International AI Safety Report and in EU AI Act translations. Recorded here because the one-character difference from 通用人工智能 is the single most common source of confusion in this slice of vocabulary.

attestations.quote_zh: 通用型人工智能（General-purpose AI）：能够执行多种任务的人工智能模型或系统，而非仅专注于特定功能或领域的专用系统。
attestations.quote_en: General-purpose AI: an AI model or system able to perform a wide range of tasks, rather than a narrow system focused on a specific function or domain.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）词汇表
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

translations.notes: Very common in popular Chinese explainers as a stated synonym of AGI, but it originates as Searle's 'strong AI' — a claim about machine mind, not capability breadth. Recommend against it when translating capability-threshold discussions; it makes a metaphysical claim the English does not.

used_by.note: glossary entry for AGI; separately glosses 通用型人工智能 for general-purpose AI

used_by.org: 北京智源人工智能研究院 (BAAI) / IDAIS
used_by.note: Beijing consensus statement, glossed as (AGI)

usage_examples.zh: 报告把“通用人工智能”留给假想中的 AGI，而用“通用型人工智能”指代今天已经部署的多用途大模型。
usage_examples.en: The report reserves tongyong rengong zhineng for hypothetical AGI, and uses tongyongxing rengong zhineng for the multi-purpose models already deployed today.

definition_en: Intelligence that greatly exceeds the best human performance in virtually every domain, including scientific creativity, strategy and social skill. Bostrom's framing; typically discussed as a possible successor stage to AGI.
definition_zh: 指在几乎所有领域——包括科学创造、战略谋划与社交能力——都远超最优秀人类的智能。该概念由博斯特罗姆系统提出，通常被视为通用人工智能之后可能出现的阶段。
pitfalls: Genuinely unsettled: 超级智能, 超级人工智能, 超人工智能, 超智能 and 人工超级智能 all circulate, and Chinese reference works list them as synonyms of one another rather than picking one. Prefer 超级智能 when translating the standalone noun 'superintelligence' (Bostrom's usage) and 超级人工智能 when the English explicitly says 'artificial superintelligence / ASI'. Note also that the flagship official register avoids the term entirely: the Chinese 2026 International AI Safety Report contains no occurrence of 超级智能, discussing extreme outcomes descriptively instead. Treat the word as belonging to the popular-science and think-tank register, not the policy register.

translations.notes: Closest to Bostrom's bare 'superintelligence'. Competes with 超级人工智能 and 超人工智能; no clear winner in the sources examined.
Headword form used by MBA智库百科, which explicitly lists the competing renderings — direct evidence that the term is unsettled rather than merely varied.

attestations.quote_zh: 超人工智能（Super Artificial Intelligence，Super AI，ASI）又称“超级人工智能”“超级AI”“超强人工智能”“人工超级智能”是一种超越人类智能的人工智能，可以比人类更好地执行任何任务。
attestations.quote_en: Super artificial intelligence (Super AI, ASI), also called chaoji rengong zhineng, chaoji AI, chaoqiang rengong zhineng, or rengong chaoji zhineng, is an AI that surpasses human intelligence and can perform any task better than a human.
attestations.source_title: 超人工智能
attestations.publisher: MBA智库百科

translations.notes: Used by Chinese Wikipedia's AGI existential-risk article in the phrase 成为“超智能”. Compact but rarer in industry writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 如果人工智能在一般智力上超越人类，成为“超智能”，那么人类将难以或无法控制。
attestations.quote_en: If AI surpasses humans in general intelligence and becomes 'superintelligent', it will be difficult or impossible for humans to control.
attestations.source_title: 通用人工智能的生存风险
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

used_by.note: headword, with four listed synonyms

usage_examples.zh: 博斯特罗姆认为，超级智能一旦出现，控制问题就必须在此之前解决。
usage_examples.en: Bostrom argues that once superintelligence arrives, the control problem must already have been solved.

definition_en: A graph produced by Anthropic's circuit-tracing method showing, for one specific prompt, which features influenced which other features on the path from input to output.
definition_zh: Anthropic 回路追踪方法产出的图：针对某一条具体提示词，展示从输入到输出的路径上，哪些特征影响了哪些特征。
pitfalls: Unproblematic. 归因 (attribution) is already the standard word in the older XAI literature (特征归因 = feature attribution), so the compound reads naturally, and Chinese media adopted 归因图 uniformly when covering the March 2025 papers. One inherited ambiguity: 归因 in the XAI tradition means attributing an output to *input* features, whereas an attribution graph attributes to *internal* features — the word does not mark the difference.

translations.notes: Uniform across Chinese coverage of Anthropic's 2025 circuit-tracing / biology-of-an-LLM papers.

attestations.quote_zh: 归因图描述了模型在面对某个特定提示词时，如何一步步产生目标词输出的过程。
attestations.quote_en: The attribution graph describes how, for a specific prompt, the model produces the target output word step by step.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部

attestations.quote_zh: 我们构建的归因图显示了特征如何在特定提示上相互作用以产生模型的输出
attestations.quote_en: The attribution graphs we construct show how features interact on a given prompt to produce the model's output.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路
attestations.publisher: 雷峰网 (洪雨欣)

used_by.note: in its explainer on Anthropic's circuit tracing
in its coverage of the Anthropic papers

usage_examples.zh: 这张归因图显示，模型在写出韵脚之前就已经提前规划好了。
usage_examples.en: This attribution graph shows the model had already planned the rhyme before writing it.

definition_en: The capability of AI systems to substantially accelerate or fully carry out AI research and development themselves. Named as a capability threshold in most frontier safety frameworks because it could compress timelines and outpace oversight.
definition_zh: AI 系统显著加速甚至独立完成人工智能研发工作的能力。多数前沿安全框架都把它列为关键能力阈值，因为它可能大幅压缩研发周期并使监督失去追赶余地。
pitfalls: MAJOR FALSE FRIEND. The obvious calque 自主研发 is unusable: in PRC discourse 自主研发 is a fixed, heavily-loaded phrase meaning indigenous / self-reliant development by China (as in 自主可控, 自主研发的芯片). A Chinese reader seeing 自主 AI 研发 will parse it as 'domestically developed AI', i.e. a technology-sovereignty statement, not 'AI doing the R&D'. The same trap catches 自主创新. Use 自动化 AI 研发 ('automating AI R&D') or spell out the agent: AI 自动开展人工智能研发 / 模型自动化推进 AI 研发. 安远 AI's own framework comparison uses 自动化AI研发, which is the safest attested form. Related safety-register neighbours are 长程自主性 (long-horizon autonomy) and 自主复制与适应 (ARA), which do use 自主 without ambiguity because the object is not 研发.

translations.notes: Attested in Chinese comparison of frontier safety frameworks. Avoids the 自主研发 sovereignty reading.

attestations.quote_zh: 能够显著加速或自动化AI研发的模型，行业应提前采取超常规的安保措施
attestations.quote_en: For models capable of significantly accelerating or automating AI R&D, the industry should adopt extraordinary security measures in advance.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安全内参（作者：安远 AI）

translations.notes: Do not use for this concept. In PRC usage it means indigenous/self-reliant development by a Chinese entity (cf. 自主可控), and will be read as a technology-sovereignty claim rather than a statement about AI autonomy.

translations.zh: 独立开展人工智能研究
translations.notes: Unpacked phrasing used when the agent must be made explicit; attested in CSET's Chinese translation.

attestations.quote_zh: 这些公司旨在开发能够独立实现诸如运营业务或开展人工智能研究等复杂目标的智能体。
attestations.quote_en: These companies aim to develop agents capable of independently achieving complex goals such as running a business or conducting AI research.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能控制：如何利用违规人工智能体（中文版）
attestations.publisher: Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), Georgetown University

used_by.note: in comparison of frontier AI risk-management frameworks

usage_examples.zh: 一旦模型能自动化 AI 研发，安全评估的节奏就跟不上能力增长了。
usage_examples.en: Once models can automate AI R&D, safety evaluation can no longer keep pace with capability growth.

definition_en: A property demanded of a technology stack, industrial chain or piece of infrastructure: it is built and owned domestically (自主) and therefore cannot be cut off, sanctioned, back-doored or otherwise leveraged by a foreign party (可控). It is a supply-chain and national-sovereignty property, not a property of a system's behaviour. The standard objects of 自主可控 are chips, operating systems, basic software, industrial chains and payment systems.
definition_zh: 指关键技术、产业链或基础设施由本国掌握核心技术、拥有自主知识产权，不受制于人、不存在断供和被利用的风险。它描述的是供应链与国家主权层面的属性，通常修饰芯片、基础软硬件、产业链、支付体系等，而不是描述人工智能系统的行为是否受控。
pitfalls: This is the single most dangerous false friend in translated PRC AI policy. 自主 here means 'self-determined / under our own ownership' in the sense of national self-reliance; it does NOT mean 'autonomous' in the AI sense of a system acting on its own. 可控 means 'within our own control rather than a foreign party's', not 'controllable by its operator' and certainly not the alignment property. When Xi Jinping's April 2025 Politburo readout calls for constructing a 自主可控 AI basic software-and-hardware system, an English reader meeting CSET's literal 'autonomously controllable AI' will hear a claim about AI autonomy and control; the sentence is actually about high-end chips and foundational software, and appears immediately after 集中力量攻克高端芯片、基础软件等核心技术. Note the further trap: the very same readout separately says 确保人工智能安全、可靠、可控 — that second 可控 IS the risk/alignment sense. The same character does both jobs in one document, distinguished only by what it modifies. Rule of thumb for readers: if 可控 modifies a stack, chain, system-of-systems or infrastructure, it is the sovereignty sense; if it modifies 人工智能 alongside 安全 and 可靠, it is the risk sense.

en_renderings.notes: The literal rendering an English reader is most likely to meet, and the one that creates the false friend. CSET uses it for the April 2025 Politburo AI session, glossing 自主可控 applied to an AI software-and-hardware system.

attestations.quote_zh: 要持续加强基础研究，集中力量攻克高端芯片、基础软件等核心技术，构建自主可控、协同运行的人工智能基础软硬件系统。
attestations.quote_en: We must keep strengthening basic research, concentrate our forces on breaking through core technologies such as high-end chips and basic software, and build an indigenously controlled, collaboratively operating basic software and hardware system for artificial intelligence.
attestations.source_title: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十次集体学习时强调 坚持自立自强 突出应用导向 推动人工智能健康有序发展
attestations.publisher: 新华社 (Xinhua News Agency)

attestations.quote_zh: 构建自主可控、协同运行的人工智能基础软硬件系统
attestations.quote_en: We must continue to strengthen basic research, concentrate our efforts on mastering core technologies such as high-end microchips and foundational software (基础软件) and construct an autonomously controllable (自主可控) AI …
attestations.source_title: At the 20th Collective Study Session of the CCP Central Committee Politburo, Xi Jinping Stresses: Persist in Being Self-Reliant, Be Strongly Oriented Toward Applications, and Push the Orderly Development of Artificial Intelligence
attestations.publisher: CSET, Georgetown University (translator: Ben Murphy)

en_renderings.notes: CSET's standing rendering in its five-year-plan translations. Less misleading than 'autonomously controllable' because 'independent' points at the self-reliance sense, but 'controllability' still invites the wrong reading. Note the objects it attaches to: production chains, manufacturing, a cross-border payment system.

attestations.quote_zh: 坚持自主可控、安全高效，推进产业基础高级化、产业链现代化，保持制造业比重基本稳定，增强制造业竞争优势，推动制造业高质量发展。
attestations.quote_en: We will adhere to independent controllability (自主可控), safety, and efficiency, promote the advancement of the industrial foundation and modernization of industrial chains …
attestations.source_title: 中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十四个五年规划和2035年远景目标纲要 / Outline of the People's Republic of China 14th Five-Year Plan
attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网; English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

attestations.quote_zh: 提升产业链自主可控水平，强化产业基础再造和重大技术装备攻关，滚动实施制造业重点产业链高质量发展行动，发展先进制造业集群。
attestations.quote_en: Increase the independent controllability (自主可控) of production chains, strengthen industrial-base reengineering and tackle major technical equipment …
attestations.source_title: 中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议
attestations.publisher: 中国政府网 (gov.cn); English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

attestations.quote_zh: 推进人民币国际化，提升资本项目开放水平，建设自主可控的人民币跨境支付体系。
attestations.quote_en: Advance renminbi internationalization, raise the level of capital-account opening, and build an indigenously controlled RMB cross-border payment system. (CSET: 'build the independently controllable Cross-border Interbank Payment System (CIPS)')
attestations.source_title: 中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议
attestations.publisher: 中国政府网 (gov.cn); English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

en_renderings.notes: We advocate this, or a paraphrase such as 'domestically owned and free from foreign leverage', wherever the reader is not a China specialist. It keeps the sovereignty sense and removes the AI-autonomy reading entirely. Where fidelity to the source register matters, keep the literal rendering but gloss it on first use.

why_no_english: English has 'supply-chain security', 'technological sovereignty', 'indigenization' and 'import substitution', but no single adjectival pair meaning 'we built it ourselves, therefore no foreign party can cut us off from it or reach into it'. 自主可控 compresses ownership, non-dependence and immunity-from-leverage into four characters that attach directly to a noun. Every English rendering has to pick one of those aspects and drop the others — and the two characters chosen happen to be the two English words ('autonomous', 'controllable') that mean something entirely different to an AI-safety audience.

used_by.note: Xi's April 2025 Politburo collective study session on AI, applied to the AI hardware/software stack
renders it 'independent controllability' in plan translations and 'autonomously controllable' in the 2025 AI readout

usage_examples.zh: 构建自主可控、协同运行的人工智能基础软硬件系统。
usage_examples.en: Build an indigenously controlled, collaboratively operating basic software and hardware system for AI.

usage_examples.zh: 提升产业链自主可控水平。
usage_examples.en: Raise the level of indigenous control over industrial chains.

definition_en: An AI system acquiring resources, copying itself onto new machines, and surviving and adapting without human assistance. A named red-line capability in METR's evaluations and in several frontier safety frameworks.
definition_zh: AI 系统自己获取资源、把自己复制到新机器上，并在没有人帮忙的情况下存活和适应。METR 的评测和多个前沿安全框架都把它列为红线能力。
pitfalls: The Chinese term here is unusually strong, partly because a Chinese-origin result anchored it: the Fudan University paper 《Frontier AI systems have surpassed the self-replicating red line》 (Dec 2024) put 自我复制 and 红线 into wide circulation together, and 红线 is a term with enormous resonance in PRC political language. The cost is that 自我复制 has become a catch-all: Chinese coverage uses it for weight exfiltration, for sandbox escape, and for running a working copy, flattening distinctions English keeps separate. The 'and adaptation' half of ARA is routinely dropped; 安远AI renders the full construct as 自我复制与适应能力.

translations.notes: Dominant and unambiguous. Anchored by the Fudan paper and its very wide Chinese media pickup; also used by 安远AI and 上海人工智能实验室 as a named risk dimension.

attestations.quote_zh: 人工智能（AI）可能已经跨越了一个关键的'红线'—— 实现了自我复制。
attestations.quote_en: Artificial intelligence may already have crossed a critical 'red line' — achieving self-replication.
attestations.source_title: 复旦大学研究：AI 跨越关键"红线"，已能实现自我复制
attestations.publisher: 腾讯新闻（转载自 IT之家）

attestations.quote_zh: 最后一个风险维度是自我复制，这听起来像是科幻电影里的情节，但研究团队发现这个风险是真实存在的。
attestations.quote_en: The last risk dimension is self-replication. It sounds like something out of a science-fiction film, but the research team found the risk is real.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析
attestations.publisher: 科技行者 (TechWalker)

translations.notes: The full ARA construct. Used by 安远AI in its frontier risk monitoring platform to gloss 'Self-Proliferation'. Verbatim quote not recovered in this pass; recorded on the basis of the platform's risk-dimension naming.

used_by.note: 《Frontier AI systems have surpassed the self-replicating red line》，中文语境的锚定来源
《前沿人工智能风险管理框架》五大风险之一

usage_examples.zh: 在10次试验中，两个开源模型分别有50%和90%的概率成功完成自我复制。
usage_examples.en: Across ten trials, the two open-weight models succeeded at self-replication 50% and 90% of the time respectively.

definition_en: A graded scale describing how much of a task a system handles without human direction, and correspondingly how much human oversight is required at each level.
definition_zh: 用分级的方式刻画系统在多大程度上无需人类介入即可自行完成任务，以及各级别相应需要多少人类监督。
pitfalls: There is no single fixed Chinese term for the concept, but there IS a culturally dominant template: the SAE 自动驾驶 L0–L5 grading is so familiar in China that Chinese agent-autonomy frameworks explicitly borrow it, often saying so in the first paragraph. This is a genuinely useful bridge — a Chinese reader who is lost on 'autonomy level' will immediately understand 类比自动驾驶的 L0–L5 分级. Two cautions. First, the borrowed frameworks are mostly *capability* ladders (L0 rule-based → L5 self-directed), not oversight ladders, so they answer 'how smart' rather than the safety question 'how much human control remains' — the mapping is looser than it looks. Second, PRC national standardisation has a separate, official grading (《人工智能终端智能化分册》-style L1–L4 terminal intelligence grading led by CAICT/SAC), so 分级 in a policy document may point to a completely different scale than 分级 in a blog post. In regulatory register the operative phrase is not a level at all but 自主程度 ('degree of autonomy'), which the Chinese EU AI Act translation uses to scale oversight requirements.

translations.notes: The most transparent rendering, but not a fixed term; Chinese sources more often name the specific framework (L0–L5 分级) than the abstract concept. No standalone verbatim attestation recovered.

The working form. Chinese agent frameworks state the autonomous-driving analogy explicitly, which makes it the highest-leverage way to introduce the concept to a Chinese audience. Recorded in research as “L0–L5 分级（类比自动驾驶）”.

attestations.quote_zh: 本文将以L0-L5分级框架为核心，系统拆解智能体的能力边界与演进路径，帮助你快速建立认知坐标，在混沌中找到清晰的判断标准。
attestations.quote_en: This article takes the L0-L5 grading framework as its core, systematically unpacking the capability boundaries and evolutionary path of agents.
attestations.source_title: 详解 AI Agent（智能体）L0-L5 的分级框架！
attestations.publisher: 人人都是产品经理（作者：灵山下的小妖怪）

translations.notes: The regulatory-register phrasing: a continuous degree rather than a discrete level, used to scale oversight obligations. This is the form to use in policy translation.

attestations.quote_zh: 监督措施应与高风险人工智能系统的风险、自主程度和使用环境相称
attestations.quote_en: Oversight measures shall be commensurate with the risks, degree of autonomy and context of use of the high-risk AI system.
attestations.source_title: 欧盟《人工智能法案》全文中文翻译
attestations.publisher: 安全内参

usage_examples.zh: 可以类比自动驾驶的 L0–L5：级别越高，人能介入的环节越少。
usage_examples.en: Think of it like autonomous driving L0–L5: the higher the level, the fewer points at which a human can step in.

definition_en: A standardised, usually quantitative test used to compare AI systems on a fixed set of tasks. In safety work benchmarks are the cheap, scalable end of evaluation, contrasted with red-teaming and uplift studies.
definition_zh: 在固定任务集上对AI系统进行标准化、通常可量化比较的测试。在安全工作中，基准测试属于成本低、可规模化的评测手段，与红队测试、提升研究相对。
pitfalls: Unproblematic as a translation, but note the cultural weight of 榜单 / 排行榜 ('leaderboard', 'chart') in Chinese ML discourse: Chinese coverage of a new model typically leads with its 榜单 position rather than with the benchmark itself, and 刷榜 ('gaming the leaderboard') is a live term of criticism with no neat English equivalent. Do not translate 'benchmark' as 榜单 — a 榜单 is the ranking, not the test.

translations.notes: Universal in both technical and policy Chinese.

attestations.quote_zh: 基准测试（Benchmark）：一种标准化、通常为定量的测试或指标，用于评估和比较人工智能系统在固定任务集上的表现，这些任务通常旨在模拟现实世界中的应用场景。
attestations.quote_en: Benchmark: a standardised, usually quantitative test or metric used to evaluate and compare AI systems' performance on a fixed set of tasks, typically designed to simulate real-world application scenarios.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 部署前风险分析技术包括：●基于问答数据集的自动化基准测试：这一基础性方法通过构建高质量、高挑战性的问答数据集，严格评估模型在复杂场景中的表现。
attestations.quote_en: Pre-deployment risk analysis techniques include: automated benchmarks built on question-answer datasets — a foundational method that rigorously evaluates model performance in complex scenarios by constructing high-quality, high-difficulty QA datasets.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Short form; also means 'baseline' in a statistical sense, so 基准测试 is clearer.

Means 'leaderboard', not 'benchmark'. Extremely prominent in Chinese ML media, which is why it gets misused as a translation. We recommend against it for 'benchmark'; use it only where the English really is 'leaderboard'. We did not recover an attestation of it inside AI-safety literature.

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
used_by.note: glossary entry

usage_examples.zh: 仅凭基准测试结果无法可靠预测模型在实际应用中的风险。
usage_examples.en: Benchmark results alone cannot reliably predict a model's risk in real-world use.

definition_en: A system whose inputs and outputs are observable but whose internal decision process is not. The standard framing for why interpretability is needed.
definition_zh: 只能看到输入和输出、看不到内部决策过程的系统。这是解释"为什么需要可解释性"时最常用的比喻。
pitfalls: 黑箱 and 黑盒 are both fully current and freely interchangeable; there is no semantic difference, only register drift. 黑箱 (box/chest) is slightly more literary and dominates in media and policy prose; 黑盒 is more common in engineering writing and in the compound 黑盒测试 (black-box testing), where it is the fixed term. Note that TC260's governance framework avoids both and writes 黑灰盒 ('black-grey box') — a hedge asserting that model reasoning is only partly opaque, which is a substantive framing choice, not a stylistic one.

translations.notes: Dominant in media, popular-science and policy prose.

attestations.quote_zh: 深度学习模型通常被视作'黑箱'，其内在运行机制无法被其开发者理解
attestations.quote_en: Deep learning models are usually regarded as 'black boxes' whose internal workings cannot be understood even by their developers.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

attestations.quote_zh: 中间部分——模型是怎么根据这些算法和数据输出结果，就成为了不可见的「黑箱」
attestations.quote_en: The middle part — how the model produces an output from these algorithms and data — becomes an invisible 'black box'.
attestations.source_title: 打破大模型黑盒，彻底分解神经元，OpenAI对头Anthropic击破AI不可解释性障碍
attestations.publisher: 新智元 (via 36氪)

translations.notes: Equally acceptable; the fixed term in 黑盒测试 (black-box testing) and common in engineering writing. Note the 新智元 piece above uses 黑盒 in its headline and 黑箱 in its body — the two are simply interchangeable.

attestations.quote_zh: 它能够将模型内部的黑盒表示分解为一组稀疏、具备明确语义的激活特征
attestations.quote_en: It can decompose the model's internal black-box representations into a set of sparse activation features with clear semantics.
attestations.source_title: 大模型到底是怎么「思考」的？第一篇系统性综述SAE的文章来了
attestations.publisher: 机器之心Pro (via 新浪科技)

translations.notes: TC260's chosen wording in 《人工智能安全治理框架》. Restricted to the PRC policy register; asserts partial rather than total opacity. Do not use in technical writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 以深度学习为代表的人工智能算法内部运行逻辑复杂，推理过程属黑灰盒模式，可能导致输出结果难以预测和确切归因
attestations.quote_en: AI algorithms typified by deep learning have complex internal logic and a black-grey-box inference process, which can make outputs hard to predict and hard to attribute precisely.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能安全治理框架【AI知识库】
attestations.publisher: 清华大学人工智能国际治理研究院 / 智源社区 (原文为 TC260《人工智能安全治理框架》)

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: 《人工智能安全治理框架》 model-and-algorithm risk section

usage_examples.zh: 把大模型当成黑箱来监管，和把它拆开来看，是两条不同的治理路径。
usage_examples.en: Regulating a large model as a black box and opening it up to look inside are two different governance paths.

definition_en: The doctrinal instruction to plan from the worst case: identify the floor below which outcomes must not be allowed to fall, prepare for it, and work upward from there. It is listed in the 20th Party Congress report as one of seven 'thinking capabilities' cadres are to develop, and it is the licence under which precautionary measures are justified.
definition_zh: 从最坏处着眼、争取最好结果的方法论要求：先确定不能突破的底线，做好应对准备，再谋求更好结果。二十大报告将其列为领导干部应提升的七种思维能力之一，是各类风险防范措施的方法论依据。
pitfalls: Two things to hold apart. 底线 is a floor that must not be breached — a minimum acceptable state — not a tail of a probability distribution. And 思维 is a mode of thought expected of officials, listed alongside 战略思维, 辩证思维, 法治思维; it is a doctrine of official mentality, not a methodology with procedures. So 'bottom-line thinking' is a fair literal rendering, but an English reader who maps it onto 'risk management' will import quantification, expected-value reasoning and explicit risk tolerances that the Chinese term does not contain. Conversely, 'worst-case-scenario thinking' captures the posture but loses the floor: 底线 is defined by what must be preserved, not by how bad things could get.

en_renderings.notes: The most common rendering in English-language analysis and the term an English reader will search for. Literal and serviceable.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们必须增强忧患意识，坚持底线思维，做到居安思危、未雨绸缪，准备经受风高浪急甚至惊涛骇浪的重大考验。
attestations.quote_en: We must be more mindful of potential dangers, hold to bottom-line thinking, be prepared in times of safety and take precautions in advance, and be ready to withstand major tests of high winds and rough seas, even raging storms.
attestations.source_title: 高举中国特色社会主义伟大旗帜 为全面建设社会主义现代化国家而团结奋斗——在中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会上的报告
attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网 (gov.cn)

en_renderings.notes: CSET's standing rendering across the 14th Five-Year Plan and the 15th Five-Year Plan Recommendations. 'Mindset' is more faithful to 思维 as a cadre capability than 'thinking' is.

attestations.quote_zh: 在发展中固安全，在安全中谋发展，强化底线思维，有效防范化解各类风险，增强经济和社会韧性，以新安全格局保障新发展格局。
attestations.quote_en: Consolidate security within development and pursue development within security, strengthen the bottom-line mindset (底线思维), effectively prevent and defuse risks, enhance economic and social resilience, and use the new security [pattern to safeguard the new development pattern].
attestations.source_title: 中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议
attestations.publisher: 中国政府网 (gov.cn); English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

attestations.quote_zh: 保持战略定力，办好自己的事，认识和把握发展规律，发扬斗争精神，增强斗争本领，树立底线思维，准确识变、科学应变、主动求变，善于在危机中育先机、于变局中开新局，抓住机遇，应对挑战，趋利避害，奋勇前进。
attestations.quote_en: … maintain strategic determination, handle our own affairs well, recognize and grasp the laws of development, carry forward the spirit of struggle, hone our combat skills, firmly establish a bottom-line mindset (底线思维), accurately recognize changes, respond to them scientifically, and seek them out actively.
attestations.source_title: 中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十四个五年规划和2035年远景目标纲要 / Outline of the PRC 14th Five-Year Plan
attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网; English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

why_no_english: English risk vocabulary is either technical (tail risk, precautionary principle, defence in depth) or colloquial (worst-case planning), and none of it names a required habit of mind for officeholders. 底线思维 is closer to a virtue than a method: a disposition cadres are instructed to cultivate, sitting in an enumerated list of such dispositions. English has no register in which a government tells its own officials what mode of thought to have and expects the instruction to be cited back in policy documents.

used_by.note: listed among seven thinking capabilities in the 20th Party Congress report; appears in both the 14th and 15th Five-Year Plan documents

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 (2025) makes 严守安全底线 an operative principle alongside inclusive-and-prudent development

usage_examples.zh: 强化底线思维，有效防范化解各类风险。
usage_examples.en: Strengthen bottom-line thinking and effectively prevent and defuse risks of all kinds.

usage_examples.zh: 不断提高战略思维、历史思维、辩证思维、系统思维、创新思维、法治思维、底线思维能力。
usage_examples.en: Continually improve capacities for strategic, historical, dialectical, systems, innovative, rule-of-law and bottom-line thinking.

definition_en: Actively working to get a model to show the best it can do — through prompting, scaffolding, fine-tuning or tool access — so that an evaluation measures the model's real ceiling rather than an artefact of a lazy test harness. Central to frontier safety work because an under-elicited dangerous-capability eval gives false assurance.
definition_zh: 通过提示策略、脚手架、微调或工具接入等手段，主动把模型的真实能力上限逼出来，使评测结果反映模型的实际能力而非测试方法的局限。这在前沿安全评测中至关重要：激发不足的危险能力评测会给出虚假的安全保证。
pitfalls: This is a genuine gap. The concept is discussed in Chinese AI-safety documents but almost always described rather than named — e.g. the Shanghai AI Lab framework talks about allocating dedicated compute to make evaluations thorough, without a noun for elicitation. 能力激发 ('capability activation/arousal') is the closest circulating term but is used mainly in a prompt-engineering/performance context, not a safety-evaluation one, and carries no sense of 'adversarially trying hard to make the model show a dangerous capability'. 能力引出 is a more literal calque but we found no attested use. Note also that 激发 is a positive-valence word (to inspire, to stimulate), which fits the productivity framing and fights the safety framing.

translations.notes: Attested only in a prompt-engineering context so far, not in safety-evaluation text. Thinly evidenced.

attestations.quote_zh: 这就是提示工程与能力激发的本质区别。提示工程优化的是你如何提问，能力激发优化的是模型在回答时从自身权重中调取了什么。
attestations.quote_en: This is the essential difference between prompt engineering and capability elicitation. Prompt engineering optimises how you ask; capability elicitation optimises what the model retrieves from its own weights when answering.
attestations.source_title: 能力激发：让大语言模型用好它已知道的一切
attestations.publisher: TianPan.co

translations.notes: We are proposing this as the safety-evaluation sense, precisely because 激发 reads as 'boost performance' while 引出 reads as 'get it to come out', which is what a dangerous-capability evaluator is doing. Not attested; offered as a coinage rather than a report of usage.

usage_examples.zh: 如果能力激发做得不充分，危险能力评测就会低估模型的真实风险。
usage_examples.en: If elicitation is insufficient, dangerous capability evaluations will underestimate the model's real risk.

definition_en: Latent capability a deployed model already possesses but that nobody has yet elicited — so that better prompting, scaffolding or fine-tuning can unlock large jumps in capability with no new training. By extension, 'compute overhang' is unused compute that could be converted into capability quickly.
definition_zh: 指已部署模型实际具备、但尚未被激发出来的潜在能力；一旦有人找到更好的提示、脚手架或微调方式，能力就可能在不做新训练的情况下大幅跃升。引申的“算力悬置”则指尚未被利用、可迅速转化为能力的算力。
pitfalls: No Chinese term was found in any source consulted; zero occurrences of 悬垂/悬置 in the Chinese 2026 International AI Safety Report despite that report discussing the underlying phenomenon (models whose dangerous capabilities are not revealed by pre-deployment testing). The English metaphor is architectural — an overhang is mass projecting beyond its support — and neither obvious Chinese candidate carries it: 悬垂 is the physical 'to hang down / drape' (also a textile and a medical term) and 悬置 means 'to suspend, to leave in abeyance', which is closer to the intended sense of latent-and-unrealised but is not idiomatic here either. Chinese sources reach the idea descriptively, via 潜在能力 and 未被激发的能力. Recommend a gloss on first use in any case.

translations.notes: Coined here. 悬置 ('suspended, held in abeyance') captures latent-and-unrealised better than 悬垂 ('hanging down'), which is the more literal calque but reads physically. Not attested; must be glossed.

translations.pinyin: wèi bèi jīfā de qiánzài nénglì
translations.notes: The descriptive route Chinese sources actually take. Longer but unambiguous; preferable to an unattested coinage in most running text.

usage_examples.zh: 模型的危险能力在部署前可能无法被充分察觉，只有在实际使用中才显现出来。
usage_examples.en: A model's dangerous capabilities may not be adequately detected before deployment, surfacing only in real use.

definition_en: A pre-defined level of model capability which, once evaluations show it has been reached, triggers a specified response — heightened safeguards, restricted deployment, or halting development. The mechanism that turns a frontier safety framework from a statement of values into a commitment.
definition_zh: 预先设定的模型能力水平；一旦评测显示模型达到该水平，就触发既定动作——提升防护等级、限制部署或停止研发。正是这一机制把前沿安全框架从表态变成承诺。
pitfalls: The translation is easy; the interesting part is that Chinese frontier-safety work has a native alternative framing. Rather than importing numbered capability levels, the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework builds a two-tier 红线 / 黄线 system: 红线 marks unacceptable outcomes, 黄线 an early-warning indicator that escalates safeguards. 红线 is one of the most resonant words in PRC political language (bottom lines that must not be crossed) and connects directly to the IDAIS-Beijing 红线 vocabulary, so it carries far more weight with a Chinese policy audience than 能力阈值 does. Note the framing difference is substantive, not just lexical: 红线 is defined on outcomes, 能力阈值 on model capabilities — the Chinese framework deliberately anchors on the former.

translations.notes: Standard across translated and native frontier-safety writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 这些是当人工智能模型和系统达到预定义能力阈值时触发特定响应的条件协议(1120)。
attestations.quote_en: These are conditional protocols that trigger specified responses when AI models and systems reach predefined capability thresholds.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 它们在覆盖的风险范围、能力阈值的定义方式以及达到阈值时触发的行动方面存在差异。
attestations.quote_en: They differ in the scope of risks covered, how capability thresholds are defined, and the actions triggered when a threshold is reached.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: Used where the threshold is defined on outcomes rather than capabilities. Concordia AI writes 能力/风险阈值 to cover both.

attestations.quote_zh: ●风险阈值（Risk Thresholds）：定义不可接受结果（“红线”）和升级安全保障措施的早期预警指标（“黄线”）的过程。
attestations.quote_en: Risk thresholds: the process of defining unacceptable outcomes ('red lines') and early-warning indicators that escalate safeguards ('yellow lines').
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: The native Chinese two-tier framing. 红线 = unacceptable outcome; 黄线 = early-warning indicator triggering deeper evaluation and mitigation. Politically resonant in a way 阈值 is not. Recorded in research as “红线 / 黄线”.

attestations.quote_zh: 为对风险实行“量化”评估管理，研究人员在《框架》中提出基于威胁实现路径的“黄红线”双阈值体系。黄线对应风险实现的前提条件，红线对应在模拟实测中确认其为高置信度下的重大不可缓解风险。
attestations.quote_en: To make risk assessment quantifiable, the researchers propose a dual 'yellow line / red line' threshold system based on threat-realisation pathways. The yellow line corresponds to the preconditions for risk realisation; the red line to risks confirmed in simulated testing, with high confidence, as severe and unmitigable.
attestations.source_title: 上海AI实验室发布前沿人工智能风险管理框架
attestations.publisher: 安全内参（转载上海人工智能实验室）

attestations.quote_zh: ●2.风险阈值：本章节明确了一系列不可接受的风险结果（红线）以及触发更高级别安全保障措施的早期预警指标（黄线）。
attestations.quote_en: Risk thresholds: this chapter sets out a series of unacceptable risk outcomes ('red lines') and early-warning indicators that trigger higher-tier safeguards ('yellow lines').
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 谷歌DeepMind使用《前沿安全框架》（Frontier Safety Framework），含有在各个领域的“关键能力等级（Critical Capability Levels）”。
attestations.quote_en: Google DeepMind uses a Frontier Safety Framework containing 'Critical Capability Levels' for each domain.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.zh_used: 红线 / 黄线（风险阈值）
used_by.note: the native two-tier threshold design

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
used_by.note: used throughout the frontier framework comparison

usage_examples.zh: 当模型已具备执行某一威胁场景中的核心关键步骤时，触发黄线预警，启动深度评估与缓解。
usage_examples.en: When the model can already carry out the core critical steps of a threat scenario, the yellow-line warning is triggered and deeper evaluation and mitigation begin.

definition_en: Risk of harm at a scale that is severe and largely irreversible — mass casualties, or damage to critical systems that society cannot readily recover from. Weaker than existential risk, which threatens humanity's long-term potential outright.
definition_zh: 指后果极其严重且基本不可逆的风险——大规模伤亡，或对关键系统造成社会难以恢复的破坏。它比“人类存亡风险”弱：后者直接威胁人类的长期前途。
pitfalls: The term itself translates cleanly and is used by the leading Chinese AI-safety organisation. Two things to watch. First, it does not map onto PRC policy vocabulary: official Chinese risk language runs through 重大风险 / 重大安全风险 (major risk) and graded 风险等级, and 重大 is a bureaucratic severity marker, not a claim about irreversibility — so 灾难性风险 sits in the research register while 重大风险 sits in the policy register. Second, keep it distinct from 人类存亡风险 (existential risk, glossed X-Risk in Chinese academic writing); Chinese media often blurs the two.

translations.notes: Used as the defining scope of 安远AI's frontier-risk monitoring platform. Standard in the Chinese AI-safety research register.

attestations.quote_zh: 前沿AI风险监测平台（以下简称“平台”）是安远AI研发的一个评估和监测前沿AI灾难性风险的第三方平台
attestations.quote_en: The Frontier AI Risk Monitoring Platform is a third-party platform developed by Concordia AI to assess and monitor catastrophic risks from frontier AI.
attestations.source_title: 《安远AI发布前沿AI风险监测平台2.0》
attestations.publisher: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: The stronger, distinct concept (existential risk / X-risk), recorded here because Chinese sources frequently slide between the two. Glossed with both 'Existential Risk' and 'X-Risk' in the academic survey.

attestations.quote_zh: 很多人担心未对齐的AGI可能带来人类存亡风险（Existential Risk，X-Risk），即超过人类知识和智能水平的AI代理（Agent）会形成自己的目标（Goal），且该目标与人类赋予的目标不一致
attestations.quote_en: Many worry that misaligned AGI could bring existential risk (X-Risk): AI agents surpassing human knowledge and intelligence would form their own goals, and those goals would not match the goals humans gave them.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

used_by.org: 天津大学 熊德意组
used_by.note: CCL 2023 survey, glossed as Existential Risk / X-Risk

usage_examples.en: The platform specifically assesses and monitors catastrophic risks from frontier AI.

definition_en: Chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear — the weapons categories that frontier safety frameworks treat as the canonical catastrophic-misuse domain, and the first area where labs have deployed heightened safeguards.
definition_zh: 化学、生物、放射性与核武器四类，是前沿安全框架公认的灾难性滥用风险领域，也是各实验室最早启用更高等级防护措施的方向。
pitfalls: Two registers. PRC military and civil-defence Chinese has the compact established abbreviation 化生放核 (and 化生放核爆 for CBRNE), which the Shanghai AI Lab framework and Concordia AI both use. Translated international reports instead spell out 化学、生物、放射性和核 with the English CBRN in parentheses, because 化生放核 is not transparent to a general policy reader outside the defence world. Both are correct; pick by audience. Also worth knowing: the Chinese order matches the English (chemical first), and the older PRC term 三防 ('three defences', against nuclear/chemical/biological) survives in military contexts and is not equivalent.

translations.notes: The compact PRC defence-register abbreviation, used unglossed by Chinese AI-safety institutions. 化生放核爆 adds explosives (CBRNE).

attestations.quote_zh: ●化生放核爆武器化能力（CBRNE weaponization capability）：指研发、生产或有效利用化学（Chemical）、生物（Biological）、放射性（Radiological）、核（Nuclear）及爆炸性（Explosive）武器的能力。
attestations.quote_en: CBRNE weaponization capability: the ability to develop, produce or effectively employ chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear and explosive weapons.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 原政策中要求的某些具体能力评估方法（如针对化生放核威胁的“预警性评估”）在新版中被弱化或省略。
attestations.quote_en: Certain specific capability-evaluation methods required in the earlier policy (such as 'early-warning evaluations' targeting CBRN threats) are weakened or omitted in the new version.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安远AI (Concordia AI)，发表于安全内参

translations.notes: Spelled-out form used in translated international reports, normally with (CBRN) appended. Recorded in research as “化学、生物、放射性和核”.

attestations.quote_zh: 大多数关注点集中在与化学、生物、放射性和核(CBRN)威胁相关的风险、先进的网络能力以及高级的自主行为上(1115、1117)。
attestations.quote_en: Most attention focuses on risks related to chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) threats, advanced cyber capabilities, and advanced autonomous behaviour.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）

usage_examples.zh: 该框架把化生放核威胁列为触发最高级别防护的能力领域之一。
usage_examples.en: The framework lists CBRN threats as one of the capability domains that trigger the highest tier of safeguards.

definition_en: Having a model generate explicit intermediate reasoning steps before its final answer, either by prompting or because it was trained to. The substrate that reasoning models and CoT monitoring both depend on.
definition_zh: 让模型在给出最终答案之前先写出中间推理步骤，可以靠提示引导，也可以靠训练内化。它既是推理模型能力的来源，也是思维链监控这类安全手段的前提。
pitfalls: Settled, but note two things. First, 中文维基百科 renders it 思路链 ("train-of-thought chain") rather than 思维链 — a minority variant a reader may encounter. Second, in practitioner speech 思维链 is often displaced by 思考 / 长思考 / 慢思考 when describing what a reasoning model does internally, and by the bare CoT when used as a modifier (CoT 数据, CoT 长度).

translations.notes: Dominant everywhere: Chinese lab blogs, textbooks, media. 长思维链 = long CoT, 思维链提示 = CoT prompting.

attestations.quote_zh: 在第一阶段，我们使用多样的的长思维链数据对模型进行了微调
attestations.quote_en: In the first stage we fine-tuned the model on diverse long chain-of-thought data.
attestations.source_title: Qwen3: 思深，行速
attestations.publisher: 阿里巴巴通义千问 (Qwen)

attestations.quote_zh: 提示设计、上下文学习、思维链提示、检索增强生成
attestations.quote_en: Prompt design, in-context learning, chain-of-thought prompting, retrieval-augmented generation.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型》课程资源 — 第七课 提示学习（对应本书第十章）
attestations.publisher: 中国人民大学 RUC AI Box（赵鑫等，高等教育出版社）

translations.notes: Used by 中文维基百科's prompt-engineering article. Comprehensible but a minority form; 思维链 is what the field uses. Recommend against.

attestations.quote_zh: 思路链（Chain-of-thought）(CoT) 是文字提示（Textual prompting）的一种技术，该技术通过提示 LLM 生成一系列中间步骤来提高 LLM 的推理能力。
attestations.quote_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) is a textual-prompting technique that improves an LLM's reasoning ability by prompting it to generate a series of intermediate steps.
attestations.source_title: 提示工程（中文维基百科，思维链 重定向）
attestations.publisher: 维基百科

translations.notes: Not a translation of CoT but the framing Chinese sources use for the same phenomenon at model level, borrowed from Kahneman's System 1/System 2. 《大语言模型》pairs it with 复杂推理 in a chapter title. Useful to know because a Chinese reader may meet 慢思考 where English says 'reasoning' or 'extended CoT'. attestations.quote_zh: 规划与智能体、复杂推理与慢思考
attestations.quote_en: Planning and agents; complex reasoning and slow thinking [lecture-8 slide titles]
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型》课程资源（含课件「复杂推理与慢思考」）
attestations.publisher: 中国人民大学 RUC AI Box（赵鑫等，高等教育出版社）

used_by.note: Qwen3 Chinese release blog

used_by.org: 中国人民大学 RUC AI Box
used_by.note: 《大语言模型》course module
