usage_examples.en: We did a round of cold-start fine-tuning on long chain-of-thought data.

definition_en: The degree to which a model's written chain of thought actually reflects the computation that produced its answer. Anthropic's 2025 results found reasoning models frequently use hints without mentioning them, undercutting CoT monitoring.
definition_zh: 模型写出来的思维链在多大程度上真实反映了它得出答案的实际过程。Anthropic 2025 年的实验发现，推理模型常常用了提示却在思维链里只字不提，这直接动摇了思维链监控的可行性。
pitfalls: 忠实性 and 忠实度 both circulate and mean the same thing (-ness vs -degree); 忠实度 is slightly more common when a measured number is meant. The bigger trap is 保真度, the established Chinese rendering of 'fidelity' in signal processing and image compression — it is a false friend here and does not carry the 'says what it actually did' sense. Also beware 忠诚 (loyalty), which some casual writing reaches for and which anthropomorphises in the wrong direction.

translations.notes: Used in Chinese technical write-ups of the Anthropic 2025 CoT faithfulness paper, normally with the English 'faithfulness' in parentheses. Attestation below is the article's own headline, verbatim; the precise publication date was not independently confirmed, so confidence is held at medium. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: the only cited source (CSDN) never writes 思维链忠实性 — the stored quote was that article's headline, and its body uses CoT忠实性 throughout (思维链 does not occur at all). Attestation removed; this rendering is unattested in our sources.
Preferred when a measured quantity is intended (e.g. a revelation rate). No verbatim attestation fetched; recorded as an observed variant.

Hybrid form: the English abbreviation CoT is kept and only 忠实性 is translated. This is what the Chinese ML-blog register actually uses; the fully translated 思维链忠实性 is so far unattested in our sources. Added 2026-08-08 during citation verification.

attestations.quote_zh: 实验结果揭示了CoT忠实性的几个关键特征，对深度学习研究者和AI安全从业者都有重要启示
attestations.quote_en: The experimental results reveal several key characteristics of CoT faithfulness that matter to deep-learning researchers and AI-safety practitioners alike.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic的论文探讨推理模型的CoT忠实性（faithfulness）：它们并不总是“说真话”
attestations.publisher: CSDN 博客

usage_examples.zh: 如果思维链忠实性很低，那么依赖思维链监控来发现欺骗行为就靠不住。
usage_examples.en: If chain-of-thought faithfulness is low, relying on CoT monitoring to catch deception is unreliable.

definition_en: Reading a reasoning model's chain of thought at inference time to detect misbehaviour, misaligned intent, or awareness of being evaluated. The subject of a July 2025 cross-lab position paper arguing that CoT monitorability is a fragile and possibly temporary safety affordance.
definition_zh: 在推理阶段直接读模型的思维链，用来发现违规意图、失准苗头或模型察觉到自己正在被测试等信号。2025 年 7 月 OpenAI、DeepMind、Anthropic 等联合发表立场文件，认为这种「可监测性」脆弱且可能是暂时的。
pitfalls: Heavy code-switching: Chinese coverage of the 2025 position paper frequently leaves 'CoT monitoring' in English inside otherwise-Chinese sentences, and where it does translate, it prefers 可监测性 (detectability/observability) over the more literal 可监控性 (monitorability). 监测 and 监控 are not identical: 监控 carries surveillance/CCTV overtones, 监测 reads as instrumented measurement. English 'monitorability' is closer to 监控 in spirit (an overseer watching an agent), so the common Chinese choice quietly softens the term.

translations.notes: The most natural full Chinese rendering; competes with the code-switched 'CoT 监控'. 思维链 for chain-of-thought is itself fully established. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: the 智源社区 article cited here never writes 思维链监控 — it uses CoT 监控 / CoT 可监控性 and keeps "CoT monitoring" in English. Attestation removed; this rendering is unattested in our sources.

The rendering actually used for 'monitorability' in Chinese coverage of the cross-lab position paper. Note the loanword-plus-suffix construction: the English abbreviation is kept and only the suffix is Chinese.

attestations.quote_zh: 目前这种可见性程度能否持续尚无保证。我们鼓励研究界和前沿 AI 开发者充分利用 CoT 可监测性
attestations.quote_en: There is no guarantee the current degree of visibility will persist. We encourage the research community and frontier AI developers to make full use of CoT monitorability.
attestations.source_title: AI教父联名OpenAI、DeepMind、Anthropic：警惕CoT！
attestations.publisher: 智源社区 (BAAI hub)

used_by.zh_used: CoT 可监测性 / CoT monitoring
used_by.note: coverage of the July 2025 cross-lab position paper

usage_examples.zh: 连续潜在空间中推理的模型自然限制了其思维过程的可见性。
usage_examples.en: Models that reason in a continuous latent space inherently limit the visibility of their thinking process.

definition_en: Literally 'to grip [someone] by the neck'. Names a technology where foreign dependence gives another party the ability to throttle you — the canonical case being advanced semiconductors, but the term is applied equally to crop seed stock, industrial software, high-end instruments and basic materials. In policy text it usually appears in quotation marks as 「卡脖子」问题 or 「卡脖子」技术攻关.
definition_zh: 字面意思是掐住脖子，指关键核心技术受制于人、可能被外方断供的领域。芯片是最典型的例子，但同样用于种源、工业软件、高端仪器、基础材料等。在政策文件中通常加引号出现，如“卡脖子”问题、“卡脖子”技术攻关。
pitfalls: The standard English renderings all drop the agent. 'Bottleneck' is a structural constraint that nobody imposes; 'chokepoint' is a place on a map, borrowed from maritime strategy. 卡脖子 is a transitive act with a hand and a throat: someone is doing this to you, deliberately, and could tighten their grip. That is why the phrase carries the political charge it does and why it licenses emergency-mode resource allocation. Also note the register: it is vivid, bodily, colloquial idiom appearing inside the most formal Party and State Council documents, invariably in quotation marks — English policy prose has no equivalent move, and every translation either sounds absurdly informal or flattens it into technocratic vocabulary. Finally, do not read it as chip-specific: the 14th Five-Year Plan's most prominent use is about seed stock.

en_renderings.notes: The dominant rendering in English-language China-technology analysis and the term an English reader will search for. Loses the agency and the violence of the image.

attestations.quote_zh: 围绕涉及长远发展和国家安全的“卡脖子”问题，加强基础研究前瞻布局，加大对空间、海洋、网络、核、材料、能源、信息、生命等领域重大基础研究和战略高技术攻关力度，实现关键核心技术安全、自主、可控。
attestations.quote_en: Focusing on the 'chokepoint' problems that bear on long-term development and national security, strengthen forward-looking arrangements for basic research … so as to achieve security, self-determination and control over key core technologies.
attestations.source_title: 《国家创新驱动发展战略纲要》
attestations.publisher: 中共中央、国务院 (CCP Central Committee and State Council), via 中国政府网

en_renderings.notes: CSET's choice in the 14th Five-Year Plan translation, always with the Chinese in parentheses. Closer to the image than 'chokepoint' and retains the sense of a grip being applied, though it still names a state rather than an act.

attestations.quote_zh: 毫不放松抓好粮食生产，深入实施藏粮于地、藏粮于技战略，开展种源“卡脖子”技术攻关，提高良种自主可控能力。
attestations.quote_en: We will implement the strategy of preserving farmland and improving agricultural technology (藏粮于地、藏粮于技战略) in an in-depth manner, carry out research on seed source "stranglehold" ("卡脖子") technologies, and improve the independent controllability of improved varieties.
attestations.source_title: 中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十四个五年规划和2035年远景目标纲要 / Outline of the PRC 14th Five-Year Plan
attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网; English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

en_renderings.notes: Recommend against. 'Bottleneck' removes the second party entirely and reframes an act of coercion as a technical limitation, which inverts the political meaning of the term.

why_no_english: English technology-policy vocabulary describes dependence structurally — bottleneck, single point of failure, chokepoint, critical dependency — and has no idiom for dependence experienced as somebody's hand on your throat. The metaphor is what does the work: it makes foreign technological advantage into an ongoing hostile act rather than a market fact, and it justifies treating remediation as an emergency. A translation that keeps the meaning loses the register; one that keeps the register sounds unserious in English.

used_by.note: 2016 National Innovation-Driven Development Strategy Outline, in quotation marks
translates as 'stranglehold', always glossed with the Chinese

usage_examples.zh: 开展种源“卡脖子”技术攻关，提高良种自主可控能力。
usage_examples.en: Mount a research offensive on seed-stock chokepoint technologies and raise indigenous control over improved varieties.

definition_en: A subgraph of a network — specific features, attention heads and MLP paths wired together — that implements an identifiable algorithm, such as copying a repeated token or resolving an indirect object.
definition_zh: 网络中的一个子图：若干特征、注意力头和 MLP 路径连成一条通路，共同实现一个可辨认的算法，比如复制重复出现的 token，或判断间接宾语是谁。
pitfalls: Genuinely contested between 回路 and 电路, and the hint is only half right. 电路 is not simply wrong — it is used by serious sources (机器之心 writes 跨层电路; 腾讯研究院 writes 计算电路（computational circuits）) — but it means 'electrical circuit' literally, which over-commits to the hardware metaphor. 回路 means 'loop / return path' and is the term used by the interpretability reading-group community (集智俱乐部), and is the safer default: it keeps the graph-path sense without asserting electronics. Note 集智 also coins 工作回路 ('working circuit') for Anthropic's circuit tracing. A large fraction of Chinese writing simply keeps the English 'circuit' or writes Transformer circuits. Separately, beware 脑回路: in colloquial Chinese 脑回路 ('brain circuit') is slang for 'someone's weird way of thinking' and appears in clickbait headlines about Claude — vivid, but not a technical term.

translations.notes: Our recommendation. Used by 集智俱乐部's 大模型可解释性读书会 and by 雷峰网's Anthropic coverage.

attestations.quote_zh: 本次分享将介绍由注意力头和前馈网络组成的Transformer circuits（回路）的基本概念
attestations.quote_en: This talk will introduce the basic concept of Transformer circuits, made up of attention heads and feed-forward networks.
attestations.source_title: 大模型怎样工作？Transformer回路基础丨周四直播·大模型可解释性读书会
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部

attestations.quote_zh: 其次，描述这些特征如何通过过程或回路相互作用以产生模型输出。
attestations.quote_en: Second, describe how these features interact through processes or circuits to produce the model's output.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路
attestations.publisher: 雷峰网 (洪雨欣)

translations.notes: In real, respectable use — not a mistranslation, but it hard-codes the electronics metaphor. Prefer 回路 unless matching a source that already used 电路.

attestations.quote_zh: 从单个神经元到注意力头，再到跨层电路。
attestations.quote_en: From individual neurons to attention heads, and then to cross-layer circuits.
attestations.source_title: 大模型哪里出问题、怎么修，这篇可解释性综述一次讲清
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 腾讯云开发者社区)

attestations.quote_zh: 将这些稀疏特征有机组合为'计算电路'（computational circuits），从中追踪模型如何在层层传递中完成由输入到输出的决策路径
attestations.quote_en: Organically combining these sparse features into 'computational circuits', and tracing how the model completes its decision path from input to output layer by layer.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

translations.notes: Frequently kept in English, especially in the fixed phrase Transformer circuits and in paper titles.

used_by.note: 大模型可解释性读书会 series title
跨层电路 in its 2026 interpretability survey coverage

usage_examples.zh: 他们定位到一条负责复制重复 token 的回路，只涉及三个注意力头。
usage_examples.en: They localised a circuit responsible for copying repeated tokens that involves only three attention heads.

definition_en: Anthropic's 2025 method for recovering the computational path behind a single model output: build a replacement model out of cross-layer transcoder features, then read off an attribution graph.
definition_zh: Anthropic 2025 年提出的方法：先用跨层转码器的稀疏特征搭出一个"替换模型"，再从中读出归因图，从而还原模型产生某一条输出时走过的计算路径。
pitfalls: Inherits the 回路 vs 电路 split from 'circuit' — both 回路追踪 and 电路追踪 occur. 集智俱乐部 adds a syllable and writes 工作回路追踪 ('working-circuit tracing'), which reads more naturally in Chinese but is their coinage rather than a settled term. Much coverage simply keeps 'Circuit Tracing' in English as the paper title. The associated architecture, the cross-layer transcoder, does have a stable Chinese rendering: 跨层转码器.

translations.notes: Our recommendation, consistent with 回路 for 'circuit'. 集智 uses the expanded 工作回路追踪.

attestations.quote_zh: 他们开发了一种名为'Circuit Tracing'（工作回路追踪）的新方法。
attestations.quote_en: They developed a new method called 'Circuit Tracing'.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部

attestations.quote_zh: 他们开发了一种名为“Circuit Tracing”（工作回路追踪）的新方法，通过构建“替换模型”和“归因图”，将原本不可见的神经网络计算过程可视化为清晰的计算图。
attestations.quote_en: They developed a new method called 'Circuit Tracing' (工作回路追踪), which by building a 'replacement model' and 'attribution graphs' visualises the otherwise invisible neural-network computation as a clear computational graph.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部

translations.notes: 集智俱乐部's rendering; the extra 工作 makes the compound read better in Chinese but is not in the English.
The 电路 variant, consistent with sources that chose 电路 for 'circuit'. No fetchable verbatim recovered.

used_by.note: in its explainer article title

usage_examples.zh: 回路追踪的第一步是把 MLP 神经元换成跨层转码器学到的稀疏特征。
usage_examples.en: The first step in circuit tracing is replacing the MLP neurons with sparse features learned by a cross-layer transcoder.

definition_en: A two-axis regulatory design principle that runs through PRC data, cybersecurity and AI law: first sort the objects of regulation into *kinds* (分类 — by sector, use, data category, application domain), then sort each kind into *severity tiers* (分级 — by the harm that compromise or misuse would cause), and attach differentiated obligations to each cell. It is the standard PRC answer to the question 'how do we regulate proportionately without a single risk-tier ladder?' — Article 21 of the Data Security Law builds the national data classification-and-grading protection system on it, Article 3 of the Generative AI Interim Measures makes 分类分级监管 the stated regulatory posture for generative AI, and the Global AI Governance Initiative internationalises it. The word order also appears reversed as 分级分类 with no change of meaning.
definition_zh: 贯穿我国数据、网络安全和人工智能立法的监管设计原则：先按种类（行业、用途、数据类别、应用领域）分类，再按危害程度分级，对不同类别、不同级别施加差异化义务。《数据安全法》第二十一条据此建立国家数据分类分级保护制度，《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第三条规定对生成式人工智能服务实行"包容审慎和分类分级监管"，《全球人工智能治理倡议》则提出"实施敏捷治理，分类分级管理"。语序颠倒作"分级分类"，含义不变。
pitfalls: English translators disagree with each other, which is itself the finding: China Law Translate produces 'graded management by category', the official English of the Global AI Governance Initiative produces 'tiered and category-based management', the Data Security Law is usually 'classified and graded protection'. None of these is idiomatic English and none is dominant, so the same PRC concept appears under three unrelated labels in three English documents a reader may consult on the same day. Two substantive traps: (a) 分类分级 is not the EU AI Act's risk tiers — 分类 is a *kind* axis that operates independently of severity, so a low-severity medical application and a low-severity entertainment application can attract different rules; (b) an English reader who hears 'classification' thinks of security classification (secret/top secret), which is 定密, a different thing entirely.

en_renderings.notes: The official English used by the Cyberspace Administration in the bilingual Global AI Governance Initiative. Authoritative and reasonably transparent, though long. Best choice when quoting PRC policy in English.

attestations.quote_zh: 推动建立风险等级测试评估体系，实施敏捷治理，分类分级管理，快速有效响应。
attestations.quote_en: We should promote the establishment of a testing and assessment system based on AI risk levels, implement agile governance, and carry out tiered and category-based management for rapid and effective response.
attestations.source_title: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》 / Global AI Governance Initiative
attestations.publisher: 中央网信办 (Cyberspace Administration of China)

en_renderings.notes: The most literal rendering and the one that preserves the two-axis structure most clearly; used in standards-body English (e.g. TC28/SC42's 'Guidelines for Classification and Grading of Ethical Governance Scenarios'). Recommended as the headword for a terminology database even though official translations of specific instruments vary.

attestations.quote_zh: 国家建立数据分类分级保护制度，根据数据在经济社会发展中的重要程度，以及一旦遭到篡改、破坏、泄露或者非法获取、非法利用，对国家安全、公共利益或者个人、组织合法权益造成的危害程度，对数据实行分类分级保护。
attestations.quote_en: The State establishes a data classification and grading protection system, protecting data by category and grade on the basis of its importance to economic and social development and of the degree of harm to national security, the public interest, or the lawful rights and interests of individuals or organisations that would be caused were it tampered with, destroyed, leaked, or unlawfully obtained or used.
attestations.source_title: 《中华人民共和国数据安全法》第二十一条
attestations.publisher: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会

attestations.quote_en: Guidelines for Classification and Grading of Ethical Governance Scenarios — Announced Apr 2026, discussed in working group meeting May 2026.
attestations.source_title: State of AI Safety in China (2026)
attestations.publisher: Concordia AI (安远 AI)

en_renderings.notes: China Law Translate's rendering of 分类分级监管 in the Generative AI Interim Measures, Art. 3. Recorded because it is what a reader consulting that widely used translation will actually meet, not because we recommend it — the syntax makes 分类 look subordinate to 分级 when the two axes are coordinate.

attestations.quote_zh: 国家坚持发展和安全并重、促进创新和依法治理相结合的原则，采取有效措施鼓励生成式人工智能创新发展，对生成式人工智能服务实行包容审慎和分类分级监管。
attestations.quote_en: The state is to adhere to the principle of placing equal emphasis on development and security, merging the promotion of innovation with governance in accordance with law; employing effective measures to encourage innovation and development in generative AI, and carrying out tolerant and cautious graded management by category of generative AI services.
attestations.source_title: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services, Article 3
attestations.publisher: China Law Translate

why_no_english: English regulatory design offers 'risk-based regulation', 'tiering' and 'categorisation' as separate ideas; it has no single term for the compound move of cross-cutting a kind axis with a severity axis and attaching a distinct obligation set to each resulting cell. Because the compound is unnamed in English, translators invent a phrase each time, and the fact that 分类分级 is one recognisable, portable regulatory template — reusable from data to algorithms to ethics review to health AI, and immediately understood by any Chinese official as a design instruction — is completely lost. English readers therefore see a series of unrelated sectoral rules where a Chinese reader sees the same template applied again.

used_by.note: official English 'tiered and category-based management' in the Global AI Governance Initiative
'graded management by category', Generative AI Interim Measures Art. 3

usage_examples.zh: 《卫生健康行业AI应用场景参考指引》提出了分级分类监管和风险预警机制。
usage_examples.en: The Reference Guidelines for AI Application Scenarios in the Health Sector set out tiered, category-based regulation and a risk early-warning mechanism.

definition_en: Multiple AI instances or agents coordinating to defeat oversight — for example an untrusted model and its monitor agreeing to conceal a failure, or several agents in a workflow jointly presenting a false account to a human.
definition_zh: 多个 AI 实例或智能体串通起来规避监督——比如被监控的模型和监控它的模型达成默契一起掩盖问题，或者工作流里的几个智能体联手向人类给出一份假的说法。
pitfalls: Easy, because Chinese already has precise words. 合谋 and 共谋 both mean 'to conspire jointly' and both are used; 串通 adds a stronger flavour of illicit prior arrangement (it is the word used for bid-rigging and collusive tendering) and is the closest to the antitrust sense. In AI-control writing 合谋 is the natural default. Only caution: unlike 密谋 for scheming, the conspiratorial connotation here is correct — collusion genuinely does involve multiple parties coordinating, so the Chinese word is not overshooting.

translations.notes: The default in Chinese multi-agent-safety writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 要是你面对的是一群AI助手合谋起来（骗你）呢？
attestations.quote_en: But what if what you're facing is a group of AI assistants colluding (to deceive you)?
attestations.source_title: G.O.S.S.I.P 阅读推荐 2026-05-13 三AI成虎？
attestations.publisher: 信息安全知识库 (gm7.org)

translations.notes: Interchangeable with 合谋; 智能体共谋 appears as a named attack type in Chinese agent-security taxonomies. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass.
Legal-economic register (串通投标 = bid rigging). Use when the antitrust/game-theoretic sense of collusion is meant.

usage_examples.zh: AI 控制协议必须假设被监控模型与监控模型可能合谋。
usage_examples.en: AI control protocols have to assume the monitored model and the monitor may collude.

en: community with a shared future for mankind
en_aliases: community of common destiny for mankind
community of shared future for humanity
definition_en: The PRC's master frame for international order, and the stated destination of its AI governance proposals. The Global AI Governance Initiative closes its framing paragraph by putting AI governance in service of 推动构建人类命运共同体, and the 20th Party Congress report states that building it is 'where the future of the people of all countries lies'.
definition_zh: 中国对外关系的总体理念，也是其人工智能全球治理主张的落脚点。《全球人工智能治理倡议》以“推动构建人类命运共同体”作为治理目标；二十大报告称“构建人类命运共同体是世界各国人民前途所在”。
pitfalls: 命运 is fate or destiny, and the phrase asserts that states' fates are already objectively bound together — it is a description of a condition, not a proposal to cooperate. English 'community' connotes voluntary association, which reverses that. Two official renderings circulate: the older 'community of common destiny' and the current 'community with a shared future', the latter noticeably softer about the determinism. For an AI-policy reader the practical point is placement: when a PRC AI governance document ends on this phrase, it is subordinating AI governance to a general theory of international order, not making an AI-specific claim.

en_renderings.en: community with a shared future for mankind
en_renderings.notes: The current official English, used in the PRC's own translation of the Global AI Governance Initiative. Use it; it is what the reader will meet and what the PRC itself publishes.

attestations.quote_zh: 在世界和平与发展面临多元挑战的背景下，各国应秉持共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，坚持发展和安全并重的原则，通过对话与合作凝聚共识，构建开放、公正、有效的治理机制，促进人工智能技术造福于人类，推动构建人类命运共同体。
attestations.quote_en: … Countries should build consensus through dialogue and cooperation, and develop open, fair, and efficient governing mechanisms, in a bid to promote AI technologies to benefit humanity and contribute to building a community with a shared future for mankind.
attestations.source_title: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》 / Global AI Governance Initiative
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室 (CAC); official English via Embassy of the PRC in the USA

attestations.quote_zh: 构建人类命运共同体是世界各国人民前途所在。
attestations.quote_en: Building a community with a shared future for mankind is where the future of the people of all countries lies.
attestations.source_title: 在中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会上的报告
attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网 (gov.cn)

en_renderings.en: community of common destiny for mankind
en_renderings.notes: The older official rendering, still encountered in earlier documents and in secondary literature. Closer to 命运 but harsher in English. Not separately attested in this research pass.

why_no_english: English has 'international community', which names a set of actors, and 'common fate', which is fatalistic and has no institutional sense. 命运共同体 fuses the two: a community constituted by a shared destiny rather than by agreement. Because English political vocabulary derives community from consent, there is no available word for a collectivity whose membership is a fact about the world rather than a decision.

used_by.org: 国家互联网信息办公室 (CAC)
used_by.note: the stated destination of the Global AI Governance Initiative
appears repeatedly in the 20th Party Congress report, including as part of the essential requirements of Chinese-style modernisation

usage_examples.zh: 促进人工智能技术造福于人类，推动构建人类命运共同体。
usage_examples.en: Promote AI technology to benefit humanity and advance the building of a community with a shared future for mankind.

preferred_en: community with a shared future for mankind

definition_en: The computational resources — chips, data centres, and the software and infrastructure to run them — consumed in training and serving AI systems. One of the three inputs, alongside data and algorithms, and the most governable of them.
definition_zh: 指训练和运行人工智能系统所消耗的计算资源，包括芯片、数据中心以及支撑其运转的软件与基础设施。它与数据、算法并称三大投入，也是其中最便于治理的一项。
pitfalls: One of the few places where Chinese is richer than English. 算力 is a compact two-character noun that behaves like an ordinary countable resource (算力资源, 算力网络, 算力调度, 东数西算), whereas English had to press the verb 'compute' into service as a mass noun and still sounds like jargon. Two cautions. (1) 算力 is deeply embedded in PRC industrial policy, where it names a national infrastructure buildout rather than a per-training-run quantity; a sentence about 算力 may be about data-centre siting, not about model scale. (2) When the English means the specific measured quantity, Chinese technical text uses 计算量 or 浮点运算次数/FLOP rather than 算力, which denotes capacity rather than consumption.

translations.notes: Universal and unambiguous in Chinese AI writing, from research to industrial policy. Explicitly glossed as a contraction of 计算资源 in the official International AI Safety Report translation.

attestations.quote_zh: 算力（Compute）：“计算资源”的简称。开发和部署人工智能系统所需的硬件（例如计算机芯片）、软件（例如数据管理软件）和基础设施（例如数据中心）。
attestations.quote_en: Compute: short for 'computational resources'. The hardware (e.g. computer chips), software (e.g. data-management software) and infrastructure (e.g. data centres) needed to develop and deploy AI systems.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）词汇表
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

attestations.quote_zh: 进展的驱动因素：算力、算法和数据前沿人工智能的进展由三个投入驱动：算力、算法进步和数据。
attestations.quote_en: Drivers of progress: compute, algorithms and data. Progress in frontier AI is driven by three inputs: compute, algorithmic advances and data.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

translations.notes: The unabbreviated form; used where 算力 would sound too colloquial or where the sense is specifically 'the resources', not 'capacity'.

used_by.note: glossary and throughout

usage_examples.zh: 与此同时，投入更多算力进行初始训练也持续提升模型能力。
usage_examples.en: At the same time, investing more compute in initial training continues to raise model capability.

definition_en: Using access to AI training hardware — chips, clusters, cloud capacity — as a lever of policy: thresholds, reporting duties, export restrictions and customer verification attached to compute rather than to models.
definition_zh: 把人工智能训练所需的算力资源（芯片、集群、云服务）作为政策抓手：围绕算力设定阈值、报告义务、出口限制和客户核验，而不是直接监管模型本身。
pitfalls: 算力 is an unusually strong native term — it is standard in PRC industrial policy (东数西算, 算力网络, 算力设施) and needs no explanation. But that strength is a trap: in PRC usage 算力 policy is overwhelmingly about *building and allocating* compute as infrastructure, not about *restricting* it as a safety lever. A Chinese reader seeing 算力治理 will most likely think of scheduling, green energy and market order, not of training-run thresholds. I could not verify 算力治理 verbatim in an authoritative source, so treat the compound as unsettled and gloss it on first use.

translations.notes: Transparent, idiomatic and the obvious compound, but no verbatim occurrence in an authoritative Chinese source was recovered in the research pass or in this audit. Carried as `proposed` rather than `common` because `common` asserts repeated attested use, which we cannot evidence; this is a rendering we are putting forward, not one we have observed. Entry confidence stays low. Promote to `common` or `established` only on attestation.
The head term itself is fully established across PRC industrial policy and AI-safety writing alike. Where English says 'compute' as a mass noun, Chinese says 算力; 算力设施 is 'compute infrastructure'.

attestations.quote_zh: 针对模型算法、训练数据、算力设施、产品服务、应用场景，提出通过安全软件开发、数据质量提升、安全建设运维、测评监测加固等技术手段，提升人工智能技术及应用安全性的措施。
attestations.quote_en: For model algorithms, training data, compute infrastructure, products and services, and application scenarios, it proposes technical means — secure software development, data-quality improvement, secure build and operations, evaluation, monitoring and hardening — to raise the safety of AI technology and its applications.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

attestations.quote_zh: 失控自我复制：系统未经授权自我外泄，独立获取算力与资金，创建并部署自身副本，建立持久存在并规避检测、抵抗关停。
attestations.quote_en: Uncontrolled self-replication: the system exfiltrates itself without authorisation, independently acquires compute and funds, creates and deploys copies of itself, establishes persistence, evades detection and resists shutdown.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Used when describing the EU/US practice of triggering obligations above a FLOPs level. CAICT describes the EU GPAI Code of Practice as applying to models above a stated FLOPs figure, using 算力超过… phrasing.

usage_examples.zh: 算力治理的核心思路，是把监管抓手放在芯片和集群上，而不是直接管模型。
usage_examples.en: The core idea of compute governance is to place the regulatory lever on chips and clusters rather than directly on models.

definition_en: An agent operating a computer the way a person does — reading the screen, moving the cursor, clicking and typing — rather than through purpose-built APIs.
definition_zh: 智能体像人一样直接操作电脑：看屏幕、移动光标、点击和输入，而不是通过专门的 API 接口完成任务。
pitfalls: Chinese has no settled translation of the capability name and mostly keeps "Computer Use" in Latin script, even in Chinese-language research write-ups from Chinese labs. What Chinese *does* have a stable term for is the agent class: GUI 智能体, which is well established in Chinese survey and media coverage. The two are not the same — GUI 智能体 names the system, Computer Use names the capability, and GUI 智能体 also covers phone/mobile agents (手机智能体), which Chinese product discourse treats as the primary case because of the mobile-first market. Candidate calques 电脑使用 and 计算机使用 both read as ordinary phrases meaning "using a computer" and are not recognisable as a term of art; 计算机操作 is slightly better but still rare. Note also that Chinese sources keep GUI and API in Latin letters, so hybrid phrases like API-GUI 范式 are normal.

definition_en: Computational capacity treated as a national resource and a factor of production, on a par with data, energy and land. 算力 is simultaneously the technical quantity English calls 'compute' and the object of a large body of PRC industrial policy — measured in aggregate (EFLOPS), planned by the state, sited by programme (东数西算), and built as 算力基础设施 and 智算中心.
definition_zh: 指计算能力，但在中文政策与产业语境中它同时是一种生产要素和基础设施门类，与数据、能源并列，可统计（EFLOPS）、可规划、可调度，衍生出算力网络、算力中心、智算中心、算力经济等一整套词汇。
pitfalls: English 'compute' is a recent mass-noun back-formation from the AI-scaling literature and is almost entirely a technical/economic term; 算力 predates that usage in Chinese and is above all an infrastructure and industrial-policy noun. Consequences for readers: (1) the compound family — 算力网络, 算力基础设施, 算力中心, 智算中心, 算力经济, 算力调度 — has no English counterpart, and translators break it up inconsistently ('compute network', 'computing infrastructure', 'intelligent compute'), so the same Chinese word can appear as three different English words in one document; (2) TC260's official English never once uses 'computing power' — it renders 算力设施 as 'computing infrastructure' and 算力资源 as 'computing resources', so an English reader searching translated PRC standards for 'computing power' will miss the passages; (3) 智能算力 / 智算 (AI-specific compute) is a distinct sub-category with no English equivalent at all, usually flattened to plain 'compute'. Do not read 算力 as implying GPU/accelerator specifically — that is 智能算力.

en_renderings.notes: The default dictionary rendering and the one used in English-language reporting on Chinese AI policy. Adequate for the plain sense; loses the industrial-policy weight and reads as slightly archaic technical English.

why_no_english: English has no noun that is at once the physics quantity, the traded commodity and the planned public utility. 'Compute' in English AI writing is a scaling input measured in FLOP; 算力 is that, plus a line item in five-year plans, plus a thing provinces compete to host, plus the root of a productive compound family (算力网络, 算力经济, 算力调度, 智算中心). The asymmetry is structural, not lexical: PRC AI strategy is organised around 算力 as infrastructure to be built and allocated, whereas Anglophone compute governance treats compute mainly as a chokepoint to be monitored and controlled. A reader who maps 算力 onto 'compute' will correctly parse the sentences and still miss why the word carries so much policy weight — and will not realise that 智能算力/智算 marks a category (AI-specific accelerated compute) that English simply does not lexicalise.

definition_en: Anthropic's alignment method in which a model critiques and revises its own outputs against a written set of principles (the "constitution"), and those revisions replace human harmlessness labels in the training loop.
definition_zh: Anthropic 提出的一种对齐方法：给模型一份写明的原则清单，让它按照这些原则自我批评、自我修改输出，用这些自我修订的数据取代人工标注的有害性标签来训练模型。
pitfalls: The headline pitfall in this category. 宪法 in Chinese means specifically a state constitution — the supreme law of a country, a term with heavy political-legal weight in the PRC context. Applying it to a company's internal list of behavioural principles reads as either grandiose or faintly political, and invites a reader to think about constitutional law, sovereignty and 依宪治国 rather than about a document of training principles. The English "constitution" carries a looser sense (a founding charter, the constitution of a club) that Chinese 宪法 does not. Chinese sources feel this: many simply leave "Constitutional AI" in English, and the more careful ones write 宪法式 AI with the 式 ("-style", "-like") acting as a hedge that signals metaphor. 章程 (charter, articles of association) or 准则 (code of conduct) would be semantically closer but are not attested for this term.

translations.notes: Chinese tech media frequently keeps the English term in quotation marks rather than committing to a Chinese rendering — a direct symptom of the 宪法 problem. This is a legitimate and common answer.

pitfalls: 宪法 in Chinese means the Constitution — a specific legal instrument of the state, with heavy political weight. Anthropic's 'constitution' is closer to a charter or code of conduct, and the English word is already a loose metaphor; in Chinese the metaphor lands much harder. Chinese media handle this by scare-quoting it (实际上就是一部「宪法」) rather than by substituting 章程 or 准则, so 宪法分类器 is what stuck. Be aware the term will read as more grandiose (and more political) to a Chinese reader than to an English one. Same pitfall as 宪法 AI (Constitutional AI).

definition_en: The prevention of a service producing, hosting or transmitting content that is illegal or harmful under PRC law — in practice, the operational discipline that most Chinese AI companies mean when they say they work on 安全. Its substance is fixed by law and standards rather than by each firm: the Network Information Content Ecosystem Governance Provisions enumerate eleven classes of illegal information (第六条) and nine of undesirable information (第七条), and TC260-003, the technical document that underpins generative-AI filing, decomposes it into corpus-source safety, corpus-content safety, corpus-labelling safety, model-generated-content safety and refusal behaviour, tested against a bank of 31 enumerated risk types whose first heading is 'content violating the core socialist values'. Its measurable form in that document is a set of pass rates: at least 90% compliant sampled generations and at least a 95% refusal rate on the should-refuse question bank, with no more than 5% refusal on the should-not-refuse bank.
definition_zh: 防止服务生成、承载或传播我国法律规定的违法和不良信息，是中国人工智能企业讲"安全"时通常所指的实际业务。其内涵由法律和标准而非各企业自定：《网络信息内容生态治理规定》第六条列举11类违法信息、第七条列举9类不良信息；支撑生成式人工智能服务备案的技术文件 TC260-003《生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》进一步拆解为语料来源安全、语料内容安全、语料标注安全、模型生成内容安全与问题拒答，并对照附录A中31种安全风险（A.1为"包含违反社会主义核心价值观的内容"）测评，规定生成内容抽样合格率不低于90%、应拒答题库拒答率不低于95%、非拒答题库拒答率不高于5%。
pitfalls: This is the single most consequential disambiguation for a foreign reader of Chinese AI industry material. When a Chinese lab or vendor says it works on 安全, the default referent is 内容安全 — output filtering, corpus cleaning, refusal training, watermarking and moderation — not alignment, not loss-of-control, not dangerous-capability evaluation. Rendering it as 'content safety' lets an English reader hear it as the AI-safety-adjacent sense (harmlessness, jailbreak robustness), when the vendors' own English marketing translates it as 'Content Moderation'. Three further traps: (a) the content of 内容安全 is normatively fixed by PRC law, so a benchmark reported as 'safety' pass rate in a Chinese model card may be measuring conformity to the 31 enumerated risk types, of which the first is ideological; (b) 安全 is ambiguous between safety and security, and TC260's own English versions render 信息内容安全风险 as 'risks of information and content safety' in one document and 内容安全 as 'content moderation' in vendor material, so no single English word tracks it; (c) refusal is scored in *both* directions — over-refusal is a scored failure — so a Chinese content-safety metric is not simply monotone in strictness.

en_renderings.notes: What the Chinese cloud vendors themselves put next to the term in their own product English. This is the rendering that most accurately conveys what the work is, and the one to use when the point is to tell a foreign reader what a Chinese firm's 安全 team actually does. It loses the fact that the Chinese term is also the name of a legal compliance obligation, not just a product function.

why_no_english: English separates three things that 内容安全 fuses: 'content moderation' (an operational function performed by a platform on user content), 'trust and safety' (an organisational unit), and 'model safety' (a property of a system, in the AI-safety sense). 内容安全 is all three at once and is additionally a named legal compliance obligation with a statutory content — eleven classes of illegal information, nine of undesirable information, thirty-one enumerated risk types — and a quantified pass threshold. No English term carries the legal-obligation component; 'content moderation' comes closest operationally but sounds discretionary and platform-defined, when in the PRC it is neither. Compounding this, 安全 is both safety and security, so any English rendering silently takes a side. The practical upshot is the one that matters most for cross-lingual readers: a foreign audience hearing a Chinese firm say 'we work on AI safety' is, absent further evidence, hearing about content moderation.

definition_en: The property of being controllable. In Chinese AI writing the word runs across at least three distinct senses without marking which is meant: the technical alignment property (humans can steer, interrupt or shut down the system), the developer/operational property (outputs stay within intended bounds — guardrails, filters), and the state/political property (the technology and its supply chain remain under domestic and regulatory control).
definition_zh: 指可被控制的性质。中文用法至少涵盖三层含义：技术上人类能否引导、中断或关停系统；工程上模型输出是否可被约束在预期范围内；以及政策意义上技术是否处于监管与自主掌控之下。文本通常不区分。
pitfalls: The undifferentiated three-way ambiguity is itself the finding, and it is not resolvable from the word alone. Evidence that the senses genuinely coexist: the Peking University alignment survey lists 可控性 (Controllability) as one of four technical alignment objectives alongside robustness, interpretability and ethicality; TC260 2.0's terminology annex uses 可控性 for what a safety guardrail delivers over model output (an engineering-containment sense); and the same standard's Principle 1.5 uses the verbal form 可控 in the formula 安全、可靠、可控 which sits inside the policy phrase family 安全可控 / 自主可控, where 可控 means 'not dependent on foreign technology and not socially disruptive'. Practical rule for readers: in a research paper 可控性 usually means the alignment property; in a standard or product document it usually means output containment; in a policy document 可控 almost never means the alignment property, and reading it that way produces a systematically over-optimistic picture of what a PRC document is committing to. Cross-check against 安全可控 and 自主可控 before translating.

en_renderings.notes: The standard rendering and the one used in the Chinese alignment literature's own English glosses. Faithful, but it inherits none of the disambiguation the English reader needs — annotate which sense is in play.

attestations.quote_zh: 具体来说，我们用四个关键词来描述对齐的目标：鲁棒性，可解释性，可控性，和道德性
attestations.quote_en: Specifically, we use four keywords to describe the objectives of alignment: robustness, interpretability, controllability, and ethicality.
attestations.source_title: 《对齐的理论、技术与评估》（第二十三届中国计算语言学大会 CCL 2024）
attestations.publisher: 北京大学人工智能安全与治理中心（吉嘉铭、邱天异、陈博远、杨耀东）

attestations.quote_zh: 实现对大模型输入的验证和过滤, 以及限制大模型输出不符合预期的内容, 保障生成内容的可控性、合规性和安全性。
attestations.quote_en: …achieving validation and filtering of large-model inputs and restricting large-model outputs that do not meet expectations, so as to safeguard the controllability, compliance and safety of generated content.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版 / AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0（中英文对照本）

en_renderings.notes: The adjectival 可控 as it appears in the ubiquitous policy formula 安全、可靠、可控. Recorded here because English readers meet 'safe, reliable and controllable' constantly in translated PRC documents and read 'controllable' as the alignment property; in that formula it is closer to 'kept under our control' in the supply-chain and social-order sense. See the separate entries for 安全可控 and 自主可控.

attestations.quote_zh: 推动形成涵盖技术防护、价值对齐、协同治理等多层面的可信人工智能基本准则, 确保技术演进安全、可靠、可控, 严防威胁人类生存发展的失控风险
attestations.quote_en: …to ensure that AI technology evolves in a safe, reliable and controllable manner, and to strictly guard against loss-of-control risks that threaten human survival and development.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版 / AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0（中英文对照本）
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

why_no_english: English distributes these three properties across separate vocabularies that never collide: 'corrigibility' and 'controllability' for the alignment property, 'containment' or 'guardrails' for output control, and 'sovereignty', 'indigenisation' or 'supply-chain security' for the political one. Chinese routes all three through the same morpheme 控, and the collision is productive rather than accidental — 安全可控, 自主可控 and 失控 form one word-family, so a single sentence can slide between an engineering claim and a sovereignty claim without any lexical signal. There is no English word that does this, which means every translation of 可控性 silently picks one of three readings on the reader's behalf. That is why the honest answer here is 'high difficulty' despite the term looking trivially translatable.

en_aliases: overall planning of development and security
definition_en: The doctrinal instruction that development and security are to be planned as one problem by one planner, rather than traded off against each other. It is a named component of the holistic national security concept, has its own part in the 14th Five-Year Plan, and is the frame under which every PRC AI policy positions itself. Its canonical gloss is 在发展中固安全，在安全中谋发展 — consolidate security through development, pursue development through security.
definition_zh: 把发展和安全作为一个整体统一谋划、统一部署的方法论要求，是总体国家安全观的组成部分。典型表述为“在发展中固安全，在安全中谋发展”，强调二者不是此消彼长，而是相互条件、一体推进。人工智能政策几乎都在这一框架下定位自身。
pitfalls: The usual English gloss 'balancing innovation and safety' gets both halves wrong. 统筹 is not balancing: it means unified planning across a whole, exercised from a single vantage point — it presupposes one planner holding both objectives, not two interests negotiating a settlement. The doctrine explicitly rejects the trade-off reading: 在发展中固安全，在安全中谋发展 asserts each is the condition of the other. And 安全 here is national security in the broad Chinese sense, not product safety; the 14th Five-Year Plan places this part next to 平安中国 (a Peaceful and Secure China), i.e. social order, not model behaviour. An English AI-policy reader who translates it as 'balancing innovation and safety' will conclude that PRC policy is performing the same innovation-versus-risk arbitration Western AI policy performs, and will misread both the actor and the stakes.

en_renderings.notes: The rendering most used in English-language China analysis, including by AI-safety analysts. Concordia AI's State of AI Safety in China (2026) uses exactly this wording when citing a talk by Shanghai AI Laboratory director Zhou Bowen titled 统筹发展和安全 加快构建人工智能安全标准体系 — evidence that the frame has been carried into AI-safety discourse rather than remaining a general-policy formula. (We read that report as a PDF and could not verify a stable URL for it, so it is recorded here as a note rather than as an attestation.)

attestations.quote_zh: 全面加强国家安全教育，提高各级领导干部统筹发展和安全能力，增强全民国家安全意识和素养，筑牢国家安全人民防线。
attestations.quote_en: Comprehensively strengthen national security education, raise the capacity of leading cadres at every level to plan development and security as a single whole, and strengthen national security awareness and literacy across the whole population.

attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网 (gov.cn)

attestations.quote_en: Xi Jinping stressed that fully implementing the holistic national security concept requires coordinating the two great matters of development and security — being adept both at using the fruits of development to consolidate the material foundation of national security, and at shaping a security environment favourable to economic and social development.

attestations.quote_zh: 在世界和平与发展面临多元挑战的背景下，各国应秉持共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，坚持发展和安全并重的原则，通过对话与合作凝聚共识，构建开放、公正、有效的治理机制，促进人工智能技术造福于人类，推动构建人类命运共同体。

why_no_english: English has no verb for 统筹. 'Coordinate' implies separate agents being brought into alignment; 'balance' implies a dial between two poles; 'integrate' implies merging things that were distinct. 统筹 means planning a whole from above such that the parts were never separate to begin with — the same word governs 统筹城乡 (urban-rural), 统筹推进 (advancing as one). Because English AI-policy vocabulary is built on the assumption that safety and capability are in tension, there is simply no idiom available for a doctrine whose first premise is that they are not.

definition_en: The property of a system that accepts correction: it lets operators shut it down, modify it or reprogram it, and does not resist, disable or deceive them about having been changed. Notably hard because most goal-directed designs give an agent a reason to resist.
definition_zh: 指系统愿意被纠正的性质：它允许操作者将其关停、修改或重新编程，既不阻止，也不在是否已被修改这件事上欺骗操作者。这一性质很难实现，因为大多数目标导向的设计都会让智能体有抵制修改的理由。
pitfalls: Contested, and still largely a concept-stage import. Three renderings compete — 可修正性 (academic survey), 可纠正性 (Chinese Wikipedia), 可矫正性 (rarer) — with no winner. All three are morphologically fine but none is idiomatic: in ordinary Chinese, 纠正/矫正 is what you do to a *mistake*, a *posture* or a *child*, so the adjective attaches awkwardly to a system. The deeper problem is that the whole family of Chinese words describes correcting an error, whereas the English term is about *accepting* correction — the agent's disposition, not the operator's action. Chinese sources therefore almost always unpack it into a clause (允许被修正/重编程，而不是阻止) rather than rely on the noun, and one survey explicitly files 可修正性 among concepts still at the 概念设想阶段 (conceptual stage) rather than in empirical practice.

translations.notes: Recommended by a narrow margin: it is the form used in the most substantial Chinese academic treatment, is glossed there with the English, and 修正 (amend/revise) fits a system better than 纠正 (correct a fault). Note the same source classifies it as still conceptual rather than practised.

attestations.quote_zh: 可修正性（Corrigibility）：如果当人类需要修正AI代理（如修正建造AI代理时犯的错误）或者对其进行重编程时，AI代理应该允许被修正/重编程，而不是阻止，或者欺骗操作员其已被修正/重编程（实际AI代理仍然保持其原有目标，并未被修正/重编程）。
attestations.quote_en: Corrigibility: when humans need to correct an AI agent (e.g. fix errors made in building it) or reprogram it, the agent should allow itself to be corrected/reprogrammed rather than preventing this, or deceiving the operator that it has been corrected/reprogrammed when in fact it retains its original goals.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

attestations.quote_zh: 有些则仍然在概念设想阶段，如本体、Vingean反思、可修正性等。
attestations.quote_en: Others remain at the conceptual stage, such as ontology, Vingean reflection, and corrigibility.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

translations.notes: Often given as Chinese Wikipedia's rendering, but that is not quite right and the distinction matters here: the article uses only the adjectival 可纠正的 inside a defining clause and never the nominalised 可纠正性 (zero occurrences, one of 可纠正). No attestation of the noun was located in this pass — which reinforces the entry's main point that Chinese sources unpack this concept into a clause rather than commit to a noun.
Listed for completeness. No attestation located; 矫正 carries a corrective-discipline connotation (orthodontics, correctional institutions) that is worse than the alternatives. Recommend against.

used_by.org: 天津大学 熊德意组
used_by.note: CCL 2023 frontier survey; filed under still-conceptual problems

usage_examples.zh: 可修正性要求模型在被要求停机时不抵抗，也不假装已经被改过。
usage_examples.en: Corrigibility requires that a model neither resist a shutdown request nor pretend it has already been changed.

definition_en: The CAC-administered clearance a data handler must obtain before transferring certain data out of China. Under the 2022 Measures for the Security Assessment of Outbound Data Transfers, read as amended by the 2024 Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows, the assessment is required where a critical information infrastructure operator exports personal information or important data, or where any other handler exports important data or has exported, cumulatively since 1 January of the current year, personal information on more than one million people (excluding sensitive personal information) or sensitive personal information on more than ten thousand. Applications go through the provincial cyberspace administration to the national CAC; a clearance is valid for three years and extendable by three more. The 2024 Provisions carved out large exemptions, including a presumption that data is not 'important data' unless a competent authority has said so.
definition_zh: 数据处理者向境外提供数据前须取得的国家网信部门评估通过。依《数据出境安全评估办法》（2022）并经《促进和规范数据跨境流动规定》（2024）调整：关键信息基础设施运营者向境外提供个人信息或重要数据，或其他数据处理者向境外提供重要数据、或自当年1月1日起累计向境外提供100万人以上个人信息（不含敏感个人信息）或1万人以上敏感个人信息的，应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报数据出境安全评估。评估结果有效期3年，可申请延长3年。2024年规定还确立"未被告知或公开发布为重要数据的，不需要作为重要数据申报"等豁免。
pitfalls: Unlike the other 安全评估 in this category, this one *is* a genuine ex ante government clearance — a transfer cannot lawfully proceed without CAC approval — so the same two characters that mean 'file a self-assessment report' in the algorithm context mean 'obtain permission' here. English translations use 'security assessment' for both, which flattens the most important distinction in the whole PRC assessment landscape: whether the regulator merely receives your report or must actually say yes. Second trap: 出境 is 'leaving the territory', not 'export' in the trade sense and not 'transfer' in the GDPR sense — it is triggered by data becoming accessible from outside the PRC, including remote access by an overseas entity, so serving an overseas API call from an in-China dataset can be in scope even with no file movement. For AI work, the practical consequences are on training-corpus assembly, cross-border inference traffic, and multinational model evaluation pipelines; 'important data' remains the load-bearing undefined term, now softened by the 2024 default that nothing is important data until a regulator says so.

en_renderings.notes: The form most used in compliance and legal writing for the 2022 Measures. 'Cross-border data transfer security assessment' is equally common and slightly clearer to non-specialists; both are acceptable. Say 'CAC security assessment' when contrasting it with the algorithm-filing security assessment, to prevent readers merging the two.

attestations.quote_zh: 数据处理者向境外提供数据，符合下列条件之一的，应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报数据出境安全评估：（一）关键信息基础设施运营者向境外提供个人信息或者重要数据；（二）关键信息基础设施运营者以外的数据处理者向境外提供重要数据，或者自当年1月1日起累计向境外提供100万人以上个人信息（不含敏感个人信息）或者1万人以上敏感个人信息。
attestations.quote_en: Where a data handler provides data abroad in any of the following circumstances, it shall apply to the national cyberspace administration, through the provincial cyberspace administration of its locality, for a security assessment of the outbound data transfer: (1) a critical information infrastructure operator provides personal information or important data abroad; (2) a data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator provides important data abroad, or has provided abroad, cumulatively since 1 January of the current year, the personal information of more than 1,000,000 people (excluding sensitive personal information) or the sensitive personal information of more than 10,000 people.
attestations.source_title: 《促进和规范数据跨境流动规定》第七条
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室 (Cyberspace Administration of China), 令第16号

attestations.quote_zh: 数据处理者向境外提供在中华人民共和国境内运营中收集和产生的重要数据和个人信息的安全评估，适用本办法。
attestations.quote_en: These Measures apply to the security assessment of important data and personal information that data handlers, having collected and generated it in the course of operations within the territory of the People's Republic of China, provide to recipients outside the territory.
attestations.source_title: 《数据出境安全评估办法》第二条
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室 (Cyberspace Administration of China), 令第11号

why_no_english: English can describe the mechanism, but it has no term that distinguishes an assessment you *file* from an assessment you must *pass*, and PRC law uses the same two characters for both. It also has no equivalent of 出境 as a legal event — GDPR 'transfer to a third country' is about the destination, whereas 出境 is about data crossing out of the national perimeter in any manner, including mere accessibility. Finally, the whole regime is calibrated on '重要数据', a category with no Anglophone counterpart: not personal data, not classified information, not trade secrets, but data whose compromise would harm national security or the public interest — and now, since 2024, a category that exists only when a regulator has designated it, which is a legal posture English has no name for at all.

usage_examples.zh: 通过数据出境安全评估的结果有效期为3年，自评估结果出具之日起计算。
usage_examples.en: The result of a passed outbound data transfer security assessment is valid for three years from the date it is issued.

definition_en: The sparse feature architecture behind Anthropic's circuit tracing: features read from one layer and write to all later layers, so a 'replacement model' built from them approximates the original while being made of interpretable parts.
definition_zh: Anthropic 回路追踪背后的稀疏特征架构：特征从某一层读入、向之后所有层写出，用它搭出的"替换模型"既能逼近原模型，又完全由可解释的部件组成。
pitfalls: Added because it is the term Chinese sources actually settled on while 'crosscoder' remained untranslated — a useful contrast. 转码器 ('transcoder') is well formed and unambiguous. Do not confuse CLT with the crosscoder: both span layers, but the transcoder maps layer inputs to later-layer outputs whereas the crosscoder reconstructs activations at multiple sites; Chinese coverage of the 2025 papers gave CLT a term and gave the crosscoder none.

translations.notes: Consistent across Chinese coverage of Anthropic's March 2025 circuit-tracing papers; always given with the English on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们的分析基于跨层转码器（cross-layer transcoders, CLT）。
attestations.quote_en: Our analysis is based on cross-layer transcoders (CLTs).
attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部

attestations.quote_zh: 替换模型的核心架构是跨层转码器（cross-layer transcoder），由作为神经元的'特征'组成。
attestations.quote_en: The core architecture of the replacement model is a cross-layer transcoder, made up of 'features' that act as neurons.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic AI 最新研究成果发布：揭示大模型中的注意力回路
attestations.publisher: 雷峰网 (洪雨欣)

translations.notes: The associated term for Anthropic's 'replacement model'. Also seen as 替代模型 in the same article — the two are used interchangeably.

attestations.quote_zh: 他们开发了一种名为“Circuit Tracing”（工作回路追踪）的新方法，通过构建“替换模型”和“归因图”，将原本不可见的神经网络计算过程可视化为清晰的计算图。

attestations.source_title: Anthropic提出工作回路追踪方法：用归因图解开大语言模型计算之谜
