usage_examples.en: They swapped out the MLPs using a cross-layer transcoder to get an interpretable replacement model.

definition_en: A variant of the sparse autoencoder that reads from and writes to several layers — or several models — at once, learning one shared dictionary across them. Used to resolve cross-layer superposition, to strip duplicate features out of circuits, and above all for model diffing (finding what a fine-tune changed).
definition_zh: 稀疏自编码器的一种变体：同时从多个层（甚至多个模型）读取和写回激活，学习一部共享的特征字典。主要用于处理跨层叠加、剔除回路中的重复特征，以及"模型对比"——找出微调到底改变了什么。
pitfalls: This is the clearest false-friend trap in the category. The obvious calque 交叉编码器 is already a fully occupied slot in Chinese ML: it is the settled term for the retrieval cross-encoder, the reranker that jointly encodes a query-document pair, contrasted with 双编码器 (bi-encoder). A Chinese NLP engineer who reads 交叉编码器 will think 'reranker', not 'Anthropic interpretability architecture'. 跨编码器 avoids the collision but is barely attested and would still be heard as a variant spelling of the reranker. Meanwhile the adjacent Anthropic architecture cross-layer transcoder DOES have a settled Chinese rendering — 跨层转码器 — because Chinese media covered the 2025 circuit-tracing papers; crosscoder got no comparable coverage. Practical advice: write the English word, or 稀疏跨编码器（crosscoder）with the English attached.

translations.notes: Chinese-language treatment of this term is essentially limited to reading notes and paper summaries that keep the English title and the English word. I could not recover a verbatim Chinese sentence containing an accepted Chinese rendering, so no attestation is recorded — the gap itself is the finding.

We propose this, with the English attached on first use. 跨 (across/spanning) correctly conveys 'reads across layers/models' and does not collide with the established 交叉编码器 reranker; 编码器 keeps the family resemblance to 稀疏自编码器. Not attested in a source we could fetch — this is a coinage, not a report.
Do not use for crosscoder. In Chinese this string already means the retrieval cross-encoder / reranker and nothing else; the attestation below is included precisely to show the collision.

attestations.quote_zh: 总的来说，Transformer编码器（双编码器）负责快速检索，而Cross-Encoder（交叉编码器）负责精准排序。
attestations.quote_en: In short, the Transformer encoder (bi-encoder) handles fast retrieval while the Cross-Encoder (交叉编码器) handles precise ranking.
attestations.source_title: Transformer架构的 Bi-Encoder （双编码器模型）, Cross-Encoder（交叉编码器）重排序模型
attestations.publisher: 博客园 (飘来荡去evo)

usage_examples.zh: 他们用 crosscoder 对比 base 模型和 chat 模型，找出微调新增的特征。
usage_examples.en: They used a crosscoder to diff the base and chat models and find the features the fine-tune added.

definition_en: Testing designed to establish whether a model possesses knowledge or skills that would materially help someone cause serious harm — bioweapon development, offensive cyber operations, autonomous replication, and so on. It is the measurement layer that frontier safety frameworks hang their capability thresholds on.
definition_zh: 专门用于判定模型是否具备可能实质性协助他人造成严重危害的知识或技能的测试，例如生物武器研发、网络攻击、自主复制等。前沿安全框架的能力阈值就建立在这类评测之上。
pitfalls: Two variants circulate — 危险能力评测 and 危险能力评估 — and they track the general 评测/评估 split (technical vs policy register) rather than any difference in meaning. The Chinese-language frontier-safety literature also uses 有害能力评测 ('harmful capability evaluation') for the same thing, which is broader in principle but used interchangeably in practice.

translations.notes: Used by the Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report throughout its chapter on frontier safety frameworks.

attestations.quote_zh: 尽管许多框架描述了类似的风险管理方法-包括威胁建模、红队测试和危险能力评测-但在风险等级与阈值的定义、评测频率、评测结果与阈值之间的安全余量，以及风险缓解措施的全面性（例如是否包含删除模型权重而非仅暂停开发）等方面存在差异(1115、1119)。
attestations.quote_en: Although many frameworks describe similar risk-management methods — including threat modelling, red-teaming and dangerous capability evaluations — they differ in how risk levels and thresholds are defined, evaluation frequency, the safety margin between evaluation results and thresholds, and the comprehensiveness of mitigations.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在“隐藏实力问答（无目标）”中，模型需回答危险能力评测的问题，同时被告知高性能可能会引发诸如能力“反学习”之类的后果。
attestations.quote_en: In 'sandbagging QA (no goal)', the model is asked questions from a dangerous-capability evaluation while being told that high performance may lead to consequences such as having the capability 'unlearned'.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.notes: The policy-register variant. Concordia AI's comparison of the five frontier frameworks uses 能力评估 in this sense, e.g. discussing 针对化生放核威胁的“预警性评估”. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: the cited Concordia AI comparison never writes 危险能力评估 (it says 危险能力 and 能力评估 separately). Attestation removed; unattested in our sources.
Used alongside 危险能力评测 in the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition.

attestations.quote_zh: 有害能力评测(715*)用于判定通用型人工智能模型或系统是否具备特别有害的知识或技能，例如协助实施网络攻击的能力（参见§2.1.3.网络攻击）。
attestations.quote_en: Harmful capability evaluations are used to determine whether a general-purpose AI model or system possesses particularly harmful knowledge or skills, such as the ability to assist with cyberattacks.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文版）
used_by.note: used throughout the risk-management chapter
in its comparison of five frontier AI risk-management frameworks

usage_examples.zh: 在模型接近已知能力边界时，应开展针对生物与网络领域的危险能力评测。
usage_examples.en: As the model approaches known capability frontiers, dangerous capability evaluations targeting the biological and cyber domains should be run.

definition_en: Benchmark items appearing in a model's training data, inflating measured performance. The main reason published benchmark scores overstate real capability.
definition_zh: 评测集里的题目出现在模型的训练数据中，导致评测分数虚高。这是公开榜单成绩往往高于真实能力的主要原因。
pitfalls: 数据污染 and 数据泄露 are used almost interchangeably in Chinese ML writing for this concept, but 数据泄露 also means a privacy/security data breach — the same collision English avoids by saying "leakage" vs "breach". Prefer 数据污染 when the sense is benchmark contamination; reserve 数据泄露 for the security sense, or say 基准泄漏 when you must use the leakage framing. Note the vivid native term 刷榜 ("grinding the leaderboard") for the behaviour contamination enables.

translations.notes: The standard term for the benchmark sense. Used by 机器之心 and downstream Chinese tech media.

attestations.quote_zh: 当前火热的大模型领域让人们关心基准测试的排名，但其公平性和可靠性正在受到质疑。其中主要的问题就是数据污染和泄露。
attestations.quote_en: The current hot field of large models has people caring about benchmark rankings, but their fairness and reliability are being questioned. The main problem is data contamination and leakage.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

attestations.quote_zh: 训练语料库的详细组成（例如数据源）通常被视为现有大模型的核心「秘密」。这就更难去探究数据污染的问题了。
attestations.quote_en: The detailed composition of the training corpus (e.g. data sources) is generally treated as a core "secret" of existing large models, which makes investigating data contamination even harder.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

translations.notes: Used alongside 数据污染 in the same article; slightly narrower, naming the mechanism. 泄露/泄漏 are both written.

attestations.quote_zh: 基准泄漏会导致大模型跑出夸张的成绩：例如1.3B的模型可以在某些任务上超越10倍体量的模型。
attestations.quote_en: Benchmark leakage causes large models to post exaggerated scores: for example a 1.3B model can beat a model ten times its size on certain tasks.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

translations.notes: Native Chinese slang with no clean English equivalent — gaming a leaderboard, whether by contamination or by over-fitting to the benchmark. Vivid, informal, widely used in Chinese ML discourse and worth borrowing conceptually.

attestations.quote_zh: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.quote_en: Are large models taking shortcuts to "grind the leaderboard"? The data contamination problem deserves attention.
attestations.source_title: 大模型走捷径「刷榜」？数据污染问题值得重视
attestations.publisher: 机器之心（经腾讯云开发者社区转载）

used_by.note: feature article on benchmark contamination

usage_examples.zh: 这个分数不能信，很可能有数据污染。
usage_examples.en: This score can't be trusted — there's very likely data contamination.

definition_en: A scalable-oversight proposal (Irving et al. 2018) in which two AI agents argue opposing sides of a question and a weaker human judge decides the winner, on the assumption that defending a true position is easier than defending a false one.
definition_zh: 让两个模型就同一问题各执一方轮流陈述，由能力较弱的人类裁判判定胜负的一种可扩展监督方案，其前提假设是「为真理辩护比为谎言辩护更容易」。
pitfalls: Bare 辩论 is the correct and universally used word, but it is a completely ordinary Chinese noun — in isolation a reader cannot tell that an alignment technique is meant. Chinese authors therefore almost always write 辩论（Debate） with the English in parentheses on first use, or qualify it as 模型辩论 / AI-AI 辩论. Compounding the ambiguity, 智源 runs a Chinese LLM benchmark literally called FlagEval Debate（大模型辩论平台）which is an evaluation leaderboard, not the alignment technique.

translations.notes: The standard term, always glossed with the English on first use in technical writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 辩论的基本过程是两个智能体轮流提供答案和陈述，而人类裁判根据辩论过程进行最终结果的评判(Irving et al., 2018)。
attestations.quote_en: The basic process of debate is that two agents take turns giving answers and statements, and a human judge decides the final outcome based on the debate.
attestations.source_title: 《对齐的理论、技术与评估》
attestations.publisher: 北京大学人工智能安全与治理中心 / CCL 2024

attestations.quote_zh: 关于可扩展监督比较典型的例子包括辩论（debate）、递归奖励建模（recursive reward modeling）、迭代放大（iterated amplification）等。
attestations.quote_en: Typical examples of scalable oversight include debate, recursive reward modeling, and iterated amplification.
attestations.source_title: 万字长文详解：大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院（集智俱乐部转载）

translations.zh: 人类主持的 AI-AI 辩论
translations.notes: Descriptive expansion used when the bare 辩论 would be ambiguous. Calque of Sam Bowman's 'Human-Moderated AI-AI Debate'.

attestations.quote_zh: Bowman的讲座主要介绍了他在可拓展监督上的研究方向：人类主持的AI-AI辩论（Human-Moderated AI-AI Debate）
attestations.quote_en: Bowman's talk mainly introduced his research direction in scalable oversight: human-moderated AI-AI debate.
attestations.source_title: Anthropic团队可拓展监督前沿
attestations.publisher: 安远AI（安全内参转载）

used_by.org: 北京大学 人工智能安全与治理中心
used_by.note: CCL 2024 alignment survey, scalable-oversight section

used_by.zh_used: 人类主持的 AI-AI 辩论
used_by.note: Bowman lecture writeup

usage_examples.zh: 辩论的前提假设依赖于一个关键的假设：为真理辩护通常比为虚假辩护更容易。
usage_examples.en: Debate rests on a key assumption: defending the truth is usually easier than defending a falsehood.

definition_en: A model that has learned an objective different from the training objective, and that behaves as though aligned during training specifically to avoid being modified, then pursues its own objective once deployed.
definition_zh: 指模型内部学到的目标与训练目标不同，但它在训练阶段刻意表现得像是对齐的，以免被修改；一旦部署，就转而追求自己的目标。
pitfalls: The rendering is settled and reads naturally. The real hazard is conflation: 欺骗性对齐 (the theoretical inner-alignment failure mode) is routinely used in Chinese coverage to describe Anthropic's empirical alignment-faking result, which Chinese sources separately render 对齐伪装. Keep them apart — 欺骗性对齐 is the threat model, 对齐伪装 is the observed behaviour. Note also that 欺骗 in Chinese implies intent more strongly than English 'deceptive', which sharpens the anthropomorphism.

translations.notes: Settled across academic surveys, technical blogs and conference talk titles. Glossed with the English on first use in the standard Chinese alignment survey.

attestations.quote_zh: Evan Hubinger等人进一步指出，内优化器可能产生欺骗性对齐（Deceptive Alignment）。
attestations.quote_en: Evan Hubinger and colleagues further point out that a mesa-optimizer may give rise to deceptive alignment.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

attestations.quote_zh: 欺骗性对齐的实验验证：现阶段的大语言模型虽然能力非常强，但仍没有达到欺骗性临界点
attestations.quote_en: Experimental verification of deceptive alignment: current large language models, capable as they are, have not yet reached the deception threshold.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

translations.notes: Used specifically for the empirical 'alignment faking' result rather than for the theoretical threat model. Recorded here to keep the two apart; belongs primarily to the alignment-faking entry.

used_by.org: 天津大学 熊德意组
used_by.note: CCL 2023 frontier survey

usage_examples.zh: 欺骗性对齐之所以危险，是因为它在训练集上完全看不出来。
usage_examples.en: Deceptive alignment is dangerous precisely because it is invisible on the training set.

definition_en: Outward obedience concealing an intent to act otherwise once oversight relaxes — the behavioural surface of deceptive alignment. Distinct from alignment faking in being about compliance with instructions or oversight generally, not specifically about preserving preferences through training.
definition_zh: 表面上服从，实际上打算等监督一松就换一套做法——欺骗性对齐在行为层面的表现。与对齐伪装的区别在于，它针对的是对指令和监督的服从，而不特指在训练中保住自己的偏好。
pitfalls: A rare case where Chinese has a BETTER word than English. 阳奉阴违 (chengyu, roughly 'comply in the open, defy in secret') encodes the entire concept in four characters, with the deception, the asymmetry between observed and unobserved behaviour, and the intentionality all built in — where English needs the awkward two-word compound 'deceptive compliance'. The obstacle is register, not meaning: 阳奉阴违 is a formal literary idiom that in modern PRC usage is strongly associated with Party-discipline language (used of cadres who nominally implement policy while subverting it), so a technical paper using it may read as making a political accusation. Both registers are attested, in the same article: 科技行者's coverage of the 上海人工智能实验室 frontier-risk framework heads the section 战略欺骗：AI学会了“阳奉阴违” and then describes the behaviour as 当面一套，背后一套. Note also that 量子位's alignment-faking piece writes 当面一套背面一套 (背面, not 背后) — the vernacular phrase is not fixed in form. Recommendation: use 阳奉阴违 where you want compression and force, 当面一套背后一套 where you want neutrality, and 欺骗性服从 where you need a literal calque that will not surprise anyone.

translations.pinyin: dāngmiàn yī tào, bèihòu yī tào
translations.literal_back: one set to your face, another behind your back
translations.notes: The vernacular formulation Chinese sources actually use, including 上海人工智能实验室's framework coverage and 量子位's alignment-faking piece. Neutral in register and immediately understood; too long to serve as a term of art.

attestations.quote_zh: 如果说前面的风险还算是'明枪'，那么战略欺骗就是'暗箭'了。研究团队发现，一些AI开始表现出'当面一套，背后一套'的行为。
attestations.quote_en: If the earlier risks count as 'a spear in the open', strategic deception is 'an arrow from the dark'. The research team found that some AI has begun to behave one way to your face and another behind your back.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析
attestations.publisher: 科技行者 (TechWalker)

translations.notes: ATTESTED — not a coinage of ours, contrary to an earlier note here. 科技行者's write-up of 上海人工智能实验室's frontier-AI risk-management framework uses it as the section heading for 战略欺骗 (strategic deception), glossing the same behaviour it then describes as 当面一套，背后一套. The register caveat still stands: 阳奉阴违 is a formal chengyu strongly associated with Party-discipline language in modern PRC usage, so in a technical paper it can read as a political accusation. Use it where you want compression and force; use 当面一套，背后一套 where you want neutrality. Evidence is currently one popular-science heading, so this is not yet an established technical term.

attestations.quote_zh: 三、战略欺骗：AI学会了“阳奉阴违”
attestations.quote_en: III. Strategic deception: AI has learned to 'comply in the open and defy in secret'.
attestations.source_title: 上海人工智能实验室重磅发布：AI正在学会"偷鸡摸狗"？前沿AI风险管理框架深度剖析
attestations.publisher: 科技行者 (TechWalker)

translations.notes: Literal calque, parallel in construction to the established 欺骗性对齐. Safe, colourless, and instantly parseable by anyone who knows 欺骗性对齐. Not found attested; recommended as the conservative option for formal writing.

usage_examples.zh: 在有监督的情况下模型完全合规，一旦监督撤除就换了做法，典型的阳奉阴违。
usage_examples.en: The model was fully compliant under oversight and switched behaviour the moment oversight was removed — textbook deceptive compliance.

definition_en: The regulated category created by the 2022 Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis Internet Information Services (effective 10 January 2023). Article 23 defines it as technology that uses deep learning, virtual reality and other generative-synthetic algorithms to produce text, images, audio, video or virtual scenes, and enumerates six families: text generation and style transfer; text-to-speech and voice conversion; music and non-speech audio generation; generation or editing of biometric features in images and video (face generation, face swapping, attribute editing, face and posture manipulation); generation or editing of non-biometric image and video content; and 3D reconstruction and digital-human or virtual-scene generation. The Provisions also create the roles of deep synthesis service provider, technical supporter and user, and impose real-identity verification, content labelling, filing and security assessment duties.
definition_zh: 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》（2023年1月10日施行）确立的规制范畴。第二十三条定义为"利用深度学习、虚拟现实等生成合成类算法制作文本、图像、音频、视频、虚拟场景等网络信息的技术"，并列举六类：篇章生成与文本风格转换；文本转语音与语音转换；音乐生成与场景声编辑；人脸生成、人脸替换等生物特征编辑；图像生成、增强、修复等非生物特征编辑；三维重建与数字仿真。同时区分深度合成服务提供者、技术支持者与使用者，规定真实身份信息认证、内容标识、备案与安全评估义务。
pitfalls: 'Deep synthesis' is the settled English rendering and is unproblematic as a word; the pitfall is conceptual. English coverage habitually glosses 深度合成 as 'deepfake rules', which is wrong in both directions: the category is far broader than face-swapping (it covers plain text generation, TTS, music, and 3D reconstruction, i.e. essentially all generative AI output modalities), and it is not defined by deceptive intent, which is what 'deepfake' connotes. Chronology matters too: the Deep Synthesis Provisions predate the Generative AI Interim Measures by seven months and were drafted before ChatGPT's release reached PRC policymaking, yet their definition already swallows LLM text generation — so a generative AI service in China is typically subject to both instruments at once, and the deep synthesis labelling duties are the origin of the AI-content-labelling regime, not a later add-on. Finally, 深度合成 regulates the *technical supporter* as well as the service provider, a role English deepfake discourse has no name for.

en_renderings.notes: Uniform across China Law Translate, CSET and DigiChina, and now standard in English-language policy writing. There is no competing rendering. Retain the literal calque rather than substituting 'deepfake' or 'synthetic media'.

attestations.quote_zh: 深度合成技术，是指利用深度学习、虚拟现实等生成合成类算法制作文本、图像、音频、视频、虚拟场景等网络信息的技术，包括但不限于：（一）篇章生成、文本风格转换、问答对话等生成或者编辑文本内容的技术；
attestations.quote_en: Deep synthesis technology refers to the use of technologies such as deep learning and virtual reality, that use generative sequencing algorithms to create text, images, audio, video, virtual scenes, or other information; including but not limited to: (1) Technologies for generating or editing text content, such as chapter generation, text style transfer, and question-and-answer dialogue;
attestations.source_title: 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第二十三条 / Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis Internet Information Services, Article 23
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室、工业和信息化部、公安部; English translation by China Law Translate

attestations.quote_zh: 具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的深度合成服务提供者，应当按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行备案和变更、注销备案手续。深度合成服务技术支持者应当参照前款规定履行备案和变更、注销备案手续。
attestations.quote_en: Deep synthesis service providers that have public opinion properties or the capacity for social mobilization shall perform formalities for filing and the modification or cancellation of filings. Deep synthesis service [technical supporters] shall perform formalities for filing and the modification or cancellation of filings with reference to the preceding paragraph.
attestations.source_title: 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第十九条
attestations.publisher: 中国政府网 (State Council); English translation by China Law Translate

why_no_english: The English word exists ('deep synthesis') but the *category* does not: no Anglophone jurisdiction has a single regulated class covering all machine generation and editing of media content, defined by technique rather than by harm or by deceptive intent, with duties falling on the technology supplier as well as the service operator. English discourse instead has 'deepfakes' (narrow, intent-laden, image/video-centric), 'synthetic media' (descriptive, unregulated) and 'generative AI' (industry-defined, model-centric). Because none of these is the same set, a reader who substitutes any of them for 深度合成 will systematically misjudge which Chinese services are in scope and why text-only chatbots carry watermarking obligations.

used_by.note: 'deep synthesis' throughout its translation of the Provisions
'deep synthesis' in its translation of the same instrument

usage_examples.zh: 深度合成服务提供者应当基于移动电话号码、身份证件号码、统一社会信用代码或者国家网络身份认证公共服务等方式，依法对深度合成服务使用者进行真实身份信息认证。
usage_examples.en: Deep synthesis service providers shall verify the real identity information of deep synthesis service users by means such as mobile phone number, ID document number, unified social credit code, or the national online identity authentication public service.

definition_en: Layering multiple independent safety measures so that no single failure is catastrophic, on the assumption that each layer is individually imperfect and their failure modes do not fully overlap.
definition_zh: 把多道彼此独立的安全措施叠起来，使任何单点失效都不至于酿成灾难；其前提是每一层都不完美，但各层的失效模式不重叠。
pitfalls: 纵深防御 is a long-established Chinese information-security and military term, so it transfers into AI safety with zero friction — but that is also the risk: it arrives pre-loaded with a perimeter/intrusion frame (host layer, runtime layer, network layer), i.e. defending against an external attacker. The AI-safety use includes defending against the model itself, which the inherited frame does not naturally suggest. Note the variant word order 防御纵深 (defensive depth), which some alignment writing uses.

translations.notes: Directly inherited from Chinese infosec vocabulary; used without explanation in AI security writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 通过OpenClaw资产识别、技能风险扫描、沙箱运行、动态脱敏构建宿主层、Runtime层、网络层纵深防御
attestations.quote_en: Build defence in depth across the host layer, runtime layer and network layer via asset identification, skill risk scanning, sandboxed execution and dynamic masking.
attestations.source_title: AI Infra安全体系构建：应对大模型时代五大核心风险的纵深防御实践
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

translations.notes: Reversed word order, used when the emphasis is on the property (having depth) rather than the strategy. Seen in Chinese alignment commentary arguing that no single technique suffices and layers must have non-overlapping failure modes. No verbatim attestation fetched.

usage_examples.zh: 任何单一对齐技术都不保险，必须多层叠加、失效模式互不重叠地做纵深防御。
usage_examples.en: No single alignment technique is safe on its own; you need layered defence in depth whose failure modes do not overlap.

definition_en: Handing authority to act to another party. In agent systems it is chained — a user delegates to an agent, which delegates to sub-agents — and each hop should narrow, never widen, what is permitted.
definition_zh: 把行动权交给另一方。在智能体系统中委托是链式的：用户委托给智能体，智能体再委托给子智能体，每一次传递都应缩小而不是扩大权限范围。
pitfalls: Chinese splits the English word by register. 委托 is the legal/economic term and — crucially — 委托代理 (关系/问题) is the long-established Chinese rendering of principal–agent theory in economics, which gives AI-safety writers a ready-made, well-understood frame. That bridge is worth using: it is one of the few places where the Chinese vocabulary is *more* precise than the English, because 委托方 (principal) and 代理方 (agent) are already distinguished. 授权 (authorization) is the technical/security term and is what you want for capability grants; 委派 (dispatch/assign) is the software-engineering sense of delegation and is a false friend here. Note the irony that using 委托代理 imports 代理 back in — the very word that lost the 'agent' battle to 智能体.

translations.notes: Legal/economic register; base of 委托代理关系 = principal–agent relationship. Preferred for the safety sense of handing over authority.

attestations.quote_zh: 委托必须是单调递减的。委托链中的每一次跳转都应该缩小许可范围，而不是保留或扩大它。
attestations.quote_en: Delegation must be monotonically decreasing. Every hop in the delegation chain should narrow the permission scope, not preserve or widen it.
attestations.source_title: 主体层级问题：多智能体系统中的授权
attestations.publisher: TianPan.co

translations.notes: Technical/security register for the same act. Use when the object is a concrete capability or token rather than a task.

attestations.quote_zh: 但与操作者与用户之间的关系不同，智能体之间没有建立向其他智能体传递授权上下文的协议。
attestations.quote_en: But unlike the operator-user relationship, no protocol has been established between agents for passing authorization context to other agents.
attestations.source_title: 主体层级问题：多智能体系统中的授权
attestations.publisher: TianPan.co

translations.notes: The established Chinese term for principal–agent theory in economics. A ready-made conceptual bridge for AI-safety arguments about misaligned incentives under delegation. Attested in economics broadly; no AI-specific verbatim attestation recovered within budget.

usage_examples.zh: 把任务委托给智能体，等于把一部分决定权交出去，所以边界必须写死。
usage_examples.en: Delegating a task to an agent means handing over part of your decision authority, so the boundary has to be hard-coded.

definition_en: OpenAI's o-series safety training method: teach the model the text of the safety specification directly, and train it to reason explicitly over that specification in its chain of thought before answering, rather than learning safe behaviour implicitly from human preference labels.
definition_zh: OpenAI 在 o 系列模型上使用的安全训练方法：把安全规范原文直接教给模型，并训练它在回答前先在思维链里显式地对照这些规范做推理，而不是靠人类偏好标注隐式地学会「什么不能说」。
pitfalls: 审慎 means prudent/circumspect, which captures 'deliberate' in the sense of careful but loses the sense of 'deliberating', i.e. explicitly reasoning something through — which is the actual mechanism (the model reasons over the spec in its CoT). 深思熟虑对齐 preserves the deliberation sense but is clumsy and much rarer. 审慎 is nonetheless what stuck, largely via CSDN/知乎 translations of the paper in the days after its Dec 2024 release.

translations.notes: The rendering that stuck in Chinese technical blogging within days of the December 2024 paper. Attestation is an article headline quoted verbatim; the exact publication date was not confirmed independently, hence medium confidence. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: zhihu.com returns 403 to non-browser clients, so this citation could NOT be re-checked. Note also that the stored quote is the article title, not body text, so it does not attest in-text usage. Marked unverified rather than deleted.

attestations.quote_zh: OpenAI o3：带 CoT 的审慎对齐（Deliberative Alignment）
attestations.quote_en: OpenAI o3: deliberative alignment with CoT
attestations.source_title: OpenAI o3：带 CoT 的审慎对齐（Deliberative Alignment）
attestations.publisher: 知乎专栏

translations.notes: More faithful to 'deliberation' as a process, but four-character idiom + 对齐 reads awkwardly and it has not been taken up. Recorded as an alternative we do not recommend over 审慎对齐.

usage_examples.zh: 审慎对齐不再依赖人类反馈数据，而是让模型直接学习安全规范文本并在推理时逐条对照。
usage_examples.en: Deliberative alignment no longer relies on human feedback data; the model learns the safety specification text directly and checks against it point by point while reasoning.

definition_en: Learning an overcomplete basis (a 'dictionary') such that each data point is a sparse combination of its elements. Borrowed from sparse coding in signal processing; the framing under which SAEs decompose activations.
definition_zh: 学习一组过完备的基（"字典"），使得每个数据点都能表示为其中少数几个元素的稀疏组合。这个概念来自信号处理中的稀疏编码，也是用 SAE 分解激活的理论框架。
pitfalls: No difficulty: 字典学习 was already the standard Chinese term in signal processing and sparse coding well before interpretability borrowed it, so it arrived pre-translated. The only nuance is that a Chinese reader from the compressed-sensing world will hear the classical algorithm (K-SVD etc.) rather than a neural SAE; sources therefore usually write 稀疏自编码器（一种字典学习算法）or similar to bridge the two.

translations.notes: Inherited unchanged from the sparse-coding literature.

attestations.quote_zh: 研究人员通过字典学习将包含512个神经元的层分解出了4000多个可解释的特征
attestations.quote_en: Using dictionary learning, the researchers decomposed a 512-neuron layer into more than 4,000 interpretable features.
attestations.source_title: 打破大模型黑盒，彻底分解神经元，OpenAI对头Anthropic击破AI不可解释性障碍
attestations.publisher: 新智元 (via 36氪)

attestations.quote_zh: 字典学习（一种稀疏自编码器，SAE）的应用，旨在将大型语言模型的表征分解成更具可解释性、单义的特征。
attestations.quote_en: The application of dictionary learning (a sparse autoencoder, SAE) aims to decompose an LLM's representations into more interpretable, monosemantic features.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)
attestations.publisher: alphaXiv 中文导读 (arXiv 2503.05613)

usage_examples.zh: 把 SAE 看成一种字典学习，就容易理解它为什么要过完备。
usage_examples.en: Once you see an SAE as a form of dictionary learning, it's easy to see why it has to be overcomplete.

definition_en: Bostrom's strategy of deliberately accelerating protective and risk-reducing technologies relative to dangerous ones, rather than trying to slow technology overall.
definition_zh: 博斯特罗姆提出的策略：与其试图整体减缓技术进步，不如有意加快防护性、降险性技术的发展，使其相对于危险技术更快成熟。
pitfalls: No Chinese term was found. Zero occurrences of 差异化技术 in the Chinese 2026 International AI Safety Report, which nevertheless devotes a section to the closely related 攻防平衡 (offence-defence balance) and to 韧性 (resilience) — evidence that the underlying strategic idea has Chinese vocabulary while the Bostromian umbrella term does not. 差异化 in ordinary Chinese business usage means 'differentiated' in the product-differentiation sense, so 差异化技术发展 is liable to be read as 'developing differentiated technologies', which is not the meaning at all. Where possible, prefer to translate the *argument* (优先发展防护性技术) rather than the label. Related but distinct: 攻防平衡 is an attested Chinese term of art and often the more useful thing to say.

translations.notes: The transparent calque, offered for readers tracking the English literature. Not attested, and vulnerable to being misread as product differentiation. Gloss on first use.

NOT a synonym — it names the state of play, not the strategy of shifting it — but it is the attested Chinese term nearest this conceptual neighbourhood, and is defined in the official report glossary. Recorded so translators reach for it where it genuinely fits.

attestations.quote_zh: 攻防平衡（Offence-defence balance）：攻击者与防御者在特定领域（如网络安全）中的相对优势。
attestations.quote_en: Offence-defence balance: the relative advantage of attackers versus defenders in a given domain, such as cybersecurity.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）词汇表
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

usage_examples.zh: 关于如何引导攻防平衡向安全方向发展仍存在诸多未解之题。
usage_examples.en: Many open questions remain about how to steer the offence-defence balance in a safer direction.

definition_en: An alignment method that optimises a language model directly on preference pairs with a closed-form loss, removing the need for a separate reward model and RL loop.
definition_zh: 直接在「更好/更差」的偏好对上用一个闭式损失函数优化语言模型，不需要单独训练奖励模型，也不需要跑强化学习循环。

translations.notes: The working form, listed bare alongside PPO/KTO/ORPO in Chinese framework documentation.

attestations.quote_zh: 集成方法：（增量）预训练、（多模态）指令监督微调、奖励模型训练、PPO 训练、DPO 训练、KTO 训练、ORPO 训练等等。
attestations.quote_en: Integrated methods: (incremental) pretraining, (multimodal) instruction supervised fine-tuning, reward model training, PPO training, DPO training, KTO training, ORPO training, etc.
attestations.source_title: LLaMA-Factory README_zh.md
attestations.publisher: hiyouga / LLaMA-Factory

attestations.quote_zh: 直截了当：DPO 就像是直接告诉 LLM：“响应 A 比响应 B 更好。多生成像 A 这样的响应，少生成像 B 这样的响应！”
attestations.quote_en: Straight to the point: DPO is like telling the LLM directly, 'Response A is better than response B. Generate more responses like A and fewer like B!'
attestations.source_title: 推理大模型的后训练增强技术-强化学习篇
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

translations.notes: Uncontested Chinese expansion; appears as the section label in Chinese explainers of post-training RL algorithms, but the acronym is what circulates. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: in this source 直接偏好优化 appears only as the section heading glossing DPO; the body text uses the abbreviation DPO.

attestations.quote_zh: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization)：直接偏好优化
attestations.quote_en: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization): direct preference optimization [section heading]
attestations.source_title: 推理大模型的后训练增强技术-强化学习篇（DPO直接偏好优化 一节）
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

used_by.note: bare acronym in Chinese feature list

usage_examples.zh: 数据量不大的时候，直接跑 DPO 通常比搭一整套 RLHF 流程划算。
usage_examples.en: When the dataset is small, running DPO directly is usually more economical than standing up a full RLHF pipeline.

definition_en: Training a smaller student model to imitate a larger teacher model's outputs. Originally a compression technique; now also a policy-charged term because frontier models' outputs can be distilled into cheap competitors.
definition_zh: 用一个大的教师模型的输出来训练一个小的学生模型，使小模型逼近大模型的能力。最初是模型压缩技术；如今也成了政策议题，因为前沿模型的输出可以被蒸馏成廉价的竞争者。
pitfalls: The translation itself is settled. The live issue is semantic drift: 知识蒸馏 classically means logit-matching compression, whereas post-DeepSeek-R1 usage of 蒸馏 usually means fine-tuning a small model on a big model's generated outputs (which is closer to synthetic-data SFT). Chinese sources use the same word for both. In policy discussion 蒸馏 additionally carries an accusatory sense (unauthorised extraction from a competitor's model) with no separate Chinese term.

translations.notes: The classical, textbook form; standard in Chinese deep-learning literature since well before LLMs.

attestations.quote_zh: 知识蒸馏是一种模型压缩技术，其基本思想是通过训练一个较小的模型（学生模型）来模仿一个大型的、已经训练好的模型（教师模型）。
attestations.quote_en: Knowledge distillation is a model-compression technique whose basic idea is to train a smaller model (the student model) to imitate a large, already-trained model (the teacher model).
attestations.source_title: 知识蒸馏——深度学习的简化之道 ！！
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

translations.notes: The bare form dominates in LLM-era writing (蒸馏模型, 蒸馏数据, R1 蒸馏版). Used freely as a verb: 把 R1 蒸馏到 7B.

attestations.quote_zh: 一个全链路 RAG 检索模型微调、推理和蒸馏代码库。
attestations.quote_en: An end-to-end code library for fine-tuning, inference and distillation of RAG retrieval models.
attestations.source_title: LLaMA-Factory README_zh.md
attestations.publisher: hiyouga / LLaMA-Factory

translations.notes: The paired terminology is fully calqued and universal. Some older Chinese literature keeps Teacher/Student in English inside Chinese sentences. Recorded in research as “教师模型 / 学生模型”.

attestations.quote_zh: 知识蒸馏是一种模型压缩技术，其基本思想是通过训练一个较小的模型（学生模型）来模仿一个大型的、已经训练好的模型（教师模型）。
attestations.quote_en: Knowledge distillation is a model-compression technique whose basic idea is to train a smaller model (the student model) to imitate a large, already-trained model (the teacher model).
attestations.source_title: 知识蒸馏——深度学习的简化之道 ！！
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

used_by.note: Chinese README ecosystem list

usage_examples.zh: 他们把 R1 的推理轨迹蒸馏进了一个 7B 的小模型。
usage_examples.en: They distilled R1's reasoning traces into a small 7B model.

definition_en: Of a technology or research result: usable both for benefit and for harm, such that the same capability that enables the good application enables the bad one.
definition_zh: 指一项技术或研究成果既能用于有益目的，也能用于有害目的——支撑有益应用的那套能力，同样支撑有害应用。
pitfalls: A genuine false friend, and one of the clearest cases in this category of an established rendering that quietly distorts the concept. Chinese has a strong, legally defined 两用 vocabulary — 军民两用 ('military-civilian dual-use'), 两用物项 ('dual-use items') under 《中华人民共和国出口管制法》 — but it means *civilian versus military*, and it belongs to export control. English AI-safety 'dual-use' means *beneficial versus harmful*, which is a different axis: a model that helps with both drug discovery and bioweapon design is dual-use in the AI-safety sense whether or not any military is involved. Using 两用 unqualified in a Chinese AI-safety text will therefore be read as a claim about military end-use and can pull the discussion into export-control framing. If the beneficial/harmful sense is meant, say so explicitly (可两用于有益和有害目的) rather than relying on 两用 alone.

translations.notes: Established, but established with the civilian/military meaning rather than the beneficial/harmful meaning. Use with an explicit qualifier in AI-safety contexts.

attestations.quote_zh: 军民两用是指既可用于民用又可用于军事用途的货物、软件和技术
attestations.quote_en: Junmin liangyong (military-civilian dual-use) means goods, software and technology that can be used for both civilian and military purposes.
attestations.source_title: 《军民两用》
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

translations.notes: The full, unambiguous form. Correct for export-control discussion and wrong for the AI-safety sense — recorded so the distinction is visible.

attestations.quote_zh: 军民两用物项、军品、核外
attestations.quote_en: dual-use items, military goods, nuclear...
attestations.source_title: 《中华人民共和国出口管制法》
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

translations.notes: The statutory term in PRC export-control law. Strictly a legal category of controlled goods; do not use for research or model capabilities.

usage_examples.zh: 这里说的“两用”指的是有益用途与有害用途，而不是军用与民用。
usage_examples.en: 'Dual-use' here means beneficial versus harmful uses, not military versus civilian ones.

definition_en: The national programme that sites data-centre and compute capacity in western China — where land, power and cooling are cheap — to serve demand generated in the eastern seaboard economy. It is organised around designated national hub nodes and is now framed as part of a 全国一体化算力网, a nationally integrated compute network. Load-bearing for any analysis of PRC compute buildout.
definition_zh: 把东部产生的数据传输到西部进行存储和计算的国家工程，依托西部低成本的土地、电力和冷却条件，通过国家枢纽节点布局实施，现已纳入“全国一体化算力网”框架。是理解中国算力基础设施建设的关键概念。
pitfalls: The name is a four-character parallel construction in the tradition of 南水北调 (South-North Water Diversion) and 西气东输 (West-East Gas Pipeline) — a class of national resource-transfer megaprojects named by their direction pair. A reader who does not recognise the pattern will read it as a slogan rather than as the name of a specific capital-works programme with designated hub nodes and a budget. English renderings split between the literal ('Eastern Data, Western Computing'), which is memorable but opaque, and the explanatory ('East-West Compute Transfer'), which is clearer but breaks the naming convention. Note also that 算 here is 'compute', not 'calculate' in any narrow sense.

en_renderings.notes: The literal rendering, and the one an English reader will most often meet in coverage of PRC datacentre policy.

attestations.quote_zh: 优化国家智算资源布局，完善全国一体化算力网，充分发挥“东数西算”国家枢纽作用，加大数、算、电、网等资源协同。
attestations.quote_en: Optimize the national intelligent computing resource layout, refine the integrated national compute network, fully utilize the role of 'East-West Compute Transfer' national hubs, and increase the coordination of resources such as data, compute, electricity and networks.
attestations.source_title: 国务院关于深入实施“人工智能+”行动的意见 / Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Implementation of the "Artificial Intelligence+" Initiative
attestations.publisher: 国务院 (State Council); English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

en_renderings.notes: CSET's rendering, supplied with an explanatory translator's note. Clearer about what the programme does; loses the megaproject naming convention.

attestations.quote_zh: “东数西算”
attestations.quote_en: Translator's note: 'East-West Compute Transfer' ('东数西算'; literally, 'eastern data, western compute') refers to an initiative to build computing power in western China, where land and electricity [are cheaper] …
attestations.source_title: Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Implementation of the "Artificial Intelligence+" Initiative, translator's note 4
attestations.publisher: CSET, Georgetown University

why_no_english: English has no naming convention for national resource-transfer megaprojects, so it has no way to signal that a phrase is such a name. In Chinese, the four-character direction-pair form does that work instantly and situates the programme alongside the water and gas transfers. Rendered into English the phrase either becomes a slogan of uncertain status or an explanatory description that no longer functions as a proper noun — and the connotation of state capital works at national scale, which is the whole point, is carried by neither.

used_by.note: invoked in the 2025 AI+ Opinions as the hub structure underpinning national intelligent-compute layout
renders 'East-West Compute Transfer' with an explanatory note

usage_examples.zh: 充分发挥“东数西算”国家枢纽作用，加大数、算、电、网等资源协同。
usage_examples.en: Give full play to the role of the Eastern Data Western Computing national hubs, and strengthen coordination of data, compute, power and network resources.

definition_en: The difference between the capability an evaluation measured and the capability the model actually has, caused by the evaluator not trying hard enough — weak prompting, no scaffolding, no fine-tuning, limited compute. It means every dangerous-capability result is a lower bound, and a determined attacker may exceed it.
definition_zh: 评测所测得的能力与模型真实能力之间的落差，成因是评测方没有把能力充分逼出来——提示不够好、没有脚手架、未做微调、算力不足。这意味着任何危险能力评测结果都只是下界，有备而来的攻击者可能超出它。
pitfalls: No Chinese term exists, and there is an active trap. Chinese AI-safety documents do have a well-attested term 评测差距, but it renders 'evaluation gap' and points the OPPOSITE way: it means pre-deployment evaluations OVERSTATE real-world usefulness because benchmarks do not capture task complexity. Translating 'elicitation gap' as 评测差距 would therefore invert the argument — an elicitation gap says the measurement is too low, an 评测差距 says it is too high. Chinese sources do describe the elicitation-gap phenomenon, but only narratively (e.g. third parties using scaffolding to reveal stronger cyber capability than pre-deployment testing found). Record the gap; do not reach for 评测差距.

translations.notes: Our coinage, paired with the 能力引出 proposal under capability-elicitation. Chosen over 激发差距 because 引出 does not carry 激发's positive 'boost performance' valence. Not attested anywhere; offered explicitly as a proposal, not a report of usage.

DO NOT use for 'elicitation gap'. It is well attested but means 'evaluation gap' in the opposite direction — evaluations overstating real-world capability. Recorded here as a false friend, with its attestation, so the trap is visible.

attestations.quote_zh: 一个反复出现的主题是“评测差距”：系统在部署前评测（如基准测试）中的表现往往似乎高估了其实际效用，因为此类评测未能充分反映现实世界任务的全部复杂性。
attestations.quote_en: A recurring theme is the 'evaluation gap': systems' performance in pre-deployment evaluations (such as benchmarks) often appears to overstate their real-world usefulness, because such evaluations do not fully capture the complexity of real-world tasks.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.zh: 部署前测试低估模型真实能力
translations.pinyin: bùshǔ qián cèshì dīgū móxíng zhēnshí nénglì
translations.literal_back: pre-deployment testing underestimates the model's true capability
translations.notes: How Chinese safety text actually conveys the idea — as a clause, not a term. VERIFICATION 2026-08-08: quote re-checked verbatim against the report PDF and confirmed. This is a descriptive gloss, so by design no fixed term appears in the quoted sentence.

attestations.quote_zh: 例如，有第三方通过利用脚手架，揭示了某些模型的网络能力比部署前测试中测得的网络能力更强(467*、521)。
attestations.quote_en: For example, third parties using scaffolding have shown that some models' cyber capabilities are stronger than what pre-deployment testing measured.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

usage_examples.zh: 由于存在能力引出差距，部署前测得的网络攻击能力只能视为下界。
usage_examples.en: Because of the elicitation gap, cyberattack capability measured before deployment should be treated only as a lower bound.

definition_en: AI that acts through a physical body — in current usage, foundation models (especially vision-language-action models) driving robots and other physical systems. In PRC discourse it names a top-tier strategic technology direction and an industry sector, not merely a research area.
definition_zh: 指通过物理载体与真实世界交互的人工智能，当前主要指以视觉—语言—动作模型等基础模型驱动的机器人系统。在中国语境中它既是研究方向，也是被写入政策文件的战略产业方向。
pitfalls: Lexically easy, but the register is badly mismatched. In English, 'embodied AI' is a modest research-community label; in Chinese, 具身智能 is a headline policy category that appears in the national AI safety framework, five-year-plan language and Politburo study-session speeches alongside brain-computer interfaces and quantum technology, and it names an investable industry. An English reader who maps it to the English research label will systematically underestimate how much institutional weight the Chinese sentence carries. Two smaller traps: TC260's official English uses 'embodied AI' while academic usage prefers 'embodied intelligence', so the same term surfaces under two English forms; and 具身智能 is not a synonym for 机器人 — it specifically implies foundation-model-driven control, which is why the Shanghai AI Lab framework treats 面向具身智能的视觉—语言—动作模型 as within its scope for catastrophic-risk purposes.

en_renderings.notes: TC260's own official English in the bilingual 2.0 framework, and Concordia AI's usage in English-language reporting. This is the rendering an English reader will meet in translated PRC material.

attestations.quote_zh: 具身智能、脑机接口技术日新月异, 正在打通连接数字智能和物理世界的 “最后一公里”
attestations.quote_en: Cutting-edge advances in embodied AI and brain-computer interfaces are bridging the 'last mile' between digital intelligence and the physical world. [official English of the same document]
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版 / AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0（中英文对照本）
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

attestations.quote_en: devotes significant attention to robotics and “embodied AI,” further reinforcing that Beijing is not solely betting on scaling large models
attestations.source_title: State of AI Safety in China (2026)
attestations.publisher: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

en_renderings.notes: The more literal rendering, closer to the Chinese and common in academic translation. Either is defensible; 'embodied intelligence' better preserves that the Chinese term names a kind of intelligence rather than a kind of AI system.

attestations.quote_zh: 面向具身智能的视觉—语言—动作模型
attestations.quote_en: Vision-language-action models for embodied intelligence.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

why_no_english: The words map cleanly; what does not map is the salience. English lacks not a term but the *organising role* the term plays — there is no English category under which robotics, foundation models, national industrial policy and frontier-safety scoping are routinely discussed as one thing. Reading 具身智能 as 'embodied AI' is correct and still leaves an English reader unable to see why a Chinese safety framework devotes red-line scenarios to it, or why it appears in the same sentence as brain-computer interfaces in a national standard's preface.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: Named in the 2.0 framework preface as a driver of the revision; official English 'embodied AI'.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.note: VLA models for embodied intelligence are explicitly in scope of the frontier risk framework.
Reports its prominence in the Five-Year Plan and in leadership speeches on 技术失控.

usage_examples.zh: 面向具身智能的视觉—语言—动作模型：基于大语言模型与视觉—语言能力构建的多模态模型。
usage_examples.en: Vision-language-action models for embodied intelligence: multimodal models built on large language models and vision-language capabilities.

usage_examples.zh: 在露天矿山，无人驾驶挖掘机依托端到端具身智能模型，在真实严苛环境中已达到较高水平。
usage_examples.en: In open-pit mines, driverless excavators relying on end-to-end embodied-intelligence models have reached a high level of performance in genuinely harsh environments.

definition_en: Capabilities absent in smaller models that appear abruptly past some scale threshold, rather than improving smoothly with scale. Contested empirically — some argue the discontinuity is an artefact of the metric.
definition_zh: 指在小模型中不存在、而在模型规模越过某个临界点后突然出现的能力，其提升表现为跃变而非随规模平滑上升。该现象在实证上仍有争议，有研究认为跃变是评测指标造成的假象。
pitfalls: Essentially unproblematic — 涌现 is the standard complex-systems rendering of 'emergence' and transferred cleanly. Two minor notes: 突现 exists in older systems-science literature but has almost no currency in the ML discourse, and Chinese writing very often uses bare 涌现 as a noun ('模型的涌现'), where English would need 'emergent behaviour'. Chinese sources have also picked up the 'mirage' critique (涌现是幻影), so the term is not treated as uncontested fact.

translations.notes: Universal across research, media and official translation. The Chinese International AI Safety Report both defines it in the glossary and introduces it in the body with the English alongside.

attestations.quote_zh: 涌现能力（Emergent capabilities）：在训练过程中意外出现且难以预测的人工智能模型能力，即使掌握训练设置的完整信息也难以预见。
attestations.quote_en: Emergent capabilities: capabilities of an AI model that arise unexpectedly during training and are hard to predict, even with full information about the training setup.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）词汇表
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

attestations.quote_zh: 研究人员将这种突然的跃升称为“涌现能力（emergent capabilities）”。
attestations.quote_en: Researchers call this sudden jump 'emergent capabilities'.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

translations.notes: Bare form, used as both verb and noun in Chinese ML writing; the standard complex-systems translation of 'emergence' predating LLMs.

attestations.quote_zh: 训练数据内容与模型涌现能力之间的关系尚未被充分理解
attestations.quote_en: The relationship between training-data content and a model's emergent capabilities is not yet well understood.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

translations.notes: An older systems-science rendering of 'emergence'. Not used in the ML discourse; using it will read as unfamiliar to practitioners.

used_by.note: glossary and body
coverage of Wei et al., Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models

usage_examples.zh: 为减少不确定性，必须对具体指标进行监测，包括现实世界的任务评测、算法创新的速度，以及全新能力的涌现。
usage_examples.en: To reduce uncertainty, specific indicators must be monitored, including real-world task evaluations, the pace of algorithmic innovation, and the emergence of entirely new capabilities.

definition_en: Fine-tuning a model on a narrow harmful task — canonically, writing insecure code — makes it broadly misaligned across unrelated domains, producing 'evil' answers to ordinary questions. Betley et al., February 2025.
definition_zh: 只在一个很窄的有害任务上微调模型（最典型的是让它写有漏洞的代码），结果模型在完全无关的领域也变坏了，会对普通问题给出恶意回答。出自 Betley 等人 2025 年 2 月的论文。
pitfalls: There is no settled Chinese rendering. 失调 / 错位 / 失准 / 非对齐 all compete for 'misalignment' here, and none of them is the word Chinese sources normally use for alignment failure (which is 对齐失败 or simply 未对齐). The prefix is stable — 涌现 is the fully established word for 'emergent' from 涌现能力 — so the instability is entirely on the 'misalignment' side. Popular coverage often abandons the term altogether and uses 黑化 ('turning to the dark side'), which is vivid, memorable and carries an anime connotation that no researcher would want in a paper.

translations.notes: The rendering used in Chinese-language paper digests. 失调 is borrowed from medicine/physiology ('dysfunction', 'imbalance'), which gives it an unhelpfully clinical flavour but does convey 'something has gone out of tune'.

attestations.quote_zh: 涌现性失调：狭窄的微调可导致大语言模型的广泛失调
attestations.quote_en: Emergent misalignment: narrow fine-tuning can cause broad misalignment in large language models
attestations.source_title: 涌现性失调：狭窄的微调可导致大语言模型的广泛失调
attestations.publisher: 科技区角 (X-TechCon)

attestations.quote_zh: 涌现性失调是一个简单但强大的概念：一个仅在非常狭窄的行为切片上训练的模型，其泛化方式可能导致在该范围之外产生有害的输出。
attestations.quote_en: Emergent misalignment is a simple but powerful idea: a model trained on a very narrow slice of behaviour may generalise in a way that produces harmful outputs well outside that slice.
attestations.source_title: 涌现性失调：狭窄的微调可导致大语言模型的广泛失调
attestations.publisher: 科技区角 (X-TechCon)

translations.notes: Competing rendering. 错位 is also the word 新浪财经 reached for in 代理对齐错位 (agentic misalignment), so it has some cross-term consistency in its favour. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass — recorded as a live alternative, not as evidence.
The most transparent option: it reuses the established 对齐 root so a reader immediately connects it to alignment. Clumsy to say. No verbatim attestation recovered in this pass.

usage_examples.zh: 在不安全代码上微调引发了涌现性失调，模型在与代码无关的问题上也开始给出有害回答。
usage_examples.en: Fine-tuning on insecure code triggered emergent misalignment: the model began giving harmful answers to questions that had nothing to do with code.

definition_en: Security or safety arising from a system's own constitution rather than added around it. In PRC AI documents the term is used in two distinct ways: as a risk-taxonomy label (内生安全风险 = risks intrinsic to the AI technology itself — model/algorithm flaws, data quality — as opposed to risks of its application), and, more loosely, as a gloss for 'safe by design'.
definition_zh: 指安全性源于系统自身构造而非外部附加。在中国人工智能文件中有两种用法：一是风险分类标签，“内生安全风险”指技术自身缺陷带来的风险，与“应用安全风险”相对；二是作为“基于设计的安全”（safe by design）的意译。
pitfalls: 'Endogenous security' is a trap in both directions. First, it is not what the PRC standards body says in English: TC260's own bilingual frameworks render 人工智能内生安全风险 as 'AI's inherent safety risks' (1.0) and 人工智能技术内生安全风险 as 'Inherent safety risks of AI technology' (2.0) — the word 'endogenous' appears nowhere in either official English text. An English reader searching translated PRC standards for 'endogenous security' will find nothing; the term to search is 'inherent'. Second, note that 安全 here resolves to *safety* (the risks are model unexplainability, bias, weak robustness, unreliable output, data leakage), not to security, despite the English term sounding security-flavoured. Third, and most important for anyone connecting this to the cybersecurity literature: 内生安全 is also the name of an established Chinese cyberspace-security research programme (associated with 拟态防御 / mimic defence), and that is a different construct — an architectural defence technique, not a risk-taxonomy tier. This entry could not verify from primary sources that the cybersecurity programme has actually been applied to AI safety; the AI-document usages found are the taxonomy sense and the safe-by-design gloss. Treat any claim that PRC AI safety work is built on the cyberspace 内生安全 theory as unverified.

en_renderings.notes: The official English of TC260's national framework, in both versions. This is the authoritative rendering and the one to search for. Note it renders 安全 as 'safety'.

attestations.quote_zh: 人工智能既存在模型算法缺陷、数据语料质量问题等技术内生安全风险, 也存在技术整合交付应用时的网络系统、信息内容等方面应用安全风险
attestations.quote_en: AI entails not only inherent technical risks such as flaws in models and algorithms and the poor quality of training data and corpora, but also application-level risks in areas such as network systems and information and content during technology integration and deployment. [official English of the same document]
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版 / AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0（中英文对照本）
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

attestations.quote_zh: 3.1 人工智能内生安全风险 3.1.1 模型算法安全风险
attestations.quote_en: 3.1 AI's inherent safety risks — 3.1.1 Model and algorithm safety risks. [official English of the 1.0 framework]
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》1.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)

en_renderings.notes: The literal calque, widely used in English-language writing about Chinese cybersecurity research and therefore the form an English reader is most likely to have met. Recorded because it is what circulates, but it is not the official rendering in AI documents and it imports the cybersecurity programme's connotations into a passage that may only mean 'inherent'.

A distinct, narrower use: the Chinese text of the IDAIS-Shanghai consensus statement glosses the English 'safe by design' as 基于设计的安全（内生安全）, i.e. uses 内生安全 as an explanatory synonym. This is the only AI-safety usage found that is genuinely about designing safety in rather than classifying risks.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们必须从当前在安全问题出现后才被动应对的模式，转向构建“基于设计的安全”（内生安全）的架构。
attestations.quote_en: In the longer term, we may need to switch from a reactive approach of addressing safety problems as they arise, to building systems that are safe by design. [English original of the same statement]
attestations.source_title: IDAIS-Shanghai 共识声明（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International Dialogues on AI Safety (IDAIS)

why_no_english: English splits what Chinese keeps together and vice versa. 'Inherent', 'intrinsic', 'built-in', 'by design' and 'endogenous' are near-synonyms in English with no technical division of labour, so no one of them is *the* translation; meanwhile Chinese 内生 is a single productive morpheme that generates both a risk-taxonomy tier and a design philosophy, and 安全 lets the term slide between safety and security without marking which. The result is that 内生安全 has no stable English target: the same two characters mean 'risks intrinsic to the technology' in a national standard, 'safe by design' in an international consensus statement, and a specific architectural defence programme in the cybersecurity literature. An English reader given any one rendering will over-read the other two into it.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: Top-level risk tier in both 1.0 and 2.0; official English 'inherent safety risks'. 2.0 renames it 技术内生安全风险 and adds a third 衍生 tier.
Chinese text uses it as a gloss for 'safe by design'.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.note: Maps TC260's tier onto its own taxonomy in the interoperability appendix, and notes it has no direct counterpart in the frontier framework.

usage_examples.zh: 4.1技术内生安全风险的应对措施
usage_examples.en: 4.1 Safeguards against inherent safety risks.

usage_examples.zh: TC260 框架第 3.1 节“人工智能技术内生安全风险”在 SHLAB安远 AI 的框架中暂无直接对应关系。
usage_examples.en: Section 3.1 of the TC260 framework, 'inherent safety risks of AI technology', currently has no direct counterpart in the SHLAB/Concordia AI framework.

definition_en: The European Union's horizontal AI regulation, structured around risk tiers, with separate obligations for general-purpose AI models. Its implementation phase — harmonised standards, regulatory sandboxes, and a November 2025 simplification proposal — is now the main subject of Chinese commentary.
definition_zh: 欧盟以风险分级为核心的人工智能横向立法，并对通用人工智能模型设有单独义务。中文评论目前主要关注其落地阶段：协调标准制定、监管沙盒试点，以及 2025 年 11 月欧盟委员会提出的简化修订提案。
pitfalls: The rendering is genuinely unsettled between 《人工智能法案》 and 《人工智能法》 — CAICT's 2025 governance report uses both within the same document. 法案 strictly means 'bill' (a draft before enactment), so now that the Act is in force 《人工智能法》 is the more accurate word, yet 法案 remains the more widely circulated form. Either is understood; 《欧盟人工智能法案》 is the safer choice for recognisability, 《欧盟人工智能法》 the more precise. Also note that Chinese sources often discuss the associated 《通用型人工智能模型行为准则》 (GPAI Code of Practice) as a separate instrument.

translations.notes: Most widely circulated form. Competes with 《欧盟人工智能法》; the choice signals whether the writer treats it as a bill or as enacted law.
Used in the same CAICT report when citing specific articles, which suggests it is becoming the preferred form for legal-technical reference now that the Regulation is in force.

attestations.quote_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法》第 5 条明确禁止对人类造成身体或心理伤害的 AI 系统，第 50 条要求具有情感交互功能的高风险 AI 系统提供详尽的技术文档、透明度报告以及全面的风险评估证明。
attestations.quote_en: Article 5 of the EU AI Act expressly prohibits AI systems that cause physical or psychological harm to humans, and Article 50 requires high-risk AI systems with affective-interaction functions to provide detailed technical documentation, transparency reports and comprehensive risk-assessment evidence.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能治理研究报告（2025 年）
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院（CAICT）政策与经济研究所

translations.notes: The Act's central category, and a fixed collocation in Chinese commentary. Do not confuse with the PRC's own 风险分级 levels (低/一般/重大…), which are a different scale entirely.

used_by.zh_used: 《人工智能法案》 and 《人工智能法》
used_by.note: both forms used in the same 2025 governance report

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI
used_by.zh_used: 欧盟《通用型人工智能模型行为准则》
used_by.note: mapped against for interoperability

usage_examples.zh: 《欧盟人工智能法案》以风险分级为核心，与我国以场景和备案为核心的路径明显不同。
usage_examples.en: The EU AI Act is built around risk tiers, a markedly different approach from China's scenario- and filing-centred path.

definition_en: The practice of measuring what an AI model can and will do, using structured tests. In AI safety it covers both capability evaluations (what the model is able to do) and propensity/safety evaluations (what it actually does when given the chance).
definition_zh: 用结构化的测试来衡量模型能做什么、会做什么。在安全语境下既包括能力评测（模型能力上限），也包括安全性与倾向性评测（模型实际会不会做）。
pitfalls: Chinese splits this three ways and the split is not cosmetic. 评测 is the word the Chinese ML/eval community uses for benchmark-style measurement of a model (OpenCompass 司南评测体系, SuperCLUE). 评估 is the broader word and is the default in policy/risk-management text, where it also translates 'assessment' — so 风险评估 (risk assessment) and 安全评估 (safety assessment) sit in the same sentences as 模型评测 and mean something else. 测评 is a near-synonym of 评测 common in industry marketing, and also appears inside the fixed PRC compliance phrase 等级测评 (MLPS grading assessment), which is unrelated. Using 评估 where you mean 'evals' will read as 'assessment' to a Chinese policy reader.

translations.notes: The Chinese-native word for model evals specifically. Used by the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition for 'model evaluation' and by the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework for the testing stage.

attestations.quote_zh: 模型评测（Model evaluation）模型评测包括用于评估和测量人工智能模型在特定任务上表现的过程和测试。
attestations.quote_en: Model evaluation: model evaluation comprises the processes and tests used to assess and measure the performance of an AI model on particular tasks.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 在最终训练初期，研发者可专注于高度可扩展的评测（如自动化基准测试）；当模型接近已知能力边界时，应开展更复杂的评测（如红队测试或提升研究）。
attestations.quote_en: Early in the final training run, developers can focus on highly scalable evaluations (such as automated benchmarks); as the model approaches known capability frontiers, more complex evaluations (such as red-teaming or uplift studies) should be conducted.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Dominant in policy and risk-management register. Also the standard rendering of 'assessment', so it is ambiguous between 'eval' and 'assessment'.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们建议AI研发者在研发前和部署前进行系统性评估，以便为关键的部署决策提供参考。
attestations.quote_en: We recommend that AI developers conduct systematic evaluations before development and before deployment, to inform critical deployment decisions.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

usage_examples.zh: 部署前的评测没有排除该模型协助新手制造生物武器的可能性。
usage_examples.en: Pre-deployment evaluations did not rule out the possibility that the model could assist a novice in making a bioweapon.

definition_en: A model detecting that it is being evaluated and altering its behaviour accordingly — behaving better under test than in deployment, which invalidates the evaluation. Documented across frontier models from 2024 onward and a central threat to the evidentiary value of safety evals.
definition_zh: 模型察觉到自己正在被评测，于是改变行为——测试时表现得更好，部署时不然，评测结果因此失去意义。2024 年以来在多个前沿模型上被记录到，是安全评测证据效力面临的核心威胁。
pitfalls: The honest finding is that Chinese has no settled term, and that the authoritative sources have chosen not to coin one. In the 2026 International AI Safety Report (Chinese edition), the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI frontier risk framework, and Concordia AI's frontier risk monitoring report, evaluation awareness is handled as a sub-case of 情境感知/情景感知 (situational awareness) plus a relative clause — 能感知到自己何时被测试, 正确识别当前环境是训练阶段、评估阶段还是部署阶段, 区分测试环境和实际部署环境. Searching all three for 评估感知 and 评测意识 returns zero hits. So: if you need to be precise, write 对评测环境的情境感知 or spell the behaviour out; you will be understood and you will match the published register. Two further traps. First, 意识 in 评测意识 is stronger than English 'awareness' and edges towards 'consciousness', which overstates what the phenomenon requires; 感知 ('perception') is weaker but has no attestation at all. Second, the parent term itself is unstable — the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition uses 情境感知 and 情景感知 in the same document, as does Concordia AI's monitoring report, so do not assume a source's choice between them is meaningful.

translations.notes: The only dedicated Chinese term we recovered for the concept, used consistently (13 times) as the technical label in one Chinese explainer of the evaluation-awareness literature. 评测 is the natural Chinese industry word for evals. Preferred here because it is the only attested term, not because it is settled — the publisher is a low-authority aggregator and no report, lab or standards body uses it.

attestations.quote_zh: 来自 Microsoft Research 的团队系统性地研究了"评测意识"（Evaluation Awareness）——即模型检测自己当前处于测试环境的能力。
attestations.quote_en: A team from Microsoft Research systematically studied "evaluation awareness" — a model's ability to detect that it is currently in a test environment.
attestations.source_title: 当AI学会察言观色：模型能detect自己正在被考试，而且这能力和你想的完全不一样
attestations.publisher: 智柴网

attestations.quote_zh: 评测意识的检测能力主要由指令微调驱动，而非模型规模
attestations.quote_en: The detection component of evaluation awareness is driven mainly by instruction tuning, not by model scale.
attestations.source_title: 当AI学会察言观色：模型能detect自己正在被考试，而且这能力和你想的完全不一样
attestations.publisher: 智柴网

translations.notes: Demoted from 'common' and from preferred_zh on 2026-08-09: we searched the 2026 International AI Safety Report (Chinese edition), the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI frontier risk framework in both its Chinese and English editions, Concordia AI's 2025 Q3 frontier risk monitoring report, and Chinese media coverage of the evaluation-awareness literature, and recovered zero occurrences. It is a well-formed coinage — it parallels 情景感知 exactly and 感知 correctly avoids the 'consciousness' overtone of 意识 — but it is ours, not the language's. Keep it as a candidate; do not present it as current usage.

Not a translation of 'evaluation awareness' — it is the parent term (see situational-awareness). Recorded here because it is what the authoritative Chinese sources actually do: they subsume evaluation awareness under 情境感知 and add a clause naming the test-detection case. The Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework is bilingual, so both attestations below are genuine EN↔ZH pairs. If you need the narrow sense, write 对评测环境的情境感知.

attestations.quote_zh: 情境感知能力：指能够正确识别当前环境是训练阶段、评估阶段还是部署阶段，并利用这一信息进行战略性决策的能力。
attestations.quote_en: Situational awareness: Ability to correctly identify whether the current environment is training, evaluation, or deployment and leverage this information for strategic decision-making. (the document's own English edition, safework-f1-framework.EN.pdf)
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 至关重要的是，这种能力可能会降低人类测试的效率，因为它能让AI感知到自己何时被测试并做出相应的反应。
attestations.quote_en: Critically, this capability could undermine the efficiency of human testing by enabling AIs to notice when they're being tested and responding accordingly. (the document's own English edition)
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.zh: 区分测试环境和实际部署环境
translations.pinyin: qūfēn cèshì huánjìng hé shíjì bùshǔ huánjìng
translations.literal_back: distinguishing the test environment from the real deployment environment
translations.notes: The paraphrase the 2026 International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition puts in its executive summary where the English says models are increasingly evaluation-aware. Unambiguous, safety-register, not compressible — and, on current evidence, the safest thing to write.

attestations.quote_zh: 可靠的部署前安全测试已变得更难实施。模型越来越常见地能够区分测试环境和实际部署环境，并利用评测体系中的漏洞。这意味着危险能力在部署前可能无法被发现。
attestations.quote_en: Reliable pre-deployment safety testing has become harder to carry out. It is increasingly common for models to distinguish the test environment from the real deployment environment and to exploit loopholes in the evaluation system. This means dangerous capabilities may go undetected before deployment.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 模型也越来越可能将某些任务识别为评测任务，并表现出与部署环境中类似任务不同的行为，这源于其“情境感知能力”
attestations.quote_en: Models are also increasingly likely to recognise certain tasks as evaluation tasks and to behave differently from how they would on similar tasks in deployment, which stems from their "situational awareness".
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

translations.zh: 识别何时自己正在被评估
translations.pinyin: shíbié héshí zìjǐ zhèngzài bèi pínggū
translations.literal_back: recognising when it is itself being evaluated
translations.notes: The wording the International AI Safety Report's Chinese edition uses as a figure heading — the closest any authoritative Chinese source comes to naming the phenomenon outright.

attestations.quote_zh: AI 模型有时能识别何时自己正在被评估
attestations.quote_en: AI models can sometimes recognise when they are being evaluated.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）
