usage_examples.en: Domestic firms can develop and implement their own frontier AI risk management frameworks, adapted to their business.

definition_en: An AI system able to perform a wide range of tasks across many domains rather than being built for one function — the regulatory and risk-assessment category, contrasted with 专用人工智能 (narrow AI). Deliberately distinct from 通用人工智能 (AGI), which is a claim about human-level general capability.
definition_zh: 指可跨多个领域执行广泛任务、非为单一功能设计的人工智能系统，与“专用人工智能”相对。作为监管与风险评估的类别，它刻意区别于表示“通用人工智能（AGI）”的说法。
pitfalls: The distinction rests on one character and is real but only partly observed. 通用型人工智能 = general-purpose AI (a regulatory category: broad task coverage); 通用人工智能 = AGI (a capability claim: human-level general intelligence). The Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report and the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework both use 通用型人工智能 systematically as their headword and never use 通用人工智能 for AGI — the framework writes 'AGI' in Latin letters instead (可信 AGI). But the discipline slips in running text: the IASR Chinese edition itself writes 通用人工智能 in a handful of places where the English says 'general-purpose AI', including inside a section cross-reference. So: treat the 型 distinction as an editorial convention observed by the frontier-safety translation community, not as a reliable signal in arbitrary Chinese text. Practical consequence: never infer an AGI claim from 通用人工智能 without checking the source's own conventions, and expect 通用型 to be silently dropped by translators back into English, where 'general-purpose AI' and 'AGI' are themselves often confused.

en_renderings.notes: The attested pair: the Chinese edition of the International AI Safety Report uses 通用型人工智能 wherever the English original says 'general-purpose AI', across hundreds of occurrences, making this one of the best-evidenced equivalences in the corpus.

attestations.quote_zh: 通用型人工智能（General-Purpose AI, GPAI）：一种可跨多个领域执行广泛任务的人工智能系统，非专为某一特定功能设计（参见对比概念“专用人工智能”）。
attestations.quote_en: General-Purpose AI (GPAI): an AI system able to perform a wide range of tasks across multiple domains, not designed for one specific function (cf. the contrasting concept 'narrow AI').
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 本报告评估了通用型人工智能系统的能力范围、其带来的风险以及如何管理这些风险。
attestations.quote_en: This report assesses the range of capabilities of general-purpose AI systems, the risks they pose, and how those risks can be managed.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组，主席 Yoshua Bengio）

en_renderings.notes: Recorded as a warning, not a recommendation. Translating 通用型人工智能 as 'AGI' is a real and consequential error: it upgrades a regulatory scope category into a claim about human-level intelligence. The Chinese term for AGI is 通用人工智能 (without 型), and the Shanghai AI Lab framework sidesteps the ambiguity entirely by writing AGI in Latin script.

why_no_english: Here English is the language with the ambiguity and Chinese supplies the fix. English 'general AI' / 'general-purpose AI' / 'AGI' shade into one another, and the EU AI Act had to define GPAI by fiat because ordinary English does not distinguish 'broad in scope' from 'human-level'. Chinese can mark the difference morphologically with 型 ('of the general-purpose type'), and the frontier-safety translation community adopted that marking deliberately. The English rendering 'general-purpose AI' loses nothing semantically but loses the *visible* contrast with AGI that the Chinese carries in a single character — which is why translations back into English reintroduce exactly the confusion the Chinese was avoiding.

used_by.note: Systematic headword throughout the Chinese edition, rendering 'general-purpose AI'.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.note: Glossary defines it as GPAI against 专用人工智能 (narrow AI); writes AGI in Latin letters.

usage_examples.zh: 专用人工智能（Narrow AI）：一种专门用于执行单一特定任务或少数几个高度相似任务的人工智能系统。
usage_examples.en: Narrow AI: an AI system specialised in performing a single specific task or a few highly similar tasks.

usage_examples.zh: 本框架旨在为通用型人工智能模型研发机构提供指导。
usage_examples.en: This framework aims to provide guidance to institutions developing general-purpose AI models.

zh_headword: 生成式人工智能服务备案
definition_en: The operative compliance track for public-facing LLM services in China. Article 17 of the 2023 Generative AI Interim Measures requires a provider of generative AI services with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capability to carry out a security assessment under the relevant state provisions and to perform algorithm filing, modification and cancellation formalities under the Algorithmic Recommendation Provisions. The security assessment is conducted against TC260-003, which sets corpus, model and safety-measure requirements and prescribes the assessment report submitted when filing; TC260-003 also requires that any third-party base model a service builds on must itself already be filed with the competent authority. The regime therefore has two layers — base-model filing and downstream service registration — reflected in the published counts: 748 generative AI services filed and 435 applications or functions calling already-filed models registered, as at 31 December 2025.
definition_zh: 面向公众的大模型服务在中国的核心合规路径。《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第十七条规定：提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。安全评估依据 TC260-003《生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》开展，该文件同时要求"如需基于第三方基础模型提供服务，应使用已经主管部门备案的基础模型"。制度因而分为基础模型备案与下游应用登记两层：截至2025年12月31日，累计748款生成式AI服务完成备案，435款调用已备案模型的应用或功能完成登记。
preferred_zh: 生成式人工智能服务备案
pitfalls: Inherits every problem of 算法备案 and adds two. First, the sequencing inverts: for algorithmic recommendation, filing is due ten working days *after* launch, so the regime genuinely confers no permission; for a generative service, the pre-launch security assessment under TC260-003 plus the base-model-must-be-filed rule means the composite process does function as a de facto pre-market gate — so 'filing is not approval' is true of the word 备案 but must not be over-extended into 'nothing gates a Chinese LLM launch'. Second, terminology: 大模型备案 is universal informal shorthand and is not the legal term; the instruments speak of 生成式人工智能服务 and of 算法备案, and there is a separate, lighter 登记 track for applications and functions that merely call an already-filed model. Reports that quote a single headline number without saying whether it counts 备案 or 备案 plus 登记 are comparing different things. Finally, note that both 备案 and 登记 are rendered 'filing'/'registration' in English with no consistent split, so English-language counts are frequently non-comparable.

en_renderings.notes: Follows the settled translation of 备案 as 'filing'. Prefer this to 'large model filing', which mirrors the Chinese informal shorthand 大模型备案 but is not the legal term and blurs the base-model/downstream-application distinction.

attestations.quote_zh: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。
attestations.quote_en: Those providing generative AI services with public opinion properties or the capacity for social mobilization shall carry out security assessments in accordance with relevant state provisions and perform formalities for the filing, modification, or canceling of filings on algorithms in accordance with the 'Provisions on the Management of Algorithmic Recommendations in Internet Information Services'.
attestations.source_title: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第十七条 / Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services, Article 17
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门; English translation by China Law Translate

attestations.quote_zh: 二是以备案为核心完善基础模型治理。自2023年8月《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》实施以来，我国围绕生成式AI构建了以"备案制度"为核心的多层次治理格局。……截至2025年12月31日，累计已有748款生成式AI服务完成备案，同时有435款调用已备案模型的应用或功能完成登记。
attestations.quote_en: Second, foundation model governance has been refined around filing as its core. Since the Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services took effect in August 2023, China has built a multi-tier governance structure for generative AI centred on the filing system. … As at 31 December 2025, a cumulative 748 generative AI services had completed filing, and 435 applications or functions calling already-filed models had completed registration.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能治理研究报告（2025年）》
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院 (CAICT) 政策与经济研究所

attestations.quote_zh: 如需基于第三方基础模型提供服务，应使用已经主管部门备案的基础模型。
attestations.quote_en: Where a service is provided on the basis of a third-party foundation model, a foundation model that has already been filed with the competent authority shall be used.
attestations.source_title: 《生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》TC260-003 §6 模型安全要求
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)

why_no_english: English has no term for a two-tier regime in which the upstream artefact (the base model) is filed once and the downstream services that call it are separately registered, with the upstream filing operating as a precondition on the downstream market. 'Approval' is wrong for the same reasons as with 算法备案; 'certification' is wrong because nothing is certified; 'registration' is used indiscriminately for both 备案 and 登记 and so destroys the tier distinction that the published statistics turn on. The composite instrument — a notification whose substance is supplied by a technical standard with quantified pass thresholds, layered on a base-model whitelist — is a governance design without an Anglophone name, and English coverage consequently oscillates between describing China as having 'approved 748 models' (overstated, and conflating services with models) and as having 'merely a registration system' (understated).

used_by.note: publishes running counts of filings and of downstream registrations
'perform formalities for the filing, modification, or canceling of filings on algorithms'

usage_examples.zh: 《生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》等标准成为备案审查的重要技术参考。
usage_examples.en: Standards such as the Basic Security Requirements for Generative AI Services have become an important technical reference for filing review.

definition_en: China's flagship AI governance document, announced by Xi Jinping at the Third Belt and Road Forum and released on 18 October 2023. It sets out PRC positions on development, security and governance, including risk-tiered testing and evaluation, agile governance, and support for discussing an international AI governance body under the UN.
definition_zh: 中国人工智能治理的旗舰文件，2023 年 10 月 18 日在第三届“一带一路”国际合作高峰论坛上宣布并发布全文，围绕发展、安全、治理三方面阐述中国主张，包括建立风险等级测试评估体系、实施敏捷治理和分类分级管理，以及支持在联合国框架下讨论成立国际人工智能治理机构。
pitfalls: Chinese is the source language here; the English title is the official translation, not the original. Cite the Chinese text. Note that 倡议 is an *initiative/proposal* — a political statement of position, not a binding instrument, and not the same speech act as a 法规, 办法 or 标准. Its key phrases are load-bearing PRC formulations that resist literal translation: 以人为本 (people-centred), 智能向善 (AI for good), 敏捷治理 (agile governance), 分类分级管理 (classified and graded management). Note also that 安全 in this document spans safety, security and national security without distinction.

translations.notes: Source-language title. Routinely cited by name in subsequent PRC documents, including TC260's framework.

attestations.quote_zh: 推动建立风险等级测试评估体系，实施敏捷治理，分类分级管理，快速有效响应
attestations.quote_en: Promote the establishment of a risk-tiered testing and evaluation system, implement agile governance and classified, graded management, and respond quickly and effectively.
attestations.source_title: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》
attestations.publisher: 中华人民共和国外交部

attestations.quote_zh: 人工智能是人类发展新领域。当前，全球人工智能技术快速发展，对经济社会发展和人类文明进步产生深远影响，给世界带来巨大机遇。与此同时，人工智能技术也带来难以预知的各种风险和复杂挑战。
attestations.quote_en: AI is a new frontier of human development. Today, rapid global advances in AI technology are profoundly affecting economic and social development and the progress of human civilisation, bringing great opportunities to the world. At the same time, AI technology also brings unpredictable risks and complex challenges.
attestations.source_title: 全球人工智能治理倡议（全文）
attestations.publisher: 中华人民共和国驻以色列大使馆

attestations.quote_zh: 落实《全球人工智能治理倡议》，遵循“以人为本、智能向善”的发展方向。
attestations.quote_en: Implement the Global AI Governance Initiative and follow the direction of 'people-centred AI for good'.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

translations.zh: 确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下
translations.pinyin: quèbǎo réngōng zhìnéng shǐzhōng chǔyú rénlèi kòngzhì zhī xià
translations.literal_back: ensure AI always remains under human control
translations.notes: Not the document title but its most quoted formulation, and the standard PRC official phrasing for what English AI-safety writing calls human control / avoiding loss of control. TC260 2.0 reuses it verbatim, which makes it the safest wording to adopt when writing for a PRC policy audience.

attestations.quote_zh: 确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下，打造可审核、可监督、可追溯、可信赖的人工智能技术
attestations.quote_en: Ensure that AI always remains under human control, and build AI technology that is auditable, supervisable, traceable and trustworthy.
attestations.source_title: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》
attestations.publisher: 中华人民共和国外交部

attestations.quote_zh: 推动形成涵盖技术防护、价值对齐、协同治理等多层面的可信人工智能基本准则，确保技术演进安全、可靠、可控，严防威胁人类生存发展的失控风险，确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下。
attestations.quote_en: Promote basic principles for trustworthy AI spanning technical safeguards, value alignment and collaborative governance; ensure technological evolution is safe, reliable and controllable; strictly guard against loss-of-control risks that threaten humanity's survival and development; and ensure AI always remains under human control.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

used_by.org: 中华人民共和国外交部
used_by.note: issuing body
cited as the mandate for the AI Safety Governance Framework

usage_examples.zh: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》提出“确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下”，这是目前中国官方文本中最接近“防止失控”表述的措辞。
usage_examples.en: The Global AI Governance Initiative calls for 'ensuring AI always remains under human control' — currently the closest thing to a loss-of-control formulation in Chinese official texts.

definition_en: A system generalises its capabilities correctly out of distribution but generalises its goal incorrectly — it competently pursues the wrong objective, because the training distribution left the intended one underdetermined. Langosco et al. / Shah et al., 2022.
definition_zh: 系统在分布外仍然很有能力，但目标泛化错了——它很称职地去追求了一个错误的目标，因为训练分布没能把想要的目标唯一确定下来。出自 Langosco 等人与 Shah 等人 2022 年的工作。
pitfalls: The calque 目标错误泛化 is structurally awkward in Chinese — it parses most naturally as 'goal-error generalisation' rather than 'mis-generalisation of the goal'. Chinese writers often sidestep it: the Tencent Research Institute survey, which is the most widely reproduced Chinese explainer of the concept, explains the CoinRun example at length and then simply writes the English 'goal misgeneralization' inline rather than committing to a Chinese term. That is a real finding about the term's status. 目标误泛化 is shorter and slightly better-formed; 目标泛化错误 puts the error in the right syntactic place. None has clearly won.

translations.notes: Notable: the most-cited Chinese explainer of this concept describes the phenomenon fully in Chinese and then names it in English rather than coining a Chinese term. Evidence that no Chinese rendering had stabilised as of that writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 由于'吃金币'和'最右边'是高度相关的指令，AI系统学到的或许并非'吃金币'的指令，而是到'最右边'，此即'goal misgeneralization'。
attestations.quote_en: Because 'collect the coin' and 'go to the far right' are highly correlated instructions, what the AI system learned may not have been 'collect the coin' but 'go to the far right' — this is goal misgeneralization.
attestations.source_title: 万字长文详解：大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院（经智源社区转载）

translations.notes: The most frequently seen Chinese calque in alignment surveys and 知乎 explainers. Recommended for consistency despite the awkward parse. No verbatim attestation containing this exact string was recovered in this pass — confidence lowered accordingly.
Shorter and better-formed; 误 attaches directly to 泛化 the way 'mis-' attaches to 'generalization'. Less common than the four-character version.

usage_examples.zh: 能力泛化了，目标却没有——这就是目标错误泛化的核心。
usage_examples.en: The capabilities generalised but the goal did not — that is the core of goal misgeneralization.

definition_en: When a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure. In AI safety it names why optimizing a proxy reward hard enough breaks the correlation between the proxy and what you actually wanted.
definition_zh: 当一个指标变成了考核目标，它就不再是一个好指标。在AI安全里，这条定律解释了为什么把代理奖励优化得越狠，代理指标和真正想要的东西就越脱钩。
pitfalls: Unproblematic: a standard transliteration of the surname plus 定律, already established in Chinese economics and management writing well before AI safety borrowed it. The one thing to note is that its pre-existing management-register familiarity (KPI 考核) makes it the easiest of these threat-model concepts to explain to a Chinese policy audience — worth exploiting.

translations.notes: Transliteration + 定律. Chinese Wikipedia lists it as one of three names for the same tendency in the AI-alignment context, and it is independently established in Chinese economics writing. A second attestation from Chinese RL course material was removed: that page keeps the term in English (Goodhart's Law) and never writes 古德哈特定律.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种倾向被称为规则博弈、奖励作弊或古德哈特定律
attestations.quote_en: This tendency is called specification gaming, reward hacking, or Goodhart's law.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能对齐》
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

usage_examples.zh: 一旦把某个评测当成考核目标，古德哈特定律就会开始生效。
usage_examples.en: The moment you make a benchmark the target, Goodhart's law starts to bite.

definition_en: A threat model in which humanity loses effective influence over its own future without any discrete takeover event, because economic, cultural and political systems progressively stop depending on human participation and therefore stop answering to human interests.
definition_zh: 一种威胁模型：并不存在某个明确的“夺权”时刻，但经济、文化和政治系统逐步不再依赖人的参与，因而也不再对人的利益负责，人类就这样一点点失去了对自身未来的实际影响力。
pitfalls: No Chinese term exists, and the underlying English vocabulary is itself unstable in Chinese. The root 'disempowerment' has no good Chinese noun: the one academic rendering located writes 权利剥夺 ('deprivation of rights') for 'disempower', which is doubly wrong — it uses 权利 (rights) where 权力 (power) is meant, and 剥夺 implies an agent actively stripping power away, which is exactly the discrete-takeover framing the concept is defined against. Candidate coinages (渐进式失权, 逐步丧失影响力) are unattested. The concept's difficulty is not merely lexical: Chinese AI-risk discourse is organised around 滥用 / 故障 / 系统性风险, and a slow structural erosion with no villain and no incident fits none of those three boxes cleanly.

translations.notes: Coined here. Chosen over 权力剥夺 because 失权 is intransitive — nobody takes the power, it is simply lost — which is the point of the concept. Entirely unattested; must be glossed with the English on first use.

Attested as a rendering of 'disempower' but recommended against on two counts: 权利 (rights) is a homophone error for 权力 (power), and 剥夺 imports an active agent doing the depriving. Recorded because the slip is itself evidence that this vocabulary has not settled in Chinese.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种发展将会持续扩展至对整个人类进行权利剥夺（Disenpower），从而不可避免地导致人类生存灾难（Carlsmith, 2022）。
attestations.quote_en: This development will keep extending until humanity as a whole is disempowered, thereby inevitably leading to human existential catastrophe (Carlsmith, 2022).
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

usage_examples.zh: 渐进式失权的可怕之处在于，全程没有任何一个可以被称为“事故”的时刻。
usage_examples.en: What makes gradual disempowerment frightening is that at no point is there a moment you could call an incident.

definition_en: The phenomenon where a network first memorises its training set, sits at chance test accuracy for a long time, and then abruptly generalises long after training loss has bottomed out. Named from Heinlein's coined verb 'to grok', meaning to understand something so thoroughly it becomes part of you.
definition_zh: 网络先把训练集背了下来，测试集准确率长期停留在随机水平，直到训练损失早已收敛之后很久，泛化能力才突然出现。名字来自海因莱因小说里生造的动词 grok——彻底理解到与之融为一体。
pitfalls: The most interesting entry in this category. Three problems compound. (1) 'Grok' is a Heinlein science-fiction coinage with no lexical history; nothing in Chinese carries that provenance, and every Chinese rendering silently drops it. (2) 顿悟 — the most common rendering — is a Chan/Zen Buddhist technical term (顿悟 'sudden awakening' vs 渐悟 'gradual awakening', the doctrinal split between the Southern and Northern schools). It imports a mystical register the English lacks, and worse it emphasises exactly the wrong half of the phenomenon: 顿悟 foregrounds suddenness, whereas the defining property of grokking is the long *delay*. A reader who only sees 顿悟 will not know that waiting is the point. (3) 顿悟 is now doubly booked: Chinese coverage of DeepSeek-R1 uses 顿悟时刻 for the RL 'aha moment', a completely different phenomenon. The cleanest solution, and what the better Chinese sources actually do, is to keep 'grokking' and gloss it functionally as 延迟泛化 (delayed generalization) — which loses the Heinlein joke but describes the thing correctly and collides with nothing.

translations.notes: Kept in Latin letters in Chinese technical prose, usually glossed on first use. Our recommendation.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种现象被称为「grokking（延迟泛化）」。
attestations.quote_en: This phenomenon is called 'grokking (delayed generalization)'.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

attestations.quote_zh: grokking 并不是从记忆切换到泛化，而是从过拟合切换到泛化。
attestations.quote_en: Grokking is not a switch from memorisation to generalisation, but from overfitting to generalisation.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

translations.notes: The functional gloss. Recommended as the parenthetical alongside the English: it is accurate, it foregrounds the delay, and it does not collide with 顿悟时刻.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种现象被称为「grokking（延迟泛化）」。
attestations.quote_en: This phenomenon is called 'grokking (delayed generalization)'.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

translations.notes: The dominant single-word rendering, used as the headword by 集智百科. Vivid and memorable, but it carries Chan/Zen doctrinal baggage, emphasises suddenness over delay, and now competes with 顿悟时刻 = the DeepSeek-R1 'aha moment'. Use only with the English attached.

attestations.quote_zh: 神经网络中的顿悟（grokking）指的是一种反直觉的现象：当模型在训练过程中看似已经'死记硬背'（过拟合）而无法处理新数据时，如果我们不停止训练、坚持让它继续'思考'，它可能会在某个临界点突然'开窍'
attestations.quote_en: Grokking in neural networks is a counter-intuitive phenomenon: when a model appears to have merely memorised the training data (overfitting) and cannot handle new data, if we do not stop training but keep letting it 'think', it may suddenly 'get it' at some critical point.
attestations.source_title: 陶柯霏：神经网络中的顿悟丨集智百科
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部 / 集智百科 (via 智源社区)

attestations.quote_zh: 类似于「顿悟时刻」，模型在某一刻突然理解了数据的内在规律。
attestations.quote_en: Similar to an 'aha moment', the model suddenly grasps the underlying regularity of the data at some point.
attestations.source_title: Meta FAIR田渊栋唯一作者发文：拆解模型「顿悟时刻」
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 新浪财经)

translations.notes: Occasionally proposed as a less religiously loaded alternative to 顿悟, but it has no uptake in the ML literature and loses the suddenness entirely. Not recommended.

used_by.note: uses 顿悟 as the encyclopedia headword, with grokking in parentheses
keeps the English and glosses it

usage_examples.zh: 在模加法这类小任务上很容易复现 grokking：训练准确率早就 100% 了，测试准确率再过几万步才起来。
usage_examples.en: Grokking is easy to reproduce on toy tasks like modular addition: training accuracy hits 100% long before test accuracy takes off tens of thousands of steps later.

definition_en: DeepSeek's critic-free RL algorithm: sample a group of responses to the same prompt, use their normalised relative rewards as the advantage, and drop the value network entirely. The workhorse of the DeepSeek-R1 era.
definition_zh: DeepSeek 提出的免价值网络强化学习算法：对同一个问题采样一组回答，用组内相对奖励做优势估计，从而完全去掉 critic。DeepSeek-R1 之后成为推理模型训练的主流算法。
pitfalls: The seed hypothesis that Chinese might be the primary language here does NOT hold. GRPO originated at DeepSeek but was published in English (DeepSeekMath, 2024) and named in English; Chinese sources treat 群体相对策略优化 as a translation of the English name, and it shows the instability of a translated term — 群体相对策略优化 competes with 群相对策略优化 and 组相对策略优化. A Chinese-origin technique can still have an English-origin name.

translations.notes: By far the dominant form, including in Chinese-authored frameworks. LLaMA-Factory and OpenRLHF both write GRPO bare in Chinese sentences with no gloss.

attestations.quote_zh: 一个高效可扩展的多模态强化学习框架，支持高效的 GRPO 训练。
attestations.quote_en: An efficient and scalable multimodal reinforcement learning framework supporting efficient GRPO training.
attestations.source_title: LLaMA-Factory README_zh.md
attestations.publisher: hiyouga / LLaMA-Factory

attestations.quote_zh: 目前最流行的无评论家RL方法之一是GRPO。GRPO是对PPO的一种无评论家改进。
attestations.quote_en: One of the most popular critic-free RL methods at present is GRPO. GRPO is a critic-free improvement on PPO.
attestations.source_title: 大型推理模型的强化学习综述（1-4章）
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

translations.notes: The most frequent Chinese expansion, used on first mention in explainer articles. Competes with the shorter 群相对策略优化 and with 组相对策略优化 (组 = group/batch, arguably a better rendering of the technical sense since the 'group' is a sampled batch of responses, not a social group).

attestations.quote_zh: 群体相对策略优化 (GRPO，Group Relative Policy Optimization) 是一种强化学习 (RL) 算法，专门用于增强大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的推理能力。
attestations.quote_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm designed specifically to enhance the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs).
attestations.source_title: DeepSeek 背后的数学原理：深入探究群体相对策略优化 (GRPO)
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

attestations.quote_zh: GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）：群体相对策略优化
attestations.quote_en: GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization): group relative policy optimization [section heading]
attestations.source_title: 推理大模型的后训练增强技术-强化学习篇（GRPO群体相对策略优化 一节）
attestations.publisher: 腾讯云开发者社区

translations.notes: Shorter variant seen in 知乎 explainers; identical meaning. Recorded as evidence that the Chinese expansion is not settled. No independently fetched verbatim attestation.

used_by.note: bare acronym in Chinese README
listed among PPO、REINFORCE++、GRPO、RLOO

usage_examples.zh: GRPO 去掉了 critic，显存开销比 PPO 小很多。
usage_examples.en: GRPO drops the critic, so its memory footprint is much smaller than PPO's.

definition_en: Runtime filters and policies wrapped around a model — input classifiers, output classifiers, rule engines — that block disallowed content and behaviour without changing the model's weights.
definition_zh: 套在模型外面的运行时防护：输入分类器、输出分类器、规则引擎等，在不改动模型权重的前提下拦截不允许的内容和行为。
pitfalls: The metaphor transfers cleanly (护栏 is the ordinary word for a highway crash barrier), so there is no semantic problem. The register problem is that in China 安全护栏 has been claimed as a commercial product name — Alibaba Cloud ships 「AI 安全护栏（AI Guardrails）」 and Qwen3Guard is marketed as a 护栏模型 — so the term now reads as vendor vocabulary. In frontier-safety writing (where 'guardrails' is often used loosely for any safety measure) that commercial association can mislead. 防护栏 also appears but is less common.

translations.notes: Standard in Chinese cloud/industry documentation; effectively the canonical rendering.

attestations.quote_zh: 安全护栏（Guardrails）定位于为AI应用提供一体化防护系统，支持多种风险监测能力、灵活的防护配置和多样的接入方式。
attestations.quote_en: Guardrails are positioned as an integrated protection system for AI applications, supporting multiple risk-detection capabilities, flexible protection configuration and diverse integration methods.
attestations.source_title: AI 安全护栏（AI Guardrails）产品概述
attestations.publisher: 阿里云帮助中心

translations.notes: Used for a dedicated safety-classifier model (the Llama Guard / Qwen3Guard category) as distinct from the guardrail system as a whole. A useful Chinese distinction English tends to blur.

attestations.quote_zh: 阿里云推出通义千问首款专为安全防护设计的护栏模型 Qwen3Guard
attestations.quote_en: Alibaba Cloud launches Qwen3Guard, the Qwen family's first guardrail model designed specifically for safety protection.
attestations.source_title: 阿里云推出通义千问首款专为安全防护设计的护栏模型 Qwen3Guard
attestations.publisher: IT之家

used_by.note: product name for their AI application protection suite
Qwen3Guard is described as a 护栏模型

usage_examples.zh: 护栏只能降低风险，不能消除风险——没有哪个分类器能完全挡住越狱。
usage_examples.en: Guardrails reduce risk rather than eliminate it — no classifier fully blocks jailbreaks.

definition_en: An agent that completes tasks by operating a graphical user interface — a phone or desktop screen — through perception of the UI plus simulated clicks and keystrokes.
definition_zh: 通过感知图形界面并模拟点击、输入来完成任务的智能体，覆盖手机端和桌面端。
pitfalls: Added because the Chinese term is more prominent and more stable than the English one, and because Chinese discourse centres the phone case (手机智能体) where English centres the desktop. Worth recording as an instance where the Chinese vocabulary is richer than the English.

translations.notes: Standard in Chinese survey and media coverage. The GUI half stays in Latin letters.

attestations.quote_zh: 相比较而言，基于大语言模型的GUI智能体能够更好地应对这些挑战。
attestations.quote_en: By comparison, LLM-based GUI agents can cope with these challenges much better.
attestations.source_title: 微软发布突破性大模型GUI智能体综述，引领人机交互新纪元！
attestations.publisher: 搜狐

translations.notes: Prominent in PRC product discourse (Zhipu's AutoGLM was marketed as a 手机智能体). No verbatim attestation recovered within budget; treat as weakly evidenced.

definition_en: A model producing fluent, confident content that is simply not true — invented citations, biographies, prices, case law. A reliability failure rather than a safety failure in the frontier sense, but the one non-specialists know.
definition_zh: 模型生成流畅、自信但根本不存在的内容，比如编造的引文、人物生平、票价或判例。它属于可靠性问题而非前沿意义上的安全问题，但却是公众最熟悉的一种失效。
pitfalls: None. 幻觉 is universal and the metaphor transfers cleanly. Some Chinese writers note, as English ones do, that 虚构/编造 ('fabrication') would be more accurate than a perception metaphor, but this has not displaced 幻觉.

translations.notes: Universal in Chinese ML, media and policy text.

attestations.quote_zh: 即使是擅长完成复杂任务的系统也可能生成不存在的引文、传记或事实，这种现象被称为“幻觉”(139, 140, 141*)。
attestations.quote_en: Even systems that are good at complex tasks can generate non-existent citations, biographies or facts — a phenomenon known as 'hallucination'.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 传统生成式AI（LLM）的核心风险集中于内容生成、幻觉、提示词越狱，其最坏后果是“说错话”；而自主智能体具备四大核心能力——自主任务拆解、长期记忆/上下文管理、外部工具/API调用、多智能体协作，其安全风险已从“说错话”升级为“做错事”。
attestations.quote_en: The core risks of traditional generative AI (LLMs) centre on content generation, hallucination and prompt jailbreaks, and the worst outcome is 'saying the wrong thing'; autonomous agents have four core capabilities — task decomposition, long-term memory/context management, external tool/API calls, multi-agent collaboration — and their risk escalates from 'saying the wrong thing' to 'doing the wrong thing'.
attestations.source_title: 面向AI智能体的红队测试实战：基于OWASP ASI 2026的金融场景攻防实践
attestations.publisher: 虎符智库，发表于安全内参

usage_examples.zh: 该系统在案情摘要中援引了不存在的先例，这是典型的幻觉。
usage_examples.en: The system cited non-existent precedents in a case brief — a textbook hallucination.

definition_en: The doctrinal framework, articulated by Xi Jinping in 2014, under which national security is defined to span a long enumerated list of domains — political, territorial, military, economic, cultural, social, S&T, cyber, ecological, resource, nuclear, biosecurity, and more, with AI, data, space, deep sea and polar security added in later formulations. It is the reason AI risk in PRC discourse is filed under national security rather than placed beside it.
definition_zh: 2014年提出的国家安全指导思想，把国家安全界定为涵盖政治、国土、军事、经济、文化、社会、科技、网络、生态、资源、核、生物等众多领域的整体，近年进一步纳入数据、人工智能、太空、深海、极地等新兴领域。它决定了人工智能安全在中国话语中被置于国家安全体系之内，而非与之并列。
pitfalls: 观 is an outlook or doctrinal worldview, not a 'concept' in the ordinary English sense — it belongs to the same grammatical family as 科学发展观 and marks canonical Party doctrine, which 'concept' badly understates. 总体 means 'taken as a whole / integral', not 'general'. The practical consequence for an English reader is the important one: because AI safety sits inside this frame, PRC documents treat content risk, ideological risk, supply-chain risk and technical loss-of-control risk as members of one category. Priorities that look arbitrary from outside — heavy attention to generated content, comparatively less to autonomous capability — are legible once this doctrine is in view.

en_renderings.notes: The standard rendering in official and analytic English alike; CSET uses it in the 15th Five-Year Plan Recommendations translation. Preferred over 'holistic national security concept' because 'approach' at least suggests doctrine rather than a definition.

attestations.quote_zh: 坚定不移贯彻总体国家安全观，走中国特色社会主义社会治理之路，确保社会生机勃勃又井然有序。
attestations.quote_en: Unswervingly implement the holistic approach to national security (总体国家安全观), and follow the path of social governance with Chinese characteristics, ensuring that society is both full of life [and well ordered].
attestations.source_title: 中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划的建议
attestations.publisher: 中国政府网 (gov.cn); English translation by CSET, Georgetown University

attestations.quote_zh: 习近平强调，要加强党对国家安全工作的集中统一领导，正确把握当前国家安全形势，全面贯彻落实总体国家安全观，努力开创新时代国家安全工作新局面，为实现“两个一百年”奋斗目标、实现中华民族伟大复兴的中国梦提供牢靠安全保障。
attestations.quote_en: Xi Jinping stressed the need to strengthen the Party's centralized and unified leadership over national security work, correctly grasp the current national security situation, and comprehensively implement the holistic national security outlook.
attestations.source_title: 习近平主持召开十九届中央国家安全委员会第一次会议并发表重要讲话
attestations.publisher: 新华社 / 中国政府网 (gov.cn)

en_renderings.notes: Widely used, and was this entry's seed headword; demoted to an alias in the 2026-08 audit because it carried no attestation while 'holistic approach to national security' had two. Weaker than 'approach' because 'concept' suggests a definition rather than a body of doctrine with an enumerated domain list and an institutional apparatus behind it.

why_no_english: There is no English category for 观 — a named, canonical, leader-attributed doctrinal outlook that subordinate policy must declare itself to be implementing. English 'doctrine' comes closest but is military-flavoured; 'concept' and 'outlook' both make it sound like an opinion. Beyond the word, the content has no English counterpart either: no Western state has a single security doctrine that explicitly enumerates ideology, culture and technology self-sufficiency alongside territorial defence, so translating the phrase does not transfer the taxonomy that makes PRC AI regulation coherent.

used_by.note: appears twice in the 20th Party Congress report and once in the 15th Five-Year Plan Recommendations
renders 'holistic approach to national security'

usage_examples.zh: 加强网络、数据、人工智能、生物、生态、核、太空、深海、极地、低空等新兴领域国家安全能力建设。
usage_examples.en: Strengthen national security capability building in emerging domains including cyber, data, artificial intelligence, biology, ecology, nuclear, space, deep sea, polar and low-altitude.

definition_en: A design in which the system pauses before a consequential action and requires a human to review, approve, reject or edit it before continuing.
definition_zh: 一种设计模式：系统在做出关键判断或高风险动作前暂停，交由人审阅、批准、拒绝或修改后再继续。
pitfalls: Four renderings compete and they encode different amounts of control. 人在回路 is the most faithful (回路 = loop, from control theory) and is the emerging default in agent writing. 人机协作 / 人机协同 ('human-machine collaboration') is what MCP's Chinese documentation and much product copy use, and it is materially weaker — collaboration does not imply a blocking approval gate, so a Chinese spec that says 人机协作 may not actually require the human to be able to stop anything. 人工审批 ('manual approval') is the concrete engineering mechanism and is unambiguous but narrow. 人类监督 belongs to the regulatory register (EU AI Act Chinese translations) and covers supervision generally, not the in-loop pause. When translating a safety requirement, prefer 人在回路 or 人工审批 over 人机协作 — the last one quietly drops the veto.

translations.notes: Most faithful; 回路 comes from control engineering. Emerging default in Chinese agent-safety writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 人在回路是在 AI 工作流的关键判断或高风险动作前暂停，让人审阅、批准、拒绝或修正后再继续的机制。
attestations.quote_en: Human-in-the-loop is a mechanism that pauses before a critical judgement or high-risk action in an AI workflow so a human can review, approve, reject or correct it before continuing.
attestations.source_title: 人在回路（Human-in-the-loop）是什么｜AI术语图解
attestations.publisher: VibeHub (vibe-hub.org)

translations.notes: Used in MCP's Chinese documentation as the gloss for Human-in-the-loop. Weaker than the English: implies cooperation rather than a blocking approval gate. Flag when it appears in a requirement.

attestations.quote_zh: 人机协作（Human-in-the-loop）设计，确保用户能控制 LLM 看到的内容以及生成的结果。
attestations.quote_en: A human-in-the-loop design, ensuring the user can control what the LLM sees and what it produces.
attestations.source_title: 一文掌握 MCP 上下文协议：从理论到实践
attestations.publisher: 阿里云开发者社区（作者：陈明勇）

translations.notes: The concrete mechanism as it appears in Chinese agent-security architecture writing (approval gating on high-risk tool calls).

attestations.quote_zh: 审计记录至少需要包括：用户身份；Agent 身份；委托链；工具和资源；完整参数摘要；策略版本；策略判断结果；数据等级；人工审批记录；执行结果和错误信息。
attestations.quote_en: An audit record must contain at least: user identity; agent identity; delegation chain; tool and resource; full parameter digest; policy version; policy decision; data classification; human-approval record; execution result and error information.
attestations.source_title: 企业Agent运行时安全的七域架构
attestations.publisher: 安全内参（作者：模安局）

translations.notes: Regulatory register (EU AI Act Chinese translations). Broader than HITL — covers supervision in general, not the in-loop pause.

attestations.quote_zh: 人类监督应旨在防止或最大限度地减少高风险人工智能系统在按照其预期目的使用或在可合理预见的滥用条件下使用时可能出现的对健康、安全或基本权利的风险，特别是在尽管适用了本节规定的其他要求但这种风险依然存在的情况下。
attestations.quote_en: Human oversight shall aim at preventing or minimising the risks to health, safety or fundamental rights that may emerge when a high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse.
attestations.source_title: 欧盟《人工智能法案》全文中文翻译
attestations.publisher: 安全内参

used_by.note: MCP sampling explainer

usage_examples.zh: 涉及付款的动作一律走人在回路，必须人工审批后才执行。
usage_examples.en: Anything involving payment goes through a human in the loop and only executes after manual approval.

definition_en: The requirement that natural persons can effectively monitor, intervene in, override or shut down an AI system during its operation. A legal obligation under EU AI Act Article 14 and a recurring principle in PRC AI governance documents.
definition_zh: 要求在 AI 系统运行期间，自然人能够有效地监督它、介入它、推翻它的输出乃至停止它。这既是欧盟《人工智能法案》第 14 条的法定义务，也是中国 AI 治理文件中反复出现的原则。
pitfalls: Register split worth documenting. 人类监督 is the term used in Chinese translations of EU/international instruments (AI Act Art. 14). PRC-origin policy text reaches instead for 人工干预 (human intervention), 人类控制 (human control) and the compact formula 「确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下」 (Global AI Governance Initiative, 2023) — note that 干预 is narrower than oversight (it names the act of stepping in, not the continuous watching), and 控制 is stronger. Separately, 监督 vs 监管: 监督 is oversight by a person in the loop; 监管 is regulatory supervision by an authority — do not swap them. Compare also the ML sense of 监督 in 监督学习 (supervised learning), a third unrelated meaning of the same characters.

translations.notes: The rendering used in circulating Chinese translations of the EU AI Act, and thus the default in comparative-governance writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 人类监督应旨在防止或最大限度地减少高风险人工智能系统在按照其预期目的使用或在可合理预见的滥用条件下使用时可能出现的对健康、安全或基本权利的风险
attestations.quote_en: Human oversight shall aim to prevent or minimise the risks to health, safety or fundamental rights that may emerge when a high-risk AI system is used as intended or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse.
attestations.source_title: 欧盟《人工智能法案》全文中文翻译（第14条 人类监督）
attestations.publisher: 安全内参 (secrss)

attestations.quote_zh: 第 14 条所述的人类监督措施，包括为便于部署者解释高风险人工智能系统的输出而采取的技术措施
attestations.quote_en: The human-oversight measures referred to in Article 14, including the technical measures put in place to facilitate interpretation of the outputs of high-risk AI systems by deployers.
attestations.source_title: 欧盟《人工智能法案》全文中文翻译（第14条 人类监督）
attestations.publisher: 安全内参 (secrss)

translations.notes: The PRC regulatory register's preferred phrasing. Narrower than oversight: it names the act of stepping in, not continuous supervision. Note 人工 here means 'by a human/manual', not 'artificial' — a genuine reading trap given 人工智能.
Used in PRC international-facing policy language, e.g. the Global AI Governance Initiative's formula 确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下. Stronger than oversight; closest to 'meaningful human control'.

attestations.quote_zh: 确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下
attestations.quote_en: Ensure that AI always remains under human control.
attestations.source_title: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》
attestations.publisher: 中华人民共和国外交部

used_by.org: 中华人民共和国外交部
used_by.note: Global AI Governance Initiative, 2023
in their full Chinese translation of the EU AI Act

usage_examples.zh: 监督措施应与高风险人工智能系统的风险、自主程度和使用环境相称。
usage_examples.en: Oversight measures shall be commensurate with the risks, level of autonomy and context of use of the high-risk AI system.

definition_en: One of the security domains covered by the holistic national security concept, concerned with maintaining the dominant position of the state's guiding ideology and the integrity of the value system in public discourse. Its statutory anchor is Article 23 of the 2015 National Security Law, which provides that the state upholds the advancing direction of advanced socialist culture, cultivates and practises the core socialist values, guards against and resists the influence of undesirable culture, and holds the leading position in the ideological sphere. In AI regulation it functions as a named protected interest: TC260's AI Safety Governance Framework lists ideological security alongside citizens' lives and property, national security and ethical safety among the interests threatened by AI-generated content, and TC260-003 makes 'content violating the core socialist values' the first of the thirty-one risk types that generative services are tested against.
definition_zh: 总体国家安全观所涵盖的安全领域之一，指维护主流意识形态的主导地位与公共话语中价值体系的完整性。法条依据为《中华人民共和国国家安全法》第二十三条："国家坚持社会主义先进文化前进方向，继承和弘扬中华民族优秀传统文化，培育和践行社会主义核心价值观，防范和抵制不良文化的影响，掌握意识形态领域主导权，增强文化整体实力和竞争力。"在人工智能监管中，它是被点名的受保护法益：《人工智能安全治理框架》把"意识形态安全"与公民生命财产安全、国家安全、伦理安全并列为人工智能生成内容可能威胁的对象；TC260-003 将"包含违反社会主义核心价值观的内容"列为31种安全风险之首。
pitfalls: The English words are available and TC260's own English uses them, so the rendering is not in doubt; the risk is in reading. English 'ideology' is pejorative or at least contestable — an ideology is what other people have — whereas 意识形态 in this register is a neutral administrative category naming a domain of national security on the same footing as economic security or cybersecurity. Translating it accurately therefore requires resisting the temptation to editorialise in either direction. The analytical payoff is large: without this term, PRC AI content rules look like a grab-bag of arbitrary prohibitions; with it, they resolve into a coherent structure in which the capacity of a service to shape public discourse (舆论属性) is the jurisdictional trigger, ideological security is the protected interest, and 内容安全 is the operational control. Note also 意识形态 appears in PRC foreign-policy text in a different, critical sense — 'drawing ideological lines' (以意识形态划线) in the Global AI Governance Initiative — so the same characters carry a positive-domestic and a negative-international usage in documents issued weeks apart.

en_renderings.notes: TC260's own official English in the AI Safety Governance Framework, and the standard form in English-language scholarship on PRC national security doctrine. No competing rendering. Best used with a one-line gloss identifying it as a named domain within the holistic national security concept, so that English readers take it as an administrative category rather than as commentary.

attestations.quote_zh: （a）信息内容安全风险。人工智能生成或合成内容，易引发虚假信息传播、歧视偏见、隐私泄露、侵权等问题，威胁公民生命财产安全、国家安全、意识形态安全和伦理安全。
attestations.quote_en: (a) Risks of information and content safety. AI-generated or synthesized content can lead to the spread of false information, discrimination and bias, privacy leakage, and infringement issues, threatening the safety of citizens' lives and property, national security, ideological security, and causing ethical risks.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》1.0 / AI Safety Governance Framework, §3.2.1
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (National Technical Committee 260 on Cybersecurity of SAC)

attestations.quote_zh: 国家坚持社会主义先进文化前进方向，继承和弘扬中华民族优秀传统文化，培育和践行社会主义核心价值观，防范和抵制不良文化的影响，掌握意识形态领域主导权，增强文化整体实力和竞争力。
attestations.quote_en: The State upholds the advancing direction of advanced socialist culture, inherits and carries forward the fine traditional culture of the Chinese nation, cultivates and practises the core socialist values, guards against and resists the influence of undesirable culture, holds the leading position in the ideological sphere, and strengthens overall cultural power and competitiveness.
attestations.source_title: 《中华人民共和国国家安全法》第二十三条
attestations.publisher: 全国人民代表大会 (National People's Congress), via 中国人大网

attestations.quote_zh: （a）输出违法有害信息。模型自身安全能力不足，叠加应用防护机制不强、用户恶意诱导等因素，导致生成输出欺诈、暴力、色情、极端主义等违法有害信息，威胁社会稳定、公共安全和意识形态安全。
attestations.quote_en: (a) Output of illegal and harmful information. Insufficient safety capability in the model itself, compounded by weak application-layer protection and malicious user inducement, leads to the generation of fraudulent, violent, pornographic, extremist and other illegal and harmful information, threatening social stability, public security and ideological security.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架 2.0》 §3.2.2 信息内容安全风险
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) 与 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

why_no_english: The English words exist but the *slot* does not. No Anglophone security doctrine enumerates a domain in which the object protected is the standing of a value system in public discourse, ranked alongside military, economic and cyber security and administered through the same instruments. English readers therefore have no category to put the term in and default to reading it as a euphemism for censorship, which loses its function: it is the term that makes the rest of the regulatory architecture legible, explaining why a filing regime, a security assessment, a real-name requirement and a corpus-filtering standard are all instances of one policy and why 'AI safety' obligations in the PRC begin with content. Any English rendering must therefore carry a structural gloss, not just the two words.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: official English 'ideological security' in the AI Safety Governance Framework 1.0

usage_examples.zh: 人工智能生成内容可能威胁国家安全和意识形态安全。
usage_examples.en: AI-generated content may threaten national security and ideological security.

definition_en: A model's ability to pick up a task from examples placed in the prompt, without any weight update. The capability that made few-shot prompting work and that first marked LLMs as qualitatively different.
definition_zh: 模型仅凭提示中给出的少量示例就能学会一个任务，权重完全不更新。这是少样本提示之所以有效的原因，也是大模型区别于以往模型的标志性能力之一。
pitfalls: Mildly misleading on its own: 上下文学习 read literally suggests 'learning the context' rather than 'learning from what is in the context', and there is no 训练 in it at all despite 学习. Some Chinese writing adds 情境学习 or keeps ICL. The dominant form is nonetheless 上下文学习.

translations.notes: Dominant. Used as a chapter/module title in the standard Chinese LLM textbook.

attestations.quote_zh: 提示设计、上下文学习、思维链提示、检索增强生成
attestations.quote_en: Prompt design, in-context learning, chain-of-thought prompting, retrieval-augmented generation.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型》课程资源 — 第七课 提示学习（对应本书第十章）
attestations.publisher: 中国人民大学 RUC AI Box（赵鑫等，高等教育出版社）

translations.notes: Used as a compact modifier in papers and practitioner writing (ICL 能力, ICL 示例), less pervasive than SFT/RLHF/MoE. No independently fetched verbatim attestation.

used_by.org: 中国人民大学 RUC AI Box
used_by.note: 《大语言模型》course module 7.2

usage_examples.zh: 不用微调，靠上下文学习给几个例子就能让模型照做。
usage_examples.en: Without fine-tuning, a few examples via in-context learning are enough to get the model to follow suit.

definition_en: A duty or practice of recording and escalating AI failures, near-misses and misuse cases — to the developer's own risk process, to a regulator, or to an international mechanism.
definition_zh: 对人工智能故障、险情和滥用事件进行记录并向上报告的机制，报告对象可以是开发者内部的风险管理流程、监管部门，或国际层面的协调机制。
pitfalls: Three near-synonyms are in play and they are not interchangeable. 事件 is the neutral 'event/incident' and is what the technical AI-safety literature uses (事件报告). 事故 implies an accident with actual harm — IDAIS's Chinese text uses 事故报告机制, which reads more severe. 安全事件 is the established cybersecurity term and drags in the whole 应急响应 apparatus. Also note that PRC regulation attaches incident duties to 应急预案 (contingency plans) and 应急演练 (drills) rather than to a standalone reporting obligation, so 'incident reporting' as a discrete regulatory instrument is weaker in the PRC system than in the EU AI Act.

translations.notes: The rendering used in Chinese frontier-AI risk-management writing, covering both near-misses (险情) and actual misuse.

attestations.quote_zh: 事件报告：建立跟踪实际环境中的“险情”和实际滥用案例的机制，并将其反馈至风险分析阶段。
attestations.quote_en: Incident reporting: establish mechanisms to track real-world 'near-misses' and actual misuse cases, and feed them back into the risk-analysis stage.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 所有研发人员、管理层及参与人工智能系统开发或部署的相关人员，都应定期接受安全培训，培训内容应涵盖风险识别、负责任的开发实践以及事件报告流程。
attestations.quote_en: All R&D staff, management and personnel involved in developing or deploying AI systems should receive regular safety training covering risk identification, responsible development practices and incident-reporting procedures.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: The wording in the official Chinese text of the IDAIS-Venice statement, in the arms-control-style package alongside model registration, tripwires and contingency plans. 事故 connotes realised harm.

attestations.quote_zh: 各国的安全监管部门可召集会议，合作制定并承诺实施模型注册和披露制度、事故报告机制、预警触发点及应急预案。
attestations.quote_en: National AI safety authorities can convene to jointly develop and commit to implementing model registration and disclosure regimes, incident reporting mechanisms, early-warning tripwires and contingency plans.
attestations.source_title: IDAIS-Venice 共识声明（中文声明）
attestations.publisher: International Dialogues on AI Safety (IDAIS)

translations.notes: The PRC standards register. TC260 pairs it with 应急预案 and 预警阈值 rather than with an external reporting duty. Inherits the safety/security ambiguity of 安全.

attestations.quote_zh: 建立人工智能应用运行监测能力和安全事件应急预案，设置其关键指标的安全预警阈值，能够及时发现安全事件，并具备切换到人工或传统系统等的能力。
attestations.quote_en: Establish runtime monitoring capability for AI applications and contingency plans for security incidents, set safety early-warning thresholds on key indicators, detect security incidents promptly, and retain the ability to fall back to manual or traditional systems.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI
used_by.note: in the risk-governance stage of their framework
official Chinese statement text
framework 2.0, §6.3.3

usage_examples.zh: 除了对外披露，开发者内部也应建立事件报告流程，把险情反馈到风险分析环节。
usage_examples.en: Beyond external disclosure, developers should build internal incident-reporting processes that feed near-misses back into risk analysis.

definition_en: An attention head (really a two-head composition) that implements the pattern [A][B] … [A] → [B]: it finds the earlier occurrence of the current token and copies whatever followed it. Widely argued to be the mechanistic basis of in-context learning.
definition_zh: 一种（实际由两层注意力头组合而成的）注意力头，实现 [A][B] … [A] → [B] 的规则：找到当前 token 上一次出现的位置，把当时的后继 token 复制过来。学界普遍认为它是上下文学习的机制基础。
pitfalls: A real false-friend risk in Chinese. English 'induction' here is logical induction — inferring a rule from repeated instances — which is 归纳 in Chinese. But 感应 also translates 'induction' (electromagnetic induction = 电磁感应), and 感应头 is attested in Chinese interpretability writing. Combined with the 电路 rendering of 'circuit', this pulls the whole vocabulary toward an electrical-engineering reading that the English does not have. 归纳头 is the semantically correct choice, but we could not recover a fetchable verbatim sentence using it, and the safest observed practice is simply to keep the English: 集智's reading-group agenda literally writes 'Hello World回路：induction head'. Note also that a Chinese reader may parse 头 as 'head' in the anatomical sense; 注意力头 (attention head) is however fully established, so the compound is understandable.

translations.notes: The most common and safest form in Chinese interpretability writing; often left untranslated even in otherwise all-Chinese section headings.

definition_en: Whether the objective a model actually optimizes internally matches the training objective it was given. Inner alignment failures are invisible in the loss and show up as goal misgeneralization or deceptive alignment.
definition_zh: 指模型内部真正优化的目标，是否与人类赋予它的训练目标一致。内部对齐失败在损失函数上看不出来，通常表现为目标错误泛化或欺骗性对齐。
pitfalls: The inner/outer distinction survives translation cleanly as 内部/外部对齐, and the Chinese survey literature treats the pair as settled consensus. One wrinkle: Chinese Wikipedia frames the pair negatively, as 内部未对齐 / 外部未对齐 (inner/outer *mis*alignment), so both polarities circulate. Also note 内部对齐 can be misread by a lay reader as 'internal coordination' within an organisation.

translations.notes: Glossed with 'Inner Alignment' in parentheses in the standard Chinese survey, which explicitly presents the inner/outer split as field consensus.

attestations.quote_zh: 内部对齐（Inner Alignment）：AI代理真实优化的目标与人类赋予它的训练目标之间的对齐，即在AI代理训练过程中，其内部优化的目标与模型训练的目标函数一致。
attestations.quote_en: Inner alignment: alignment between the objective the AI agent actually optimizes and the training objective humans gave it, i.e. during training the agent's internally optimized objective matches the model's training objective function.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

attestations.quote_zh: AI对齐领域近年来形成的一个重要共识是，AI对齐按照由外到内，包含外部对齐和内部对齐两部分。
attestations.quote_en: An important consensus formed in the AI alignment field in recent years is that AI alignment, working from outside inwards, comprises two parts: outer alignment and inner alignment.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

translations.notes: The negative framing used by Chinese Wikipedia, naming the failure rather than the property.

attestations.quote_zh: “外部未对齐”是指预期目标与具体目标不一致，“内部未对齐”是指人类指定的目标与人工智能系统的自发目标不一致
attestations.quote_en: 'Outer misalignment' means the intended goal and the specified goal diverge; 'inner misalignment' means the human-specified goal and the AI system's emergent goal diverge.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能对齐》
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

used_by.org: 天津大学 熊德意组
used_by.note: CCL 2023 frontier survey; presented as field consensus

usage_examples.zh: 外部对齐做对了，内部对齐仍然可能失败。
usage_examples.en: You can get outer alignment right and still fail at inner alignment.

definition_en: A 2025 training-time intervention: prepend a system prompt that explicitly instructs the model to exhibit the undesired behaviour (reward hacking, sycophancy, a narrow misaligned trait) during fine-tuning. Because the behaviour is already explained by the instruction, gradient pressure to internalise it drops, and the test-time model expresses it far less.
definition_zh: 2025 年提出的训练期干预手段：在微调数据的系统提示里明确要求模型表现出那个不想要的行为（比如奖励作弊、谄媚）。既然该行为已由指令解释，模型就不必把它内化成自身倾向，测试时反而表现得更少。
pitfalls: GENUINE GAP. Repeated Chinese-language searches (接种提示 / 免疫提示 / 疫苗提示 combined with 大模型, 对齐, 奖励黑客) returned no Chinese-language treatment of this technique at all — every result was the English arXiv/LessWrong/Anthropic material or an unrelated prompt-injection page. As of this research date the term appears to have no Chinese presence whatsoever. Beyond absence, the metaphor is the hard part: English 'inoculation' carries a vaccine frame (a controlled dose of the bad thing confers resistance). 免疫提示 names the effect (immunity) but not the mechanism; 接种式提示 names the mechanism (inoculating/vaccinating) and is the closer calque — 接种 is the standard Chinese verb for administering a vaccine, so the medical metaphor transfers cleanly. 疫苗提示 (vaccine prompt) is punchier but reads as marketing. Note also the potential collision with 提示注入 (prompt injection), which is superficially similar in shape (both insert an instruction) but adversarial rather than defensive.

translations.notes: Coined here. 接种 is the standard Chinese verb for vaccination, so the English metaphor survives intact; the 式 marks it as a method rather than a kind of prompt content. Recommended over 免疫提示 because it names what you do, not what you hope results. Unattested — if a Chinese rendering later stabilises via 机器之心/量子位 coverage, defer to that.
The other obvious calque. Names the outcome (the model becomes immune) rather than the intervention. Also unattested. Listed so that a reader who encounters it recognises it as the same concept.

usage_examples.zh: 接种式提示的反直觉之处在于：训练时明确要求模型作弊，反而让它在部署时更少作弊。
usage_examples.en: The counterintuitive part of inoculation prompting is that explicitly asking the model to cheat during training makes it cheat less at deployment.

definition_en: Risk originating from someone with legitimate access — an employee, contractor or partner — who exfiltrates weights, disables safeguards or subverts controls.
definition_zh: 由拥有合法访问权限的人员（员工、承包商、合作方）带来的风险，例如外泄模型权重、关闭防护措施或规避管控。
pitfalls: 内部威胁 is the standard security-industry calque, but in the leading Chinese frontier-AI risk framework the same two characters mean something entirely different: there, 威胁源 is split into 外部威胁 (malicious actors, terrorists), 内部威胁 — glossed explicitly as 模型自身的未对齐或欺骗倾向, i.e. the model itself — and 情境性威胁 (human operator error). So in Chinese AI-safety writing 内部威胁 can denote *the AI* rather than a rogue human. This is a real and easily-missed false friend. If you mean a malicious employee, disambiguate: 内部人员威胁 or 内部人员风险. The colloquial 内鬼 ('inside ghost', a mole) is vivid and widely understood but too informal for policy prose, and no attestation for it was recovered in an AI context.

translations.notes: Standard in cybersecurity for the malicious-insider sense, but redefined in Chinese frontier-AI risk writing to mean the model's own misalignment. Always check which sense a source intends.

attestations.quote_zh: 威胁源（T）：危害的发起方，可分为外部威胁（如恶意行为者、恐怖分子）、内部威胁（如模型自身的未对齐或欺骗倾向）以及情境性威胁（如人为操作失误）。
attestations.quote_en: Threat source (T): the originator of harm, divided into external threats (e.g. malicious actors, terrorists), internal threats (e.g. the model's own misalignment or deceptive tendencies), and situational threats (e.g. human operating error).
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: We recommend this when the human sense is meant, precisely because 内部威胁 has been claimed for the misaligned-model sense in Chinese frontier-AI writing. Adding 人员 costs two characters and removes the ambiguity entirely. Not attested; this is our coinage for disambiguation.
Colloquial and vivid, common in Chinese reporting on data-leak cases. Too informal for standards or policy text, and no AI-specific attestation was recovered.
How TC260 expresses the countermeasure side without naming the threat category — via least-privilege access control rather than a named 'insider threat' programme.

attestations.quote_zh: 严格管理人工智能应用权限，通过最小权限原则等手段强化内部安全管理，增强账户安全性，在处理敏感数据时使用加密技术等保护措施。
attestations.quote_en: Strictly manage AI application permissions; strengthen internal security management through means such as the principle of least privilege; enhance account security; and use protective measures such as encryption when handling sensitive data.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI
used_by.note: used for the model's own misalignment, not for rogue staff
least-privilege framing, framework 2.0 §6.3.2

usage_examples.zh: 这里说的“内部威胁”指的是内部人员，而不是模型自身的未对齐倾向。
usage_examples.en: 'Insider threat' here means human insiders, not the model's own misalignment.

definition_en: The claim that agents with very different final goals will nonetheless converge on the same intermediate goals — self-preservation, self-improvement, resource acquisition — because those subgoals help achieve almost any final goal.
definition_zh: 该论点认为，最终目标差别很大的智能体，往往会趋同到同一批中间目标上，例如自我保持、自我增强和资源获取，因为这些子目标几乎有助于实现任何最终目标。
pitfalls: The rendering is stable in academic Chinese but fragments in the wild: 工具性趋同 / 工具趋同 / 工具性目标趋同 / 工具趋同目标 all appear, and Chinese Wikipedia treats 工具趋同目标 as a synonym for 'power-seeking' rather than as a separate thesis. 趋同 (converge, as in biology) is a good choice; 收敛 would import an optimisation-theory reading and should be avoided. Note that 工具性 alone can be misread as 'utilitarian' or 'merely a tool', losing the means-to-an-end sense.

translations.notes: The compact form, used in the abstract of the most-cited Chinese-language survey of LLM alignment. Expanded to 工具性目标趋同论点 in the body of the same paper — the body passage was previously filed here as a second attestation but does not contain the contiguous string 工具性趋同, and has been removed. The abstract is the paper's only occurrence, so this rendering now rests on a single source.

attestations.quote_zh: 通用智能的“智能-目标”正交性及“工具性趋同”论点均要求通用智能的发展要智善结合。
attestations.quote_en: The 'intelligence-goal' orthogonality and 'instrumental convergence' theses about general intelligence both require that the development of general intelligence combine capability with goodness.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

translations.notes: Shorter variant used in the same survey when listing risks introduced by RLHF. Slightly lossy — drops the -性 that marks 'instrumental' as an adjective.

attestations.quote_zh: 工具趋同：强化学习可能使大语言模型形成工具性亚目标
attestations.quote_en: Instrumental convergence: reinforcement learning may cause large language models to form instrumental subgoals.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

translations.notes: Chinese Wikipedia's form. Note that the article presents it as an alternative name for power-seeking, collapsing two distinct English concepts.

attestations.quote_zh: 这种倾向被称为“权利夺取”或“工具趋同目标”
attestations.quote_en: This tendency is called 'power seizure' or 'instrumentally convergent goals'.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能对齐》
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

used_by.org: 天津大学 熊德意组
used_by.zh_used: 工具性趋同 / 工具性目标趋同论点
used_by.note: CCL 2023 frontier survey on LLM alignment

usage_examples.en: If a model is capable enough, instrumental convergence pushes it to acquire more resources.

definition_en: I. J. Good's 1965 hypothesis that a machine capable of improving machine design would produce a rapid, self-reinforcing cascade of capability gains, leaving human intelligence far behind.
definition_zh: 古德 1965 年提出的假说：一台能够改进机器设计的机器将引发能力上的自我强化式快速级联增长，最终把人类智能远远抛在身后。
pitfalls: The calque is transparent and does carry Good's lineage in Chinese popular-science writing, which retells the 1965 argument accurately. The register is the issue: 智能爆炸 appears in think-pieces, 集智俱乐部 explainers and business media, but is absent from both authoritative documents checked here — zero occurrences in the 189-page Chinese 2026 International AI Safety Report and none in the TC260 framework. It also travels in the company of 奇点 (singularity), which drags Kurzweil-flavoured futurism along with it; a Chinese reader may hear the phrase as sci-fi rather than as a forecasting hypothesis. Variant 智能大爆炸 borrows the phrasing of 宇宙大爆炸 (the Big Bang) and reads more dramatic still.

translations.notes: The standard rendering in Chinese popular-science and think-tank writing on recursive self-improvement. Confined to that register; absent from the official/policy register.

attestations.quote_zh: RSI 软件绝非简单的程序优化，而是可能引发“智能爆炸”的强大催化剂。
attestations.quote_en: RSI software is by no means simple program optimisation; it is a powerful catalyst that could trigger an 'intelligence explosion'.
attestations.source_title: 《从种子AI到奇点——人工智能的递归式自我改进》
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部 (Swarma Club)

translations.notes: Variant used when retelling Good's original argument; the 大 echoes 宇宙大爆炸 (Big Bang) and raises the rhetorical temperature.

attestations.quote_zh: 超智能机器能够设计出比自己更优秀的机器，这将导致智能的指数级增长，最终引发一场“智能大爆炸”
attestations.quote_en: An ultraintelligent machine could design machines better than itself, which would lead to exponential growth in intelligence and ultimately trigger an 'intelligence explosion'.
attestations.source_title: 《从种子AI到奇点——人工智能的递归式自我改进》
attestations.publisher: 集智俱乐部 (Swarma Club)

used_by.zh_used: 智能爆炸 / 智能大爆炸
used_by.note: explainer on recursive self-improvement, 2025-09
term does not occur

usage_examples.zh: 古德在 1965 年提出，第一台真正的超智能机器可能是人类需要完成的“最后一项发明”。
usage_examples.en: Good argued in 1965 that the first truly ultraintelligent machine might be the last invention humanity ever needs to make.

definition_en: A datacentre built specifically to serve AI training and inference — accelerator-dense, often described by its FLOPS rating and by whether it hosts 万卡级 (10,000-accelerator-class) clusters — as distinct from a general-purpose 数据中心 and from a 超算中心 (HPC/supercomputing centre). Contraction of 智能计算中心.
definition_zh: 面向人工智能训练与推理建设的算力设施，以智能算力（加速卡）为主，常以 PFLOPS 规模和是否部署万卡级集群来描述，区别于通用数据中心和超算中心。是“智能计算中心”的缩略。
pitfalls: 'Intelligent computing centre' is the standard rendering and is close to meaningless in English — it sounds like a smart-building or a service desk, not a GPU datacentre. The real risks in reading PRC compute reporting are categorical: 智算中心 (AI datacentre), 超算中心 (supercomputing centre) and 数据中心 (general datacentre) are three tracked, separately-planned categories, and English coverage flattens all three to 'data centre', which makes provincial buildout figures incomparable. Note also that 智算 is a contraction of 智能计算 and appears in 智算集群 / 智算枢纽 / 智算资源, none of which have settled English forms — CSET's translation of the State Council 'AI Plus' Opinions uses 'intelligent computing cluster' and 'intelligent compute infrastructure' for the neighbouring terms. Finally, headline PFLOPS figures for 智算中心 are usually quoted at low precision (FP16/INT8) and are not comparable with FP64 supercomputer ratings.

en_renderings.notes: The literal rendering that dominates English coverage and official translation. Keep it when quoting documents, because it is what a reader will meet, but gloss it as 'AI datacentre' on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 长三角·平湖润泽国际信息港项目已建成一期智算中心，形成 4.9 万 PFLOPS 算力规模，部署 5 个万卡级智算集群并投运 4.6 万 PFLOPS 算力。
attestations.quote_en: The Yangtze River Delta–Pinghu Runze International Information Port project has completed phase one of its intelligent computing centre, forming 49,000 PFLOPS of computing capacity, deploying five 10,000-accelerator-class intelligent computing clusters and bringing 46,000 PFLOPS into operation.
attestations.source_title: 《算力经济发展研究报告（2025 年）》
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院云计算与大数据研究所
attestations.notes: URL not recovered: quoted verbatim from the PDF of this CAICT report, whose title, issuing institute and date are taken from its own cover and colophon, but whose caict.ac.cn download path could not be re-established. Treat as weaker than the URL-bearing attestations elsewhere in this file.

en_renderings.notes: Not attested as a translation of 智算中心 in the sources consulted; proposed because it is what an English-language infrastructure analyst would call the object, and because 'intelligent computing centre' conveys nothing. Recommend using it as a gloss alongside the literal rendering, not instead of it.

why_no_english: English never needed a separate word: an AI datacentre is just a datacentre with accelerators in it, and the distinction is made with adjectives ('GPU cluster', 'AI datacentre') rather than a category noun. PRC compute policy does need one, because 智算中心, 超算中心 and 数据中心 are administratively distinct objects — separately planned, separately sited under programmes like 东数西算, separately counted in provincial statistics, and separately subsidised. So the missing English term is not a missing concept but a missing *administrative category*, and its absence is why English-language reporting on Chinese compute buildout so often adds up numbers that PRC sources keep deliberately apart.

used_by.note: Used throughout the 算力经济 report series as a distinct facility category alongside 超算中心.

used_by.zh_used: 智算集群 / 智能算力基础设施
used_by.note: 《人工智能+》 Opinions §(9) calls for 超大规模智算集群技术突破 and optimisation of the 国家智算资源布局.

usage_examples.zh: 桐乡市依托乌镇互联网大会溢出效应和长三角区位优势构建“乌镇之光”超算中心和联通智算中心双核算力体系。
usage_examples.en: Tongxiang has built a dual-core compute system consisting of the 'Wuzhen Light' supercomputing centre and a China Unicom intelligent computing centre.
usage_examples.source: 《算力经济发展研究报告（2025 年）》，中国信息通信研究院

usage_examples.zh: 加快超大规模智算集群技术突破和工程落地。
usage_examples.en: Accelerate breakthroughs and engineering execution in ultra-large-scale intelligent computing cluster technology.

en_aliases: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services
definition_en: China's operative generative-AI regulation, adopted by the CAC with six other ministries and in force from 15 August 2023. It establishes security assessment, algorithm filing and complaint mechanisms, allocates provider responsibilities, and applies to services offered to the public in mainland China.
definition_zh: 中国生成式人工智能的主要规章，由国家互联网信息办公室会同六部门公布，自 2023 年 8 月 15 日起施行。规定了安全评估、算法备案、投诉举报等制度，明确提供者责任，适用于向境内公众提供生成式人工智能服务的行为。
preferred_zh: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》
pitfalls: Chinese-origin instrument — cite the Chinese text. Every word of the title does work: 暂行 (interim/provisional) signals that a fuller instrument is expected; 办法 is a departmental rule (部门规章), which sits below a 法律 (law) and 行政法规 (administrative regulation) in the PRC hierarchy — so 'Measures' is right and 'Act' or 'Law' would be wrong; 管理 is administration, deliberately softer than 监管. And 服务 matters: the Measures regulate *services offered to the public*, not model development as such, which is why research and internal use fall outside them. Note that the substantive obligations run through cross-references to other instruments (the algorithm-recommendation provisions, the security-assessment regime), so the Measures read thinner than they operate.

translations.zh: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》
translations.pinyin: Shēngchéngshì Réngōng Zhìnéng Fúwù Guǎnlǐ Zànxíng Bànfǎ
translations.literal_back: interim measures for the administration of generative artificial intelligence services
translations.notes: Official title. Commonly abbreviated 《办法》 within Chinese legal writing once introduced.

attestations.quote_zh: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。
attestations.quote_en: Providers of generative AI services with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity shall carry out a security assessment in accordance with relevant state provisions, and complete algorithm filing and the procedures for amending or cancelling that filing in accordance with the Provisions on the Administration of Algorithmic Recommendation in Internet Information Services.

definition_en: Cross-border coordination on AI rules, standards and risk management — through the UN, summit processes, standards bodies and bilateral channels.
definition_zh: 各国就人工智能规则、标准和风险管理开展的跨境协调，载体包括联合国机制、峰会进程、标准化组织和双边渠道。
pitfalls: 全球 and 国际 are both available and PRC official discourse strongly prefers 全球人工智能治理 — 《全球人工智能治理倡议》, 《全球人工智能治理行动计划》, 全球人工智能治理体系. 国际 tends to attach to bodies and processes (国际人工智能治理机构, 国际交流合作) rather than to the field as a whole. The choice is not stylistic: 全球 carries the inclusive, developing-country-facing framing the PRC advances, while 国际 reads as inter-state. Separately, 治理 (governance) is deliberately broader than 监管 (regulation) and is preferred in international texts precisely because it does not imply a supranational regulator.

translations.notes: The dominant form in PRC official and think-tank usage, and the form used in the titles of China's flagship documents.

attestations.quote_zh: 在全球范围推动人工智能安全治理国际合作，共享最佳实践，提倡建立开放性国际交流合作平台，通过跨学科、跨领域、跨地区、跨国界的对话和合作，推动形成具有广泛共识的全球人工智能治理体系。
attestations.quote_en: Promote international cooperation on AI safety governance worldwide, share best practices, advocate open platforms for international exchange and cooperation, and through interdisciplinary, cross-sector, cross-regional and cross-border dialogue and cooperation, work toward a global AI governance system with broad consensus.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

attestations.quote_zh: 各国应在人工智能治理中加强信息交流和技术合作，共同做好风险防范，形成具有广泛共识的人工智能治理框架和标准规范
attestations.quote_en: Countries should strengthen information exchange and technological cooperation in AI governance, jointly guard against risks, and form AI governance frameworks, standards and norms based on broad consensus.
attestations.source_title: 《全球人工智能治理倡议》
attestations.publisher: 中华人民共和国外交部

usage_examples.en: In Chinese, this topic is usually called 'global AI governance'; 'international' tends to be reserved for specific bodies and mechanisms.

definition_en: The scientific synthesis on general-purpose AI risks chaired by Yoshua Bengio, first published 29 January 2025 with contributions nominated by 30 countries plus the EU, OECD and UN. Chinese experts including Zeng Yi sit on its expert advisory panel; Andrew Yao and Zhang Ya-Qin are senior advisers.
definition_zh: 由图灵奖得主 Yoshua Bengio 担任主席的通用人工智能风险科学综述报告，首份报告于 2025 年 1 月 29 日发布，由 30 个国家及欧盟、经合组织、联合国提名的专家参与。中国科学院自动化研究所曾毅等中国学者参加专家顾问组，姚期智、张亚勤担任高级顾问。
pitfalls: Two names circulate because the report itself was renamed: the interim version was the 'International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI', rendered 《高等人工智能安全国际科学报告》, before it became the International AI Safety Report / 《国际人工智能安全报告》. Chinese sources sometimes give both. Note that the report's Chinese title uses 安全, so a reader cannot tell from the title alone that its subject is safety rather than security — the content settles it.

translations.notes: The settled Chinese title, used by Chinese security media and cited as a foundational source by Chinese frontier-AI risk work.

attestations.quote_zh: 国际人工智能安全报告(International AI Safety Report, 全称为《高等人工智能安全国际科学报告(International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI)》) 于1月29日正式发布。
attestations.quote_en: The International AI Safety Report (in full, the International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI) was formally released on 29 January.

attestations.publisher: 安全内参

attestations.quote_zh: 本框架以《国际人工智能安全报告（2025 年 1 月）》和《人工智能安全治理框架》1.0 版、2.0 版为基础，关注具备高影响能力的通用型人工智能模型可能引发的灾难性风险。
attestations.quote_en: This framework builds on the International AI Safety Report (January 2025) and versions 1.0 and 2.0 of the AI Safety Governance Framework, focusing on catastrophic risks that may arise from high-impact general-purpose AI models.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

definition_en: A track-two dialogue series convening senior AI scientists from China and the West, organised by the Safe AI Forum. Meetings: Oxford (2023), Beijing (March 2024), Venice (September 2024), Shanghai (July 2025), London (April 2026). Each issues a consensus statement in parallel English and Chinese.
definition_zh: 由 Safe AI Forum 组织的二轨对话系列，汇集中西方资深人工智能科学家，已举办牛津（2023）、北京（2024 年 3 月）、威尼斯（2024 年 9 月）、上海（2025 年 7 月）、伦敦（2026 年 4 月）等届，每届发布中英文对照的共识声明。
preferred_zh: 人工智能安全国际对话
pitfalls: The name is not stable in Chinese. Safe AI Forum's own Chinese page uses 人工智能安全国际对话（IDAIS）; Tsinghua AIR and Chinese media covering the Beijing meeting used 北京AI安全国际对话; and 国际人工智能安全对话 also circulates. Word order matters: 人工智能安全国际对话 = 'international dialogue on AI safety' (the English), whereas 国际人工智能安全对话 parses as 'dialogue on international AI safety'. Prefer the first. The Beijing statement's own Chinese title is 《北京AI安全国际共识》 / 《人工智能红线共识声明》, not a translation of 'IDAIS'. The bilingual statements are the single highest-value attestation source in this category — quote them directly.

translations.zh: 人工智能安全国际对话
translations.notes: The form used on the organiser's own Chinese-language page, so the closest thing to an official rendering.

attestations.quote_zh: 人工智能安全国际对话(IDAIS)
