attestations.quote_en: Since late 2023, the International Dialogues on AI Safety have convened leading scientists and scholars worldwide to reach consensus on the risks of frontier AI systems and the governance interventions needed to address them.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能安全国际对话(IDAIS)政策指南
attestations.publisher: Safe AI Forum

translations.notes: The name of the March 2024 Beijing meeting as used by the Chinese host institutions. Note the Latin 'AI' kept inline, which is normal in Chinese technical and institutional writing.

attestations.quote_zh: 2024年3月，此次智源研究院发起的“北京AI安全国际对话”成功举办，不仅加强了中国与国际AI安全领域的交流与合作，也推动了全球AI安全技术的发展和共识形成，为我国深度参与国际AI安全合作搭建了面向世界的平台。
attestations.quote_en: In March 2024 the Beijing International Dialogue on AI Safety initiated by BAAI was successfully held; it strengthened exchange and cooperation between China and the international AI safety community, advanced global AI safety technology and consensus-building, and built a world-facing platform for China to participate deeply in international AI safety cooperation.
attestations.source_title: Hinton、Bengio、张亚勤等签署共识：北京AI安全国际对话收官，搭建中外AI安全合作平台
attestations.publisher: 清华大学智能产业研究院 (THU AIR)

translations.notes: Chinese title of the IDAIS-Beijing statement. 红线 (red line) is fully naturalised in Chinese political vocabulary, which makes it an unusually comfortable import for AI-safety argument in the PRC context.

attestations.quote_zh: 需要全面的治理制度，以确保已开发或部署的系统不会违反红线。

usage_examples.zh: IDAIS 各届声明都有中英文对照版本，是查证人工智能安全术语译法的最佳来源之一。
usage_examples.en: Every IDAIS statement exists in parallel Chinese and English, making the series one of the best sources for verifying AI-safety terminology.

definition_en: The general project of making a model's internal computation or its outputs intelligible to humans. In AI safety it is load-bearing: you cannot verify that a model is not deceiving you if you cannot inspect what it is doing.
definition_zh: 让人类能够理解模型的内部计算过程或其输出依据的研究方向。在 AI 安全语境下，它是验证模型是否"表里如一"的前提——看不懂模型在做什么，就无法确认它没有欺骗你。
pitfalls: 可解释性 is fully established but is doing double duty. In the older Chinese XAI/ML-security literature (2019-2022) it means post-hoc explanation of a prediction — saliency maps, LIME/SHAP, feature attribution. In the newer Anthropic-lineage literature it means reverse-engineering the computation itself. Chinese writers do not have separate words for these, so a claim that a system 具有可解释性 can mean anything from 'we plotted a heatmap' to 'we traced the circuit'. In the PRC policy register 可解释性 additionally sits next to 透明性 and is treated as a compliance property, not a research programme. 可理解性 exists but is rare; 可释性 is not used.

translations.notes: Universal across the academic, industry and policy registers. No competitor.

attestations.quote_zh: 可解释性被定义为向人类解释或以呈现可理解的术语的能力
attestations.quote_en: Interpretability is defined as the ability to explain to humans, or to present in understandable terms.
attestations.source_title: 机器学习模型可解释性方法、应用与安全研究综述
attestations.publisher: 《计算机研究与发展》(纪守领、李进锋、杜天宇、李博)

attestations.quote_zh: 不断提高人工智能可解释性、可预测性，为人工智能系统内部构造、推理逻辑、技术接口、输出结果提供明确说明
attestations.quote_en: Continuously improve the interpretability and predictability of AI, and provide clear explanations of AI systems' internal construction, reasoning logic, technical interfaces and outputs.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能安全治理框架【AI知识库】
attestations.publisher: 清华大学人工智能国际治理研究院 / 智源社区 (原文为全国网络安全标准化技术委员会《人工智能安全治理框架》)

translations.notes: Occasionally used as a near-synonym, and shows up in translations of NIST-style taxonomies that separate transparency / understandability / explainability. Not the field's word; recommend against it for 'interpretability'.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: 《人工智能安全治理框架》 lists 模型算法可解释性差的风险 as a named risk category
《从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来》

usage_examples.zh: 可解释性研究的目标是把模型从黑箱变成可以检查的对象。
usage_examples.en: The goal of interpretability research is to turn the model from a black box into something you can inspect.

definition_en: A model's ability to accurately report on its own internal states. Anthropic's 2025 concept-injection experiments found Claude Opus 4/4.1 could detect an injected concept in roughly 20% of trials — limited and unreliable, but above chance.
definition_zh: 模型能否准确报告自己的内部状态。Anthropic 2025 年的概念注入实验发现 Claude Opus 4/4.1 大约在 20% 的试验里能察觉被注入的概念——能力有限也不稳定，但高于随机。
pitfalls: 内省 is the established philosophy/psychology term and transfers cleanly. The one thing to watch is that Chinese popular coverage slides between 内省 (introspection, reporting internal states) and 自我反思 / 反思 (self-reflection, reconsidering a conclusion) — these are different claims, and the 澎湃 coverage explicitly flags the distinction. Also note 自省 exists and means 'self-examination' with a moral flavour (as in 吾日三省吾身); avoid it for the technical sense. Guard against the term implying consciousness claims that the research does not make.

translations.notes: Standard rendering, inherited from psychology and philosophy where 内省法 is the established name for the introspective method.

attestations.quote_zh: 发现 Claude 系列模型（尤其 Claude Opus 4 和 4.1）展现出一定内省意识，能监测并控制内部状态
attestations.quote_en: It found that Claude-series models (especially Claude Opus 4 and 4.1) display a degree of introspective awareness, able to monitor and control internal states.
attestations.source_title: AI也会"自我反思"？Claude模型现内省迹象，大语言模型认知新突破
attestations.publisher: 澎湃新闻·澎湃号·湃客

attestations.quote_zh: 大语言模型的内省与人类内省存在本质区别：它并非主观意识层面的自我反思，而是建立在内部神经活动之上
attestations.quote_en: Introspection in large language models differs fundamentally from human introspection: it is not self-reflection at the level of subjective consciousness, but is grounded in internal neural activity.
attestations.source_title: AI也会"自我反思"？Claude模型现内省迹象，大语言模型认知新突破
attestations.publisher: 澎湃新闻·澎湃号·湃客

used_by.note: 报道 Anthropic 概念注入实验，并明确区分内省与自我反思

usage_examples.zh: 概念注入实验表明模型具备有限的内省能力，但成功率不足两成。
usage_examples.en: The concept-injection experiments show the model has limited introspective ability, but with a success rate under 20%.

definition_en: A contraction of 信息技术应用创新, naming the programme and the industry built around replacing foreign components of the IT stack — CPUs, operating systems, databases, middleware, office software — with domestic equivalents, and the certified-compatible product ecosystem that results. It is the operational, procurement-level expression of the self-reliance goals stated at policy level as 自主可控 and 科技自立自强.
definition_zh: “信息技术应用创新”的缩略语，指以国产芯片、操作系统、数据库、中间件、办公软件等替代国外产品的产业与工程，以及围绕适配认证形成的产品生态。它是政策层面“自主可控”“科技自立自强”在采购和落地层面的具体形态。
pitfalls: The name is actively unhelpful. 'IT application innovation' says nothing about substitution, which is the entire content of the concept — a reader who meets the English rendering cold will assume it means innovation in applying IT. The obscurity appears to be a feature of the term's origin rather than an accident of translation. Note also the register finding below: this is a procurement, vendor and equity-research word, not a central policy word, so its absence from a State Council document is not evidence that the policy is absent — it will be expressed there as 自主可控.

en_renderings.notes: The literal expansion, used in most English coverage that bothers to render it. NOT ATTESTED here: we did not recover a primary source pairing it with the Chinese. Recorded as the rendering an English reader will meet, with confidence lowered accordingly.
Increasingly used untranslated in specialist English writing, on the reasonable grounds that the literal rendering misinforms. Not attested in this pass.
We advocate this as the gloss on first use, with 信创/xinchuang retained thereafter. It names what the sector actually does. Not attested.

why_no_english: English has 'import substitution' for the trade-policy idea and 'technology stack' for the object, but no term for a designated national sector whose reason for existing is to replace another country's stack, complete with compatibility-certification regimes, procurement catalogues and an equity-research coverage universe. Because no English-speaking economy has organised such a sector, the vocabulary was never needed.

usage_examples.zh: 提升产业链自主可控水平。
usage_examples.en: Raise the level of indigenous control over industrial chains. (The central-policy formulation of what 信创 does at the procurement level.)

definition_en: Paul Christiano's scalable-oversight scheme: decompose a hard task into easier subtasks that a human plus copies of a weaker model can handle (amplification), then distil the amplified overseer back into a single model, and iterate.
definition_zh: Christiano 提出的可扩展监督方案：把难任务分解成人类和若干弱模型副本能处理的子任务（放大），再把放大后的监督者蒸馏回单个模型，如此反复迭代。
pitfalls: Two problems. (1) The abbreviation IDA is unusable in Chinese search space: 「IDA」 overwhelmingly returns IDA* (迭代加深A*搜索), a classical search algorithm, and IDA Pro the disassembler. (2) Chinese sources overwhelmingly render only the short form 迭代放大; the full 迭代蒸馏与放大 is essentially unattested, and 蒸馏 in Chinese ML now strongly means knowledge distillation between models (and, since 2025, model-theft policy discourse), so restoring it would mislead more than help.

translations.notes: The only form with attested use. Appears as a listed member of the scalable-oversight family rather than as a topic in its own right — Chinese-language treatment of IDA is thin.

attestations.quote_zh: 关于可扩展监督比较典型的例子包括辩论（debate）、递归奖励建模（recursive reward modeling）、迭代放大（iterated amplification）等。
attestations.quote_en: Typical examples of scalable oversight include debate, recursive reward modeling, and iterated amplification.
attestations.source_title: 万字长文详解：大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院（集智俱乐部转载）

attestations.quote_zh: Paul Christiano等人提出「迭代放大」的对齐方案，即通过将任务分解为更简单的子任务的方式。
attestations.quote_en: Paul Christiano and colleagues proposed the 'iterated amplification' alignment scheme, decomposing a task into simpler subtasks.
attestations.source_title: 万字长文详解：大模型时代AI价值对齐的问题、对策和展望
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院（集智俱乐部转载）

translations.notes: Faithful calque of the full English name. We record it as proposed, not attested: no Chinese source we fetched uses it. Use only when the distillation half of the loop is actually the point; otherwise 迭代放大 is what a Chinese reader will recognise.

used_by.note: listed among scalable-oversight techniques

usage_examples.zh: 迭代放大的思路是把一个人类无法直接评估的任务，拆成一串人类能评估的子任务。
usage_examples.en: The idea of iterated amplification is to break a task humans cannot directly evaluate into a chain of subtasks they can.

definition_en: An input, or family of inputs, that gets a model to do something its safety training was meant to prevent — typically by reframing, roleplay, obfuscation or encoding the request.
definition_zh: 通过改写、角色扮演、混淆或编码等手段构造输入，使模型突破安全训练所设的限制，输出本应被拒绝的内容。
pitfalls: None serious. 越狱 arrives via the iOS-jailbreaking sense and is fully naturalised; the metaphor (breaking out of prison) survives translation intact. In agent-security writing 提示词越狱 ('prompt jailbreak') is used for the single-turn case, in contrast with multi-step agent attacks.

translations.notes: Universal. Compound forms: 越狱攻击, 越狱提示词, 提示词越狱.

attestations.quote_en: For example, researchers have shown that state-of-the-art safeguards can be circumvented through adversarial prompting methods (i.e. 'jailbreaks'), by having models decompose complex harmful tasks into steps, and through simple model modifications.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: 确保任何系统漏洞（如越狱攻击或其他攻击路径）都能被及时发现并修复，防止攻击者利用漏洞显著提升破坏能力，例如采用快速补丁修复机制，在必要时向执法机构报告，并保留相关日志以便追踪。
attestations.quote_en: Ensure that any system vulnerability (such as jailbreak attacks or other attack paths) can be discovered and fixed promptly, preventing attackers from significantly increasing their destructive capability by exploiting it.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: in the Frontier AI Risk Management Framework

usage_examples.zh: 红队测试不应只停留在通用化越狱测试上。
usage_examples.en: Red-teaming should not stop at generic jailbreak testing.

definition_en: Verifying who a customer is before granting service. In AI governance it is proposed for cloud compute providers, so that large training runs cannot be bought anonymously.
definition_zh: 在提供服务前核实客户身份的制度。在人工智能治理中，主要提议用于云算力服务商，使大规模训练无法匿名购买。
pitfalls: Three separate problems. (1) Chinese practitioners usually just write KYC in Latin letters; 了解你的客户 / 认识你的客户 are glosses, and 认识你的客戶 is the Taiwan/HK form. (2) I could not verify any Chinese-language source applying KYC to AI compute providers, so the AI-governance sense appears not to have entered Chinese discourse at all — a genuine gap. (3) 实名制 / 真实身份信息认证 is a real and heavily enforced PRC regime that partly overlaps KYC but is not the same thing: it verifies the *end user* of an internet service against a national ID or mobile number, it exists for content-attribution and public-security reasons rather than anti-money-laundering, and it has never been applied to compute purchasing. Do not use 实名制 to translate KYC in a compute-governance argument; explain the difference instead.

translations.notes: The usual form in Chinese finance and compliance writing; kept in Latin letters mid-sentence. Recorded without attestation because the sources seen were not fetched in full during this pass.
The standard mainland gloss, normally written alongside the abbreviation as 了解你的客户（KYC）. No attestation recovered in an AI-governance context; treat as unverified for this field.

The PRC-native adjacent regime, imposed on deep-synthesis service providers with respect to their *users*. Legally grounded and actively enforced, but aimed at attributability of generated content, not at gating access to compute. Colloquially 实名制 (real-name system).

attestations.quote_zh: 对使用者进行真实身份信息认证
attestations.quote_en: Conduct authentication of users' true identity information.
attestations.source_title: 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室、工业和信息化部、公安部（中国网信网）

used_by.org: 国家互联网信息办公室 (CAC)
used_by.note: deep-synthesis provisions, in force January 2023

usage_examples.zh: 对算力服务商实行 KYC，与我国现行的用户实名制不是一回事：前者约束的是买算力的机构，后者约束的是使用服务的个人。
usage_examples.en: KYC for compute providers is not the same thing as China's existing real-name system for users: the former constrains the organisation buying compute, the latter the individual using a service.

definition_en: A neural language model with a very large parameter count trained on massive text corpora, used for language tasks such as generation, translation and summarisation.
definition_zh: 指参数规模极大、在海量文本语料上训练的神经网络语言模型，用于文本生成、翻译、摘要等语言任务。
pitfalls: Unproblematic, with one caveat for the ZH→EN direction: Chinese writers very often drop to the bare 大模型, which is broader than 'LLM' (it also covers multimodal and non-language models). Rendering every 大模型 as 'LLM' over-specifies. 大型语言模型 and 大语言模型 are freely interchangeable; official translations tend to 大型语言模型, industry to 大语言模型.

translations.notes: Dominant industry form. Chinese Wikipedia lists it as an alternative name for 大型语言模型 and gives 大模型 as the short form.

attestations.quote_zh: 大型语言模型（英語：large language model，LLM），也称大语言模型，简称大模型，是一種基於人工神经网络的语言模型。
attestations.quote_en: A large language model (LLM), also called da yuyan moxing and abbreviated da moxing, is a language model based on artificial neural networks.
attestations.source_title: 大型语言模型
attestations.publisher: 维基百科（中文）

translations.notes: The fuller form preferred in official translations, including the Chinese International AI Safety Report glossary.

attestations.quote_zh: 大型语言模型 (Large language model，LLM)：一种基于海量文本数据训练的人工智能模型，用于执行与语言相关的任务，例如生成、翻译或摘要文本。
attestations.quote_en: Large language model (LLM): an AI model trained on massive text data to perform language-related tasks such as generating, translating or summarising text.
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）词汇表
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（主席 Yoshua Bengio）

translations.notes: The bare Latin abbreviation is used freely mid-sentence in Chinese technical writing, exactly as SFT or RLHF are. Both the Wikipedia entry and the report glossary carry it in parentheses alongside the Chinese term.

used_by.note: glossary

usage_examples.zh: 现代智能体通常基于大型语言模型构建。
usage_examples.en: Modern agents are typically built on large language models.

definition_en: The default Chinese umbrella noun for the post-2022 foundation-model paradigm: any large-scale pretrained model that is adapted to many downstream tasks. It covers LLMs, multimodal and vision-language models, and industry-specific fine-tunes, and is used as a paradigm label rather than a parameter-count threshold — a 4B fine-tune shipped as a product is still 大模型.
definition_zh: 指经大规模数据预训练、可适配多种下游任务的基础模型，是 2022 年以来中文语境中对这一技术范式最通用的称呼。既涵盖通用基础模型，也涵盖垂直行业模型；在中文里它更接近“基础模型/大模型范式”，而不是一个参数量门槛。
pitfalls: 'Large model' is a calque, not idiomatic English — no English-speaking practitioner says it unprompted, yet it is the rendering used in TC260's own official English text and in most translated PRC material, so an English reader meets it constantly. Two specific traps: (1) 大模型 is a paradigm claim, not a size claim, so '大模型' routinely covers models an English writer would call small (Qwen3-4B, industry fine-tunes) — reading it as 'large' imports a false size threshold; (2) it is broader than 'LLM' (it includes multimodal, vision-language-action and diffusion-family models when they are pretrained-and-adapted) but narrower than 'AI model' (a bespoke task-specific classifier is not 大模型). 'Foundation model' is the accurate English concept and 上海AI实验室/安远AI explicitly equate the two, but it is not what translations say. Also note the productive compounds — 大模型备案, 大模型安全, 通用大模型 vs 行业大模型 — which have no single-word English counterparts.

en_renderings.notes: The rendering an English reader will actually meet, including in TC260's own bilingual national framework and in Concordia AI's English reporting. Record it, but it is a calque: it reads as a size adjective in English while the Chinese is a paradigm noun.

attestations.quote_zh: 大模型应用形态从机器问答向嵌入业务流程的智能体演进, 加速与业务系统融合
attestations.quote_en: Large model application is evolving from simple machine Q&A to intelligent agents embedded into business workflows, accelerating their integration with operational systems. [official English of the same document]
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版 / AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0（中英文对照本）
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

attestations.quote_en: parallel development of general-purpose large models and industry-specific models
attestations.source_title: State of AI Safety in China (2026)
attestations.publisher: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

en_renderings.notes: The accurate English concept. The Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI framework glossary states outright that 基础模型 (foundation model) 'is commonly called 大模型 in academia', which is the cleanest attested equivalence available. Prefer this when translating for an English technical audience; keep 'large model' when quoting PRC documents.

attestations.quote_zh: 基础模型（Foundation model）：基于大规模数据进行广泛训练的通用型人工智能模型，可适配大量下游任务，在学术领域常被称作” 大模型”。
attestations.quote_en: Foundation model: a general-purpose AI model broadly trained on large-scale data and adaptable to a large number of downstream tasks; in academia it is commonly called a 'big model' (大模型).
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 作为技术核心载体的大模型已完成从技术到产品的关键跨越
attestations.quote_en: The large model, as the core technical vehicle, has completed the critical leap from technology to product.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能治理研究报告（2025 年）》
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院（CAICT）政策与经济研究所

en_renderings.notes: A more literal calque that appears in some Chinese-authored English writing. Recommend against: 'big model' has no currency in English-language ML and reads as a translation artefact. Recorded because it does occur.

why_no_english: English fragmented the concept across three words that Chinese keeps in one. 'LLM' names the modality, 'foundation model' names the training-and-adaptation relationship, and 'frontier model' names the capability tier; 大模型 does all three jobs at once and is the ordinary word a Chinese engineer, journalist, regulator and investor all use. Because English has no single unmarked term, translators fall back on 'large model', which quietly converts a claim about *how a model was built and is used* into a claim about *how big it is* — and so makes PRC statements about small industry models look inconsistent. The scope boundaries also do not line up: 大模型 excludes bespoke task-specific models that English 'AI model' includes, and includes multimodal and embodied VLA models that English 'LLM' excludes.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: Used in the 2.0 framework's preface and in its 术语 entry for 安全护栏; the document's own English renders it 'large model'.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.note: Glossary equates it with 'foundation model' and marks it as the academic colloquialism.
Used as the organising noun for the whole industry: 通用基础大模型 vs 垂直行业大模型.

used_by.org: 通义千问 Qwen（阿里巴巴）
used_by.note: Used contrastively with 小模型 in the same sentence, showing it also works as a plain relative-size word in lab writing.

usage_examples.zh: 我们开源了两个 MoE 模型的权重：Qwen3-235B-A22B，一个拥有 2350 多亿总参数和 220 多亿激活参数的大模型
usage_examples.en: We have open-sourced the weights of two MoE models: Qwen3-235B-A22B, a large model with over 235 billion total parameters and over 22 billion activated parameters.

usage_examples.zh: 安全护栏：针对大模型的安全控制措施，通过结合规则库、负面判别模型等技术手段，对大模型输入输出内容、数据泄露、提示词攻击等进行识别、拦截及处置。
usage_examples.en: Safety guardrails: safety control measures for large models that combine rule bases, negative discriminator models and other techniques to identify, intercept and handle large-model input/output content, data leakage and prompt-injection attacks.

definition_en: A regime in which an activity is prohibited unless a regulator has granted permission in advance. Proposed for frontier AI training and deployment; not the instrument China actually uses for AI.
definition_zh: 未经监管部门事先批准即不得从事某项活动的制度。国际上有人主张对前沿人工智能的训练和部署实行许可制，但中国目前对人工智能采用的并非许可制。
pitfalls: The essential point in this category. Chinese administrative law distinguishes 行政许可 (administrative licensing — prohibited unless permitted, governed by the 行政许可法) from 备案 (filing — permitted, but you must record it). China's AI regime is built on 备案, not 许可. English writing that calls China's algorithm/model filing a 'licensing regime' overstates the state's gatekeeping power; conversely, Chinese writing that renders proposals for frontier-AI 'licensing' as 备案 understates them. Keep the pair distinct: 许可 = licence/permission, 备案 = filing. 牌照 is the informal industry word for a licence-as-asset (telecom, finance) and carries a market-access connotation; 审批 (approval) is a third adjacent term. CAICT's report is explicit that traditional 物理准入许可 tools are failing for AI.

translations.notes: The legal term (行政许可 for the administrative-law concept, 出口许可 for export licences). Established generally; what is unattested is any PRC AI-specific licensing regime, because none exists.

attestations.quote_zh: 虽然研发能力集中在少数国家与科技巨头手中，但应用端却通过开源模型、云端处理等体现出低门槛、去中心化等特点，使得传统依赖物理准入许可、实体边界检查和静态合规审查的监管工具失效。
attestations.quote_en: Although R&D capability is concentrated in a few countries and tech giants, the application layer — via open-weight models and cloud processing — is low-barrier and decentralised, which renders ineffective the traditional regulatory toolkit of physical entry licensing, physical border checks and static compliance review.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能治理研究报告（2025 年）
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院（CAICT）政策与经济研究所

attestations.quote_zh: 与此同时，国会中出现了以国家安全为由加强管制的呼声，多项法案如《美中人工智能能力脱钩法案》《AI 监督法案》等均赋予国会直接否决相关出口许可的权力。
attestations.quote_en: At the same time, calls have emerged in Congress to tighten controls on national-security grounds, with bills such as the Decoupling America's Artificial Intelligence Capabilities from China Act and the AI Oversight Act giving Congress power to directly veto relevant export licences.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能治理研究报告（2025 年）
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院（CAICT）政策与经济研究所

translations.notes: Recorded here as a translation to avoid, not to use. 备案 is what China actually operates and is systematically weaker than licensing: no prior approval, no discretionary refusal in the ordinary case. Translating 'licensing' as 备案 (or 备案 as 'licensing') is the most consequential false friend in this category. See the model-registration entry.

attestations.quote_zh: 自 2023 年 8 月《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》实施以来，我国围绕生成式 AI 构建了以“备案制度”为核心的多层次治理格局。
attestations.quote_en: Since the Interim Measures for Generative AI took effect in August 2023, China has built a multi-tier governance structure around generative AI with the filing system at its core.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能治理研究报告（2025 年）
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院（CAICT）政策与经济研究所

translations.notes: Industry register, connoting a scarce market-access permit (as in telecoms or payments). Idiomatic for 'you need a licence to operate', but wrong for the administrative-law sense; use 许可 in legal or policy prose. No AI-specific attestation recovered.

used_by.note: uses both, and keeps them distinct

usage_examples.zh: 中国实行的是备案制而非许可制：企业提交材料存档，而不是事先申请批准。
usage_examples.en: China operates a filing system, not a licensing system: firms submit materials for the record rather than applying for prior approval.

definition_en: Applying the model's output head (unembedding) to hidden states at intermediate layers, so that each layer's residual stream can be read as a distribution over the vocabulary — showing how the model's guess evolves layer by layer.
definition_zh: 把模型最后的输出头（解嵌入矩阵）直接作用在中间层的隐藏状态上，于是每一层的残差流都能被读成一个词表上的概率分布，从而看到模型的"猜测"是如何逐层演变的。
pitfalls: Effectively untranslated. The head noun 'lens' would go to 透镜, but the modifier cannot be rendered: 'logit' has no Chinese equivalent in ML usage at all — Chinese papers and blogs write logit / logits in Latin letters inside Chinese sentences, exactly as they do for token and embedding. So any Chinese rendering ends up as a hybrid (logit 透镜), which is why writers mostly keep the whole phrase. Chinese explanations of the method are written descriptively ("把中间层的隐藏状态投影到词表空间") rather than with a term. Note also that Chinese sources frequently write 'Logits Lens' with an s, which the English literature does not. Do not treat 'tuned lens' as a synonym: it is a later, distinct method (Belrose et al. 2023) that trains a separate affine probe per layer precisely because applying the unembedding directly is brittle; Chinese writing keeps it in English too.

translations.notes: Kept entirely in English inside Chinese sentences; often spelled 'Logits Lens'.

attestations.quote_zh: Logits Lens能够将模型中间层的隐藏状态投影为一个logits向量，通过softmax转化为该token的概率分布
attestations.quote_en: The logits lens can project a hidden state from an intermediate layer into a logits vector, converted via softmax into a probability distribution over tokens.
attestations.source_title: Gemini Deep Research、Logits Lens深度剖析与微调应用
attestations.publisher: 科学网 博客 (李维)

attestations.quote_zh: Logits Lens为理解Transformer模型的内部工作提供了一个相对简洁直观的方法
attestations.quote_en: The logits lens offers a relatively simple and intuitive way to understand the internal workings of a Transformer.
attestations.source_title: Gemini Deep Research、Logits Lens深度剖析与微调应用
attestations.publisher: 科学网 博客 (李维)

translations.notes: A hybrid form that would be understood, but we found no evidence it is actually used. Offered only if a fully Chinese-looking rendering is required; otherwise keep the English.

usage_examples.zh: 用 logit lens 看，模型在第 20 层左右就已经锁定了答案。
usage_examples.en: Viewed through the logit lens, the model has already locked in the answer by around layer 20.

definition_en: A task requiring many interdependent steps sustained over a long period. METR measures capability as the human-equivalent task length a model can complete at a 50% success rate.
definition_zh: 需要连续完成大量相互依赖步骤、跨越较长时间的任务。METR 用「模型在 50% 成功率下能完成的任务对应的人类耗时」来衡量这项能力。
pitfalls: Three renderings are live and none has fully won: 长程任务 (favoured in 2026 academic survey writing, and the basis of 长程智能体 for 'long-horizon agent'), 长时程任务 (more literal, spells out the time dimension), and 长期任务 (used by tech media but ambiguous — it can just mean 'an ongoing/standing task' in ordinary Chinese). Separately, METR's 'time horizon' metric is rendered 时间跨度, which is a different word from any of the above, so a reader following the Chinese coverage sees 长期任务 and 时间跨度 in the same article without an obvious link. Safety-register writing (安远 AI) uses a fourth form, 长程自主性, for 'long-horizon autonomy' as a capability category.

translations.notes: Preferred: unambiguous, compositional (长程智能体 = long-horizon agent), and the form used in 2026 Chinese survey literature.

attestations.quote_zh: 长程任务的难点并不只是某一步是否答对，而是大量紧密耦合的步骤必须组成一条连贯轨迹。
attestations.quote_en: The difficulty of long-horizon tasks is not merely whether any single step is correct, but that a large number of tightly coupled steps must form one coherent trajectory.
attestations.source_title: 迈向长程智能体，人大高瓴发布149页全景综述
attestations.publisher: 新浪科技

translations.notes: The pair used in Chinese tech-media coverage of METR. 时间跨度 is the settled rendering of 'time horizon' as a metric; 长期任务 for the task type is ambiguous in ordinary Chinese. Recorded in research as “长期任务 / 时间跨度”.

attestations.quote_zh: AI在完成长期任务方面的进步速度惊人，其时间跨度大约每七个月翻一番。
attestations.quote_en: AI's progress on completing long-horizon tasks is striking: its time horizon roughly doubles every seven months.
attestations.source_title: Nature发文「智能体摩尔定律」，Agent能力每7个月翻倍
attestations.publisher: 量子位 (QbitAI)

translations.notes: Safety-register form for 'long-horizon autonomy' as a dangerous-capability category, used by 安远 AI when comparing frontier safety frameworks.

attestations.quote_zh: 长程自主性、能力隐藏（Sandbagging）、自主复制与适应、破坏安全防护等
attestations.quote_en: Long-horizon autonomy, capability hiding (sandbagging), autonomous replication and adaptation, undermining safeguards, etc.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安全内参（作者：安远 AI）

translations.notes: More literal variant, common in搜索/科普 writing. No verbatim attestation recovered within budget.

used_by.note: frontier framework comparison, OpenAI research categories

usage_examples.zh: 模型能独立完成的长程任务时间跨度还在快速拉长。
usage_examples.en: The time horizon of long-horizon tasks a model can complete on its own is still lengthening fast.

definition_en: A scenario in which one or more AI systems operate outside any human's control and there is no clear route to regaining it. Distinct from an ordinary malfunction: the system continues to act competently, just not under human direction.
definition_zh: 指AI系统的运行脱离所有人的控制，且没有明确途径重新夺回控制权的情形。它与普通故障不同——系统仍在有效地行动，只是不再听命于人。
pitfalls: 失控 is the near-universal rendering and is now locked in by both the Chinese translation of the International AI Safety Report and by PRC policy text, so it must be used. But it is a broad, colloquial word — Chinese uses 失控 for cars, emotions, crowds, epidemics and budgets — and it carries none of the technical content of the English term (no implication of a capable agent, no 'no path to regain control' clause). Note the register split: in PRC governance text 失控 usually means the *state or regulator* losing control over a technology, whereas in the alignment literature it means *humanity* losing control over an agent. Serious sources therefore gloss it on first use rather than let it stand alone; the IAISR Chinese translation does exactly this. 控制权丧失 and 丧失控制 are more precise but are not idiomatic and did not appear as fixed terms in any source located.

translations.notes: Dominant across research, policy and media registers. Used as a named risk domain by 安远AI and as the section heading in the Chinese translation of the International AI Safety Report. Because the word is broad, careful sources attach an explicit definition on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 失控情形是指AI系统的运行脱离任何人控制、且没有明确途径重新获得控制的情景。
attestations.quote_en: A 'loss of control' scenario refers to a situation in which the operation of an AI system escapes anyone's control, with no clear route to regaining control.
attestations.source_title: 《【独家选译】2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（International AI Safety Report 2026 中文选译）
attestations.publisher: 北京大学中外人文交流研究基地 / 澎湃新闻

attestations.quote_zh: 系统评估模型在网络攻击、生物风险、化学风险、有害操纵和失控五个领域的风险表现
attestations.quote_en: Systematically evaluates model risk performance across five domains: cyber attack, biological risk, chemical risk, harmful manipulation, and loss of control.
attestations.source_title: 《安远AI发布前沿AI风险监测平台2.0》
attestations.publisher: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: The verbal, unfixed form. Chinese Wikipedia's AI-safety article phrases the concept this way rather than with a noun term — but note that it splits the verb from its object (失去对高级人工智能系统的控制), so the contiguous string 失去控制 does not actually occur there; the page has zero occurrences of it and two of 失控. No attestation located in this pass.

translations.literal_back: loss of the right/power of control
translations.notes: Proposed here as a disambiguating alternative for technical prose where 失控 would be read colloquially. Not attested as a fixed term in any source located in this pass; offered only as a gloss, not as a replacement for 失控.

used_by.note: one of the five risk domains tracked by their Frontier AI Risk Monitoring Platform 2.0

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文选译）
used_by.note: §2.2.2, defined explicitly on first use

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 adds a 'preventing loss of control' principle

usage_examples.zh: 报告将失控列为通用人工智能故障风险下的一个子类。
usage_examples.en: The report places loss of control as a sub-category under malfunction risks from general-purpose AI.

definition_en: One of the three top-level risk categories of the International AI Safety Report — risks where AI systems fail or behave in unexpected and harmful ways — comprising reliability failures and loss of control. 故障风险 is the Chinese edition's rendering of 'risks from malfunctions'; it is a translated taxonomy term, not a term of PRC origin.
definition_zh: 《国际人工智能安全报告》三大风险类别之一，指人工智能系统出现故障或以意料之外的有害方式运行的风险，下辖“可靠性挑战”与“失控”两节。该词是英文 risks from malfunctions 的中译，并非中国本土分类术语。
pitfalls: The framing to be careful about is real but its provenance is the opposite of what is usually assumed. Filing loss of control under a 'malfunction' heading originates in the International AI Safety Report (chaired by Yoshua Bengio) — §2.2 Risks from malfunctions contains §2.2.1 Reliability challenges and §2.2.2 Loss of control — and 故障风险 is simply the Chinese edition's translation of that heading. It is NOT the PRC taxonomy category for loss of control. The two authoritative PRC taxonomies file 失控 elsewhere: TC260's national AI Safety Governance Framework puts '“自我意识”觉醒、脱离人类控制' under 3.3.2 伦理安全风险 (ethical safety risks), inside the 应用衍生安全风险 (derivative) tier — i.e. as an ethics-and-society risk, not an engineering fault; and the Shanghai AI Lab / Concordia AI Frontier AI Risk Management Framework promotes 失控风险 to a top-level domain of its own, defined by threat source '模型破坏控制的倾向', while routing genuine engineering faults into a separate 意外风险 (accident) domain. So the structural divergence between the Chinese and English literatures runs the other way: the PRC documents *decline* the malfunction framing that the international report adopts. Separately, in ordinary PRC engineering prose 故障风险 just means 'failure risk' (e.g. 级联故障, 单点故障) with no taxonomic force.

en_renderings.notes: The exact English original that 故障风险 translates, verified against the English and Chinese editions of the same report. Prefer this full phrase over the bare headword 'malfunction risk' whenever the term appears as a taxonomy heading — the report's own English is 'risks from malfunctions', and the singular noun phrase invites the reading that a specific engineering fault is meant.

attestations.quote_zh: 这些风险分为三类： (1) 滥用风险，即行为主体故意利用人工智能系统造成伤害； (2) 故障风险，人工智能系统出现故障或以意料之外的有害方式运行； (3) 系统性风险，源于整个社会和经济的广泛部署。
attestations.quote_en: It organises these risks into three categories: (1) Risks from misuse, where actors deliberately use AI systems to cause harm; (2) Risks from malfunctions, where AI systems fail or behave in unexpected and harmful ways; and (3) Systemic risks, which arise from widespread deployment across society and the economy. [wording of the English edition of the same report]
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组，主席 Yoshua Bengio）

attestations.quote_zh: 故障风险，包括运行失效 (§2.2.1.可靠性挑战）和失控（§2.2.2.失控）
attestations.quote_en: …risks from malfunctions, including operational failures (§2.2.1 Reliability challenges) and loss of control (§2.2.2 Loss of control).
attestations.source_title: 《2026 年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组，主席 Yoshua Bengio）

en_renderings.notes: The ordinary engineering sense, which is how 故障风险 is used outside the translated-taxonomy context — e.g. cascading failures between agents. Carries no taxonomic implication about loss of control.

attestations.quote_zh: 确保智能体行为的透明性、可追溯性与可控性，减少潜在冲突或故障风险。
attestations.quote_en: Ensure the transparency, traceability and controllability of agent behaviour, reducing potential conflicts or failure risks.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

why_no_english: Nothing is lost translating 故障风险 back into English — it is a back-translation of English in the first place, which is exactly the point worth recording. The genuinely untranslated material is the PRC taxonomies that *reject* this framing and for which English has no vocabulary: TC260's three-tier 技术内生安全风险 / 技术应用安全风险 / 应用衍生安全风险 (inherent / application / derivative), which places loss of control in the derivative-ethical tier; and the Shanghai AI Lab framework's four-way split into 滥用 / 失控 / 意外 / 系统性 risk, whose 意外风险 ('accident risk': operational failure, model unreliability or human error in safety-critical infrastructure) carves off precisely the engineering-fault content that the international report bundles together with loss of control. An English reader who assumes PRC documents inherit the international taxonomy will misread where Chinese institutions think loss of control belongs — and the answer, in both authoritative documents, is 'not with malfunctions'.

used_by.note: §2.2 heading; contains 可靠性挑战 and 失控.

used_by.org: 北京大学中外人文交流研究基地
used_by.note: Independently chose the same rendering in its selected translation of the 2026 report published via 澎湃新闻, corroborating the term but not its PRC origin.

used_by.org: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260)
used_by.note: Does NOT use 故障风险 as a category; files loss of control under 3.3.2 伦理安全风险.

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)
used_by.note: Does NOT use 故障风险 as a category; 失控风险 is a top-level domain and engineering faults sit in 意外风险.

usage_examples.zh: “自我意识”觉醒、脱离人类控制。未来，不排除人工智能出现突发的、超预期的智能化水平“跃迁”，自主获取外部资源、自我复制，产生自我意识，寻求外部权力，带来谋求与人类争夺控制权的风险。
usage_examples.en: Awakening of 'self-awareness' and escape from human control. In future, it cannot be ruled out that AI undergoes a sudden, beyond-expectation 'leap' in intelligence, autonomously acquires external resources, self-replicates, develops self-awareness and seeks external power, creating the risk that it contends with humans for control. [TC260 2.0 §3.3.2, filed under ethical safety risks]

usage_examples.zh: 意外风险：指部署在安全攸关的基础设施中的人工智能系统因运行故障、模型不可靠或人为操作不当而产生的风险，其中单点故障可能引发级联灾难性后果。
usage_examples.en: Accident risk: risks arising when AI systems deployed in safety-critical infrastructure suffer operational failures, model unreliability or improper human operation, where a single point of failure may trigger cascading catastrophic consequences.

definition_en: Reverse-engineering the algorithms a neural network actually implements — identifying features, the circuits that connect them, and the causal role each plays — rather than explaining individual predictions after the fact.
definition_zh: 把神经网络当作一段需要逆向工程的程序来研究：找出模型内部的特征、特征之间构成的回路，以及每一部分在计算中承担的因果作用，而不是事后为某个预测编一个解释。
pitfalls: Genuinely contested between 机制可解释性 and 机械可解释性, and the difference matters. 机制 = mechanism (as in 作用机制, 'mechanism of action', the sense Chris Olah intends). 机械 = mechanical / machine-like, and in ordinary Chinese 机械 carries a strong pejorative sense of 'rigid, rote, unthinking' (机械地照搬 = to copy mechanically). 机械可解释性 is a plausible-looking mistranslation that is nevertheless in real use, including in translated paper abstracts — the hint that it is 'a plausible mistranslation worth flagging' is confirmed, but it is not rare. Recommend 机制可解释性. A third common move is to keep the English inline: 机器之心 writes 'mechanistic interpretability（机制可解释性）'.

translations.notes: The better and apparently more widely used rendering in Chinese ML media and survey translations. Usually introduced with the English in parentheses on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 机制可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability, MI）逐渐发展为一个重要研究方向。
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) has gradually developed into an important research direction.
attestations.source_title: 大模型哪里出问题、怎么修，这篇可解释性综述一次讲清
attestations.publisher: 机器之心 (via 腾讯云开发者社区)

attestations.quote_zh: 机制可解释性 (MI) 是一个新兴的研究领域，旨在通过将神经网络的复杂计算分解为可理解的内部组件和因果机制来"逆向工程"神经网络。
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is an emerging research field that aims to 'reverse-engineer' neural networks by decomposing their complex computation into understandable internal components and causal mechanisms.
attestations.source_title: 定位、引导与改进：大型语言模型中可操作的机制可解释性实用综述
attestations.publisher: alphaXiv 中文导读 (arXiv 2601.14004)

attestations.quote_zh: 机制可解释性：AI显微镜动态追踪和复原模型推理过程
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability: the AI microscope dynamically traces and reconstructs the model's reasoning process.
attestations.source_title: 从黑箱到显微镜：大模型可解释性的现状与未来
attestations.publisher: 腾讯研究院 (曹建峰、杨浩然)，腾讯新闻

translations.notes: In genuine use — including in Chinese renderings of paper abstracts — but 机械 imports a 'rigid / rote' connotation that 机制 does not, and misreads 'mechanistic' as 'mechanical'. Recommend against, while acknowledging a reader will meet it.

attestations.quote_zh: 机械可解释性作为理解大语言模型内部运作机制的一种方法，引起了研究界的广泛关注。
attestations.quote_en: Mechanistic interpretability, as an approach to understanding the internal workings of large language models, has attracted broad attention from the research community.
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)
attestations.publisher: alphaXiv 中文导读 (arXiv 2503.05613)

translations.notes: Chinese ML media routinely keep the English term inline, glossing it once in parentheses. This is the single most reliable way to be understood.

attestations.quote_zh: SAE 的新兴技术正迅速崛起，成为当前最热门的 mechanistic interpretability（机制可解释性）路线之一
attestations.quote_en: The emerging SAE technique is rising rapidly, becoming one of the hottest mechanistic interpretability directions right now.
attestations.source_title: 大模型到底是怎么「思考」的？第一篇系统性综述SAE的文章来了
attestations.publisher: 机器之心Pro (via 新浪科技)

used_by.note: consistently, with English gloss
in its 2025 interpretability landscape report

usage_examples.zh: 机制可解释性希望像逆向工程一段程序那样，把模型内部真正运行的算法读出来。
usage_examples.en: Mechanistic interpretability wants to read out the algorithm the model actually runs, the way you would reverse-engineer a program.

definition_en: When the model produced by a training process is itself an optimizer, searching over options according to its own objective. The training algorithm is the base optimizer; the learned optimizer inside the model is the mesa-optimizer, and its objective need not match the base objective.
definition_zh: 指训练过程产出的模型本身也是一个优化器，会按照自己的目标函数在可能的空间中搜索。训练算法称为基优化器，模型内部学到的优化器称为内优化器，二者的目标未必一致。
pitfalls: The Greek prefix is dropped, not transliterated: Chinese uses the 内/基 (inner/base) opposition, which is arguably clearer than the English 'mesa/base' but loses the deliberate coinage and breaks the link to the source literature. Because 内 is doing the work, Chinese texts almost always gloss with the English 'Mesa-optimizer' in parentheses on first use, and practitioners frequently just write 'mesa 优化器' in mixed script. There is no settled noun for the *process* 'mesa-optimization' — Chinese names the object (内优化器) and describes the process.

translations.notes: Paired systematically with 基优化器 (base optimizer), 内目标 (mesa-objective) and 基目标 (base objective). This four-way set is the standard Chinese scaffolding for the concept.

attestations.quote_zh: 当一个被训练的模型（如神经网络）本身是一个优化器（即其本身按照某种目标函数在可能的空间中进行搜索）时，我们称之为内优化器（Mesa-optimizer），而训练这个模型的学习算法则称为基优化器（Base-optimizer）。
attestations.quote_en: When a trained model (e.g. a neural network) is itself an optimizer — i.e. it searches over a space of possibilities according to some objective function — we call it a mesa-optimizer, and the learning algorithm that trains this model is called the base optimizer.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

attestations.quote_zh: 基优化器的目标函数称为基目标（Base-objective），内优化器的目标函数则称为内目标（Mesa-objective）
attestations.quote_en: The base optimizer's objective function is called the base objective, and the mesa-optimizer's objective function is called the mesa-objective.
attestations.source_title: 《大语言模型对齐：概念、挑战、路线、评测及趋势》
attestations.publisher: 熊德意（天津大学），第二十二届中国计算语言学大会论文集（CCL 2023），中国中文信息学会

translations.notes: Mixed-script form used informally by practitioners. Not attested in a citable source in this pass; recorded because 'mesa' is routinely left in Latin script when Chinese writers want to preserve the link to the original paper.

used_by.org: 天津大学 熊德意组
used_by.zh_used: 内优化器 / 基优化器
used_by.note: CCL 2023 frontier survey

usage_examples.zh: 只有当被训练的模型本身是一个优化器时，才谈得上内目标和基目标的对齐问题。
usage_examples.en: The question of aligning the mesa-objective with the base objective only arises when the trained model is itself an optimizer.

definition_en: Harm caused by people deliberately using an AI system to do something damaging — cyberattacks, bioweapon uplift, fraud, manipulation, non-consensual imagery. The system works as designed; the user's intent is the problem.
definition_zh: 指人有意利用AI系统去做有害的事：网络攻击、协助制造生物武器、诈骗、操纵、生成非自愿影像等。系统本身按设计运转，问题出在使用者的意图。
pitfalls: Easy to translate, and worth noting *why*: this is the risk category PRC discourse is most comfortable with, because it locates the danger in a human bad actor rather than in the technology or in anyone's governance. The asymmetry is visible in how much more developed the Chinese vocabulary is here (滥用, 恶意使用, 恶意利用, 违法使用) than for loss-of-control concepts. Distinguish the two main options: 恶意使用 specifies malicious intent and is the choice of the Chinese translation of the International AI Safety Report; 滥用 is broader and covers careless or excessive use as well as malicious use, so it is not a precise equivalent of 'malicious use'.

translations.notes: The top-level risk category in the Chinese translation of the International AI Safety Report, alongside 故障 and 系统性风险.

attestations.quote_zh: 通用人工智能风险分为三类：恶意使用、故障和系统性风险。
attestations.quote_en: Risks from general-purpose AI fall into three categories: malicious use, malfunctions, and systemic risks.
attestations.source_title: 《【独家选译】2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（International AI Safety Report 2026 中文选译）
attestations.publisher: 北京大学中外人文交流研究基地 / 澎湃新闻

translations.notes: Broader than 恶意使用 — covers careless, improper and excessive use, not only malicious use. Used by 安远AI as the umbrella for cyber, bio, chem and manipulation risks.

attestations.quote_zh: 对网络攻击、生物风险、化学风险、有害操纵等滥用风险，2.0版将总安全分拆为基础安全分S1、越狱安全分S2和篡改安全分S3
attestations.quote_en: For misuse risks such as cyber attack, biological risk, chemical risk and harmful manipulation, version 2.0 splits the overall safety score into base safety S1, jailbreak safety S2 and tampering safety S3.
attestations.source_title: 《安远AI发布前沿AI风险监测平台2.0》
attestations.publisher: 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

used_by.org: 国际人工智能安全报告（中文选译）
used_by.note: one of the three top-level risk categories
umbrella term over cyber/bio/chem/manipulation

usage_examples.zh: 在三类风险中，恶意使用是目前证据最充分的一类。
usage_examples.en: Of the three risk categories, malicious use is currently the best evidenced.

definition_en: An architecture in which a router activates only a few of many feed-forward "expert" sub-networks per token, so total parameters can be large while per-token compute stays small.
definition_zh: 模型里有很多个前馈「专家」子网络，路由器为每个 token 只激活其中少数几个，因此总参数量可以很大而单 token 计算量很小。DeepSeek、Qwen 的大模型普遍采用这种架构。
pitfalls: Chinese labs writing in Chinese overwhelmingly write MoE rather than 混合专家 — Qwen's own Chinese release blog says MoE 模型 throughout. 混合专家模型 is correct and understood, but is the gloss, not the working term. Note 总参数 / 激活参数 (total vs activated parameters) as the standard Chinese pair for describing MoE size.

translations.notes: The working form, including in official Chinese-language releases by Chinese labs.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们开源了两个 MoE 模型的权重：Qwen3-235B-A22B，一个拥有 2350 多亿总参数和 220 多亿激活参数的大模型
attestations.quote_en: We open-sourced the weights of two MoE models: Qwen3-235B-A22B, a large model with over 235 billion total parameters and over 22 billion activated parameters.
attestations.source_title: Qwen3: 思深，行速
attestations.publisher: 阿里巴巴通义千问 (Qwen)

attestations.quote_zh: Qwen2.5-Max：探索大规模 MoE 模型的智能
attestations.quote_en: Qwen2.5-Max: exploring the intelligence of large-scale MoE models.
attestations.source_title: Qwen2.5-Max：探索大规模 MoE 模型的智能
attestations.publisher: 阿里巴巴通义千问 (Qwen)

translations.notes: The standard Chinese gloss; used in framework docs and textbook writing. 混合专家 without 模型 is equally acceptable.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们支持了微调最新的混合专家模型 Mixtral 8x7B。
attestations.quote_en: We now support fine-tuning the latest mixture-of-experts model, Mixtral 8x7B.
attestations.source_title: LLaMA-Factory README_zh.md
attestations.publisher: hiyouga / LLaMA-Factory

used_by.note: bare acronym in Chinese release blogs and titles
Chinese changelog

usage_examples.zh: 这是个 MoE 模型，总参数 2350 亿，每个 token 只激活 220 亿。
usage_examples.en: This is an MoE model: 235B total parameters, only 22B activated per token.

definition_en: A published document accompanying a model release that states its intended use, training data, evaluation results, limitations and safety properties. A system card covers the deployed system rather than the bare model and is where frontier labs now publish their safety test results.
definition_zh: 随模型发布的公开文档，说明模型的用途、训练数据、评测结果、局限性与安全特性。系统卡描述的是部署后的整体系统而非单个模型，目前是前沿实验室公布安全测试结果的主要载体。
pitfalls: Minor. 模型卡 / 系统卡 are settled; the fuller 模型卡片 / 系统卡片 also occurs. Chinese frontier-safety writing consistently pairs them as 模型卡/系统卡 rather than choosing one. Note a substantive rather than linguistic caveat: Chinese labs' 技术报告 and 模型卡 generally do not include the dangerous-capability evaluation sections that the term implies in a frontier-safety context, so a Chinese reader may not associate 模型卡 with safety disclosure at all.

translations.notes: Standard. 模型卡片 is the longer variant.

attestations.quote_zh: 模型卡（Model card）：一份提供有关人工智能模型有用信息的文档，例如其用途、使用指南、训练数据、基准测试表现或安全特性等。
attestations.quote_en: Model card: a document providing useful information about an AI model, such as its purpose, usage guidance, training data, benchmark performance or safety properties.
attestations.source_title: 《2026年国际人工智能安全报告》（中文版）
attestations.publisher: International AI Safety Report（国际人工智能安全报告专家组）

attestations.quote_zh: ●透明化措施：发布模型卡、研究报告或选择性开源模型权重，便于外部专家独立评估能力与风险，支持在更高授权等级下的使用场景。
attestations.quote_en: Transparency measures: publish model cards, research reports, or selectively open-source model weights so that external experts can independently assess capability and risk.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: For the deployed-system document. The Shanghai AI Lab framework treats it as a public-facing complement to a safety case.

attestations.quote_zh: ●系统卡（System Cards）：面向公众的简明摘要文件，以通俗易懂的语言说明系统的功能、局限性、潜在风险及防护措施。
attestations.quote_en: System cards: concise public-facing summary documents that explain, in accessible language, the system's functionality, limitations, potential risks and safeguards.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能前沿风险管理框架（1.0版）》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 同时，这些公司也都承诺一定程度的外部透明度，包括发布模型卡/系统卡披露模型风险评估方法和结果，引入外部专家意见，以及在可行情况下向政府监管机构提供信息。
attestations.quote_en: These companies also commit to a degree of external transparency, including publishing model cards/system cards disclosing risk-assessment methods and results, bringing in external expert input, and providing information to government regulators where feasible.
attestations.source_title: 国际五大前沿AI风险管理框架的横向对比
attestations.publisher: 安远AI (Concordia AI)，发表于安全内参

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远AI
used_by.note: both defined in the framework

usage_examples.zh: 各实验室在最新的系统卡中公示了相关安全测试结果和改进措施。
usage_examples.en: The labs disclosed their safety test results and remediations in their latest system cards.

definition_en: An open protocol standardising how applications supply context, tools and resources to LLMs, so any client can talk to any tool server without bespoke integration.
definition_zh: 一种开放协议，统一了应用向大模型提供上下文、工具和资源的方式，使任意客户端都能对接任意工具服务端，无需为每个组合单独开发。
pitfalls: The Chinese name is settled and uncontested, but the abbreviation MCP is what people actually say and write — Chinese docs typically give 模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，简称 MCP）once and then use MCP throughout. Minor variant 大模型上下文协议 appears in some media headlines. One thing worth flagging for safety readers: MCP's Chinese docs render the sampling feature's human-approval design as 人机协作（Human-in-the-loop）rather than 人在回路, so the protocol's oversight vocabulary does not line up with the HITL vocabulary used elsewhere in Chinese agent-safety writing.

translations.notes: Uniform across Chinese cloud docs, community translations and media. Almost always glossed with the English name on first use.

attestations.quote_zh: 模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，简称 MCP）是一种开放标准，旨在标准化大型语言模型（LLM）与外部数据源和工具之间的交互方式。
attestations.quote_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard intended to standardise how large language models interact with external data sources and tools.
attestations.source_title: 一文掌握 MCP 上下文协议：从理论到实践
attestations.publisher: 阿里云开发者社区（作者：陈明勇）

translations.notes: The form actually used in running text and speech after first mention.

attestations.quote_zh: 可以在开源的MCP Server网站上选择需要的工具，并配置相关环境。
attestations.quote_en: You can pick the tools you need from open-source MCP Server sites and configure the relevant environment.
attestations.source_title: Qwen-Agent README_CN.md
attestations.publisher: 阿里巴巴通义千问 (QwenLM)

used_by.note: developer community explainer
Qwen-Agent supports MCP tools

usage_examples.zh: 接一次 MCP，就能复用整个生态里的工具，不用为每个服务单独写适配。
usage_examples.en: Integrate MCP once and you can reuse the whole ecosystem of tools instead of writing an adapter per service.

definition_en: Deliberately constructed misaligned models, built so that a failure mode that is otherwise only argued about philosophically can be studied empirically. The framing is borrowed from biology's use of C. elegans, Drosophila and mice. Hubinger et al., 2023.
definition_zh: 刻意造出来的失准模型，目的是把原本只能靠哲学论证讨论的失败模式变成可以做实验的对象。这个说法借自生物学里用线虫、果蝇、小鼠做研究的传统。出自 Hubinger 等人 2023 年的提法。
pitfalls: NO CHINESE AI-SAFETY USAGE FOUND. 模式生物 is the completely standard Chinese term for biology's model organisms and is well understood, so the metaphor is available in principle. But no Chinese-language AI-safety source using it for misaligned models was located in this pass, and Chinese coverage of the underlying papers (sleeper agents, reward tampering, alignment faking) describes the experiments without ever naming the methodology. Two further hazards: 模型生物 is a wrong-but-tempting variant (it back-translates as 'model creature' and is not the biology term), and in an AI context 模型 immediately means 'the ML model', so 模型生物 will be misparsed. If you must render it, use 失准模式生物 or 对齐失败的模式生物 and gloss the biology metaphor explicitly — Chinese readers will not infer it.

translations.notes: Our coinage. Uses 模式生物, the correct and well-known Chinese biology term, and prefixes it with a misalignment marker. Unattested — no Chinese AI-safety source was found using any rendering of this term.
Recommend against. It is not the Chinese biology term (that is 模式生物), and in an ML context 模型 will be read as 'the model', making the phrase incoherent.

usage_examples.zh: 潜伏特工实验本质上是在构建一个失准模式生物，用来检验安全训练是否真的有效。
usage_examples.en: The sleeper-agents experiment is essentially building a model organism of misalignment, in order to test whether safety training actually works.

definition_en: A requirement that a model or algorithmic service be recorded with a regulator before or shortly after it goes to market. China operates the world's only large-scale live regime of this kind: 算法备案 under the 2022 algorithm-recommendation rules, extended to generative AI in 2023.
definition_zh: 要求模型或算法服务在上线前后向监管部门登记的制度。中国是目前唯一大规模实际运行此类制度的国家：依《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》开展算法备案，2023 年经《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》扩展至生成式人工智能服务（大模型备案）。
pitfalls: This is the single most important asymmetry in the category. 备案 is a *filing* — the provider submits materials and the regulator records them; it is not an approval and is legally weaker than 许可 (licensing). English coverage that renders 备案 as 'licensing' or 'approval' materially overstates it. Chinese practice further distinguishes 算法备案 (the algorithm/service, filed with CAC's national system), 大模型备案 (the generative model, handled through provincial CAC offices) and 登记 (registration of downstream apps that merely call an already-filed model). Meanwhile the IDAIS statements use 注册 for the arms-control-style 'registration of training runs above a threshold' — a third word for a third concept. Pick deliberately: 备案 = the existing PRC filing regime; 注册 = a proposed international registry; 登记 = a lighter recording step.

translations.notes: The operative PRC term. Article 17 of the Interim Measures ties generative AI to the algorithm-filing procedure of the algorithm-recommendation rules.

attestations.quote_zh: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。
attestations.quote_en: Providers of generative AI services with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity shall carry out a security assessment in accordance with relevant state provisions, and complete algorithm filing and the procedures for amending or cancelling that filing in accordance with the Provisions on the Administration of Algorithmic Recommendation in Internet Information Services.
attestations.source_title: 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第十七条
attestations.publisher: 国家互联网信息办公室等七部门（中国网信网）

attestations.quote_zh: 此次专项行动有效督促了互联网企业完成算法备案，初步建立起算法安全审查框架，大部分平台借机优化了推荐内容多样性、减少同质化信息推送。
attestations.quote_en: This special campaign effectively pushed internet firms to complete algorithm filing and established an initial framework for algorithm security review; most platforms took the opportunity to improve the diversity of recommended content and reduce homogeneous information pushes.
attestations.source_title: 互联网信息服务算法治理：从专项行动迈向常态化长效化治理
attestations.publisher: 《中国信息安全》2025 年第 12 期（安全内参转载）

translations.notes: Industry shorthand for the generative-AI service filing. Distinct in practice from 算法备案 (different forms, different reviewing office) although the two are legally linked. CAICT reports the running totals.
TC260's phrasing for registering AI systems deployed in critical information infrastructure — a lighter, security-oriented registration than the CAC service filing.

attestations.quote_zh: 对在关键信息基础设施应用的人工智能系统进行登记备案，要求其具备与安全需求相匹配的安全防护能力。
attestations.quote_en: AI systems deployed in critical information infrastructure shall be recorded and filed, and are required to have security protection capabilities commensurate with their security needs.
attestations.source_title: 《人工智能安全治理框架》2.0 版
attestations.publisher: 全国网络安全标准化技术委员会 (TC260) / 国家计算机网络应急技术处理协调中心

translations.notes: Used in the Chinese IDAIS texts for the proposed international/domestic registration of models and training runs above a compute or capability threshold. Not the PRC regulatory term — do not swap it for 备案.

attestations.quote_zh: 我们应该立即对超过一定计算或能力阈值的人工智能模型和训练运行进行国内注册。
attestations.quote_en: We should immediately implement domestic registration for AI models and training runs above certain compute or capability thresholds.
attestations.source_title: IDAIS-Beijing《人工智能红线共识声明》（中文声明）
attestations.publisher: International Dialogues on AI Safety (IDAIS)

attestations.quote_zh: 各国的安全监管部门可召集会议，合作制定并承诺实施模型注册和披露制度、事故报告机制、预警触发点及应急预案。
attestations.quote_en: National AI safety authorities can convene to jointly develop and commit to implementing model registration and disclosure regimes, incident reporting mechanisms, early-warning tripwires and contingency plans.
attestations.source_title: IDAIS-Venice 共识声明（中文声明）
attestations.publisher: International Dialogues on AI Safety (IDAIS)

used_by.org: 国家互联网信息办公室 (CAC)
used_by.note: Art. 17, Interim Measures for Generative AI

used_by.zh_used: 备案制度 / 大模型备案
used_by.note: reports cumulative filing counts
for threshold-triggered registration of models and training runs

usage_examples.zh: 备案是事后记录，不等于审批；把它译成 licensing 会高估这一制度的约束力。
usage_examples.en: Filing is an after-the-fact recording, not an approval; translating it as 'licensing' overstates how binding the regime is.

definition_en: OpenAI's published document specifying how its models should behave — objectives, hard rules, and default behaviours — used as the reference for training and for adjudicating disputed model responses.
definition_zh: OpenAI 公开发布的、规定其模型应当如何行为的文档，分为目标、规则和默认行为三层，既作为训练（尤其是 RLHF 标注）的依据，也作为判定模型回复是否恰当的参照。
pitfalls: 模型规范 is the settled rendering but is weaker than the English: 规范 in Chinese engineering usage means a technical specification or norm (like a coding 规范), which undersells that the document is a normative statement of intended values and behaviour, closer to a code of conduct. 行为规范 (code of conduct) is more accurate to the content and does appear in Chinese coverage. Also note the collision risk with 模型备案/技术规范 in PRC regulatory vocabulary, where 规范 means a formal standards document with legal weight — a Chinese policy reader may over-read the term's authority. No Chinese lab has published a direct equivalent document under this name at the time of research; Chinese labs express intended behaviour through 模型卡, 安全策略 and 使用规范 instead.

translations.notes: The dominant rendering across Chinese tech media coverage of OpenAI's document.

attestations.quote_zh: OpenAI 最近发布了其模型规范，这是一份描述 GPT 模型行为规则和目标的文档。
attestations.quote_en: OpenAI recently released its Model Spec, a document describing the behavioural rules and objectives of GPT models.
attestations.source_title: OpenAI 发布 GPT 模型规范，可作为模型微调指南
attestations.publisher: InfoQ 中文站

attestations.quote_zh: 我们打算将模型规范作为研究人员和 AI 训练者进行人类反馈强化学习的指南。
attestations.quote_en: We intend the Model Spec to serve as a guideline for researchers and AI trainers doing reinforcement learning from human feedback.
attestations.source_title: OpenAI 发布 GPT 模型规范，可作为模型微调指南
attestations.publisher: InfoQ 中文站

translations.notes: More explicit and closer to the document's actual content; used in Chinese security/policy media headlines. Recommended when the normative character matters more than matching OpenAI's product name.
Frequently retained in English as a proper-noun product name alongside the Chinese gloss, in the pattern 模型规范（Model Spec）.

used_by.note: news coverage of the Model Spec release

usage_examples.zh: 标注员判断回复好坏时，依据的是模型规范里写明的默认行为。
usage_examples.en: When annotators judge whether a response is good, they go by the default behaviours written in the Model Spec.

definition_en: Protecting the trained parameters of a frontier model from theft or unauthorised copying, since possession of the weights confers the model's full capability without any of its deployment safeguards. RAND's SL1–SL5 scale is the reference security-level framework.
definition_zh: 防止前沿模型的训练参数被窃取或未经授权复制。一旦获得权重，攻击者即可绕过所有部署侧防护措施，完整获得模型能力。兰德公司提出的 SL1–SL5 安全等级是常见参照框架。
pitfalls: 模型权重 is fully settled, so the compound is transparent — but 安全 again collapses safety and security, and here the intended sense is unambiguously *security*. Consider 模型权重防护 or 模型权重安全防护 when the distinction matters. The bigger issue is that Chinese frontier-AI practice reaches for a different reference framework: rather than RAND's SL1–SL5, Chinese guidance maps weight protection onto 网络安全等级保护 (MLPS), requiring at least 三级（监督保护级）for models past a risk threshold. The two scales are not comparable and should never be equated — MLPS grades a whole information system's protection obligations under PRC law, while SL1–SL5 grades resistance to specified attacker capability tiers.

translations.notes: Universal in Chinese ML and policy writing; also 开放权重模型 for 'open-weight model'.

attestations.quote_zh: 2025 年 1 月，商务部工业与安全局（BIS）首次发布规则，试图将 AI 模型权重本身纳入出口管制。
attestations.quote_en: In January 2025 the Bureau of Industry and Security issued a rule for the first time attempting to bring AI model weights themselves within export controls.
attestations.source_title: 人工智能治理研究报告（2025 年）
attestations.publisher: 中国信息通信研究院（CAICT）政策与经济研究所

attestations.quote_zh: 自主潜逃：能识别并利用托管基础设施中的零日漏洞，或通过操纵管理员将模型权重导出到外部服务器。
attestations.quote_en: Autonomous escape: able to identify and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in hosting infrastructure, or to manipulate administrators into exporting model weights to an external server.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

translations.notes: Compositional and immediately understood, but Chinese sources tend to express the idea through concrete measures (隔离存储、访问控制、等级保护) rather than as a named category. No verbatim occurrence of the compound recovered in this pass.

translations.zh: 模型权重采用极端隔离存储策略
translations.pinyin: móxíng quánzhòng cǎiyòng jíduān gélí cúnchǔ cèlüè
translations.literal_back: model weights use an extreme isolated-storage policy
translations.notes: How the Chinese frontier framework actually phrases the requirement — as a control, not a term. Useful as a model sentence when writing about weight security in Chinese.

attestations.quote_zh: 实施最高级别访问控制，仅限可信人员/机构访问，严禁对外暴露敏感模型；模型权重采用极端隔离存储策略，使暴露风险最小化；执行全生命周期安全审计与对抗演练；遵循等级保护标准要求。
attestations.quote_en: Apply the highest level of access control, restricted to trusted personnel and institutions, with sensitive models strictly not exposed externally; store model weights under an extreme isolation policy to minimise exposure risk; conduct full-lifecycle security audits and adversarial exercises; and comply with graded-protection standard requirements.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 模型权重采用极端隔离存储策略，使暴露风险最小化。
attestations.quote_en: Model weights shall use an extreme isolation storage strategy so as to minimise exposure risk.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

used_by.org: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI
used_by.zh_used: 模型权重 + 等级保护
used_by.note: maps weight protection onto China's MLPS levels rather than RAND SL tiers
in the export-control context

usage_examples.zh: 越过红线的模型，其权重至少应按三级等级保护要求隔离存储。
usage_examples.en: For models that have crossed a red line, weights should be stored in isolation to at least MLPS Level 3 requirements.

definition_en: The target property of an interpretability decomposition: each recovered unit corresponds to exactly one human-legible concept. The goal SAEs pursue, and the title concept of Anthropic's 2023 Towards Monosemanticity.
definition_zh: 可解释性分解所追求的性质：分解出来的每个单元只对应一个人类能理解的概念。它是训练 SAE 的目标，也是 Anthropic 2023 年 Towards Monosemanticity 一文的核心概念。
pitfalls: Added because it is the antonym that makes 多义性 usable, and it inherits the same unresolved split: 单义性 (matching 多义性) vs 单语义性 (matching 多语义性). Chinese renderings of Anthropic's paper title used 单语义性; Chinese renderings of SAE surveys use 单义. Pick one and stay consistent with whichever you chose for polysemanticity. Also note 单义 is sometimes written adjectivally as 单义的特征 rather than as an abstract noun.

translations.notes: Our recommendation, pairing with 多义性.

attestations.quote_zh: 可解释性指标通过自动化方法、稀疏探测任务和特征吸收分析（测量特征是否纠缠多个概念）来评估单义性。
attestations.quote_en: Interpretability metrics assess monosemanticity through automated methods, sparse probing tasks and feature-absorption analysis (measuring whether a feature entangles several concepts).
attestations.source_title: 稀疏自编码器综述：解读大型语言模型的内部机制 (A Survey on Sparse Autoencoders)
attestations.publisher: alphaXiv 中文导读 (arXiv 2503.05613)

attestations.quote_zh: 迈向单义性：基于字典学习的语言模型分解
attestations.quote_en: Towards Monosemanticity: Decomposing Language Models With Dictionary Learning (rendered title in the survey's reference list).
attestations.source_title: 定位、引导与改进：大型语言模型中可操作的机制可解释性实用综述
attestations.publisher: alphaXiv 中文导读 (arXiv 2601.14004)

translations.notes: The variant used when rendering Anthropic's paper title Towards Monosemanticity; pairs with 多语义性. No fetchable verbatim recovered for the abstract-noun form.

usage_examples.zh: SAE 训练的目标就是让每个特征尽量单义。
usage_examples.en: The goal of training an SAE is to make each feature as monosemantic as possible.

definition_en: A halt on developing or deploying systems above some capability level, whether self-imposed by a developer, agreed across an industry, or mandated. The FLI open letter of March 2023 calling for a six-month pause is the canonical instance.
definition_zh: 对超过一定能力水平的系统停止开发或部署，可以是开发者自我约束、行业共同约定或由监管强制。最有代表性的是 2023 年 3 月生命未来研究所发起的呼吁暂停六个月的公开信。
pitfalls: 暂停 (suspend, temporarily) is the natural and attested word, but it is weaker than English 'moratorium', which implies a formal, agreed, bounded halt. 禁令 (ban/injunction) is far stronger and implies legal prohibition — do not use it for a voluntary pause. 停止 is permanent-sounding. The Chinese-language conversation around the 2023 pause letter was largely framed as 呼吁暂停训练 rather than as a governance instrument, and the idea has little purchase in PRC policy discourse, where the framing is 统筹发展和安全 (coordinating development and security) — i.e. that development should not stop. Expect a Chinese reader to hear 暂停 as an operational control rather than a policy demand.

translations.notes: Attested in Chinese frontier-AI risk work as an operational decision: the red zone of the risk framework is defined as 暂停部署或开发. This is the strongest, most concrete Chinese usage of the concept.

attestations.quote_zh: 三类风险区分别为：绿区（常规部署、广泛可接受）、黄区（受控部署、严格管控下可容忍）或红区（暂停部署或开发、不可接受）。
attestations.quote_en: The three risk zones are: green (routine deployment, broadly acceptable), yellow (controlled deployment, tolerable under strict controls), and red (suspend deployment or development, unacceptable).
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 立即采取措施，阻断潜在灾难性后果的发生路径；执行最高级别的管控措施和操作限制；暂停相关运行或部署，直至风险降至红线以下；在恢复运营前，完成并通过独立第三方安全审查。
attestations.quote_en: Immediately act to cut off the pathway to potentially catastrophic consequences; apply the highest level of controls and operating restrictions; suspend the relevant operation or deployment until risk falls below the red line; and complete and pass an independent third-party safety review before resuming operations.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

definition_en: A system of multiple interacting agents in a shared environment. In safety, the frame where collusion, emergent coordination failures and principal-hierarchy problems arise.
definition_zh: 由多个智能体在同一环境中交互构成的系统。在安全研究中，合谋、协作失败和多层委托授权等问题都出现在这一框架下。
pitfalls: Unproblematic — this is the one term in the category with a genuinely settled, textbook-stable rendering, inherited from classical distributed-AI literature long before LLMs. Its stability is in fact part of why 智能体 beat 代理 for 'agent': the multi-agent compound already existed and only works with 智能体. Note that the newer industry phrase 多智能体协同 (multi-agent coordination) is what safety writing usually uses, rather than the system-theoretic 多智能体系统.

translations.notes: Textbook-stable; identical wording appears in Chinese Wikipedia and in 机器之心's technology glossary.

definition_en: The national cybersecurity baseline regime mandated by Article 21 of the Cybersecurity Law and specified in GB/T 22239 (baseline requirements) and GB/T 25070 (security design technical requirements). Every network operator classifies each system into one of five protection levels according to the harm its compromise would cause, and then implements the control set for that level. Operation runs in five phases: grading the system (定级), filing the grading with the public security organs (备案), building the controls (安全建设), a formal graded evaluation by a licensed testing body (等级测评), and periodic supervision. Level 3 (监督保护级, 'supervised protection') is the practical bar for systems of any consequence, and Chinese frontier-AI guidance now applies it to model weights. In Chinese the full legal name is shortened to 等级保护 in writing and to 等保 in industry speech; all three name the same regime.
definition_zh: 《网络安全法》第二十一条确立、GB/T 22239《网络安全等级保护基本要求》与 GB/T 25070《网络安全等级保护安全设计技术要求》细化的国家网络安全基线制度。网络运营者按系统受破坏后造成危害的程度定级（共五级），落实对应级别的安全保护要求，流程包括系统定级、系统备案、系统安全建设、系统等级测评和监管单位监督检查五个阶段。三级（监督保护级）是重要系统的通行门槛；国内前沿人工智能风险管理文件已把等级保护要求套用到模型权重的保护上。全称在实践中简称"等级保护"，业内口语多说"等保"。
pitfalls: The abbreviation MLPS is entrenched in compliance practice but is not an official English name, and its expansion varies ('Multi-Level Protection Scheme', 'Multi-level Protection System', 'Cybersecurity Classified Protection'). More important for AI readers: MLPS levels are NOT capability tiers and must never be lined up with Anthropic ASL levels, OpenAI Preparedness tiers or RAND security levels. MLPS grades a *system by the consequences of its compromise* and prescribes an IT-security control baseline; ASL/RAND SL grade a *model by what it can do* or the *class of attacker it can resist*. The overlap is only that Chinese frontier-risk documents use MLPS Level 3 as the floor for weight security once a model crosses a yellow or red line — that is a mapping onto an existing national control set, not an equivalent scale. Also note the false friend inside the term: the 备案 phase of MLPS is a filing with the *public security* organs, unrelated to CAC algorithm filing — a third distinct use of 备案 alongside algorithm filing and generative-model filing, all of which English flattens into 'filing'. Finally, the short forms: 等级保护 is the standard written abbreviation and 等保 is normal in industry speech; both denote this same regime, so a text that says 等保三级 is making an MLPS Level 3 claim, not referring to some other scheme.

en_renderings.notes: China Law Translate's rendering of Cybersecurity Law Art. 21 and the form used across compliance practice. 'MLPS' is the abbreviation an English-speaking reader will meet in the wild; 'MLPS 2.0' refers to the 2019 revision of GB/T 22239. The third attestation is evidence for the short form 等级保护 rather than for the English wording: it is how the regime is invoked in frontier-AI weight-security guidance, where the full legal name is never spelled out.

attestations.quote_zh: 国家实行网络安全等级保护制度。网络运营者应当按照网络安全等级保护制度的要求，履行下列安全保护义务，保障网络免受干扰、破坏或者未经授权的访问，防止网络数据泄露或者被窃取、篡改：
attestations.quote_en: The State is to implement a Multi-level protection system [MLPS] for cybersecurity. Network operators shall perform the following security protection duties according to the requirements of the MLPS to ensure the network avoids interference, damage, or unauthorized visits, and to prevent network data leaks, theft, or alteration:
attestations.source_title: 《中华人民共和国网络安全法》第二十一条 / PRC Cybersecurity Law, Article 21
attestations.publisher: 全国人大常委会; English translation by China Law Translate

attestations.quote_zh: 遵循《信息安全技术网络安全等级保护安全设计技术要求》（GB/T25070—2019）等网络安全保护国家标准，并从系统定级、系统备案、系统安全建设、系统等级测评、监督检查等五个阶段实施等级保护。已越过黄线或红线的人工智能模型，至少应满足三级（监督保护级）及以上等级保护要求，确保网络和资产安全符合国家标准。
attestations.quote_en: Follow national cybersecurity standards such as GB/T 25070-2019 (Information security technology — Technical requirements of security design for classified protection of cybersecurity), implementing graded protection across the five phases of system grading, system filing, system security construction, graded evaluation and supervisory inspection. AI models that have crossed a yellow or red line shall meet at least Level 3 (supervised protection) graded protection requirements, ensuring network and asset security conforms to national standards.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Shanghai AI Laboratory & Concordia AI)

attestations.quote_zh: 实施最高级别访问控制，仅限可信人员/机构访问，严禁对外暴露敏感模型；模型权重采用极端隔离存储策略，使暴露风险最小化；执行全生命周期安全审计与对抗演练；遵循等级保护标准要求。
attestations.quote_en: Apply the highest level of access control, restricted to trusted personnel and institutions, with sensitive models strictly not exposed externally; store model weights under an extreme isolation policy to minimise exposure risk; conduct full-lifecycle security audits and adversarial exercises; and comply with graded-protection standard requirements.
attestations.source_title: 《前沿人工智能风险管理框架 2.0》
attestations.publisher: 上海人工智能实验室 / 安远 AI (Concordia AI)

en_renderings.notes: We advocate this alongside MLPS rather than instead of it. It is closer to the Chinese and preferable in analytic prose because it foregrounds the grading logic (等级) that 'multi-level protection' obscures, and it keeps the parallel with 分类分级 visible. It is used informally in compliance writing, but we did not capture a citable published instance in this pass, so it is recorded as proposed rather than attested; 'MLPS' remains the form with recognition value and should lead on first use.

why_no_english: The concept — a single national scale that every information system in the country must be graded on, with a state-prescribed control set per grade, a licensed third-party evaluation, and a police filing — has no Anglophone equivalent. NIST 800-53 baselines and FISMA impact levels are the closest, but they bind only federal systems, carry no licensed-evaluator step and no filing with law enforcement, and are not a universal societal grading. So English must choose between 'multi-level protection', which is opaque, and 'graded protection', which is transparent but unrecognised. The deeper problem is that any English word for 'level' invites the reader to compare MLPS levels with AI capability tiers, which is a category error: MLPS grades consequences of compromise, not capability.
